8.71.31: मन्युं च मा कृथाः पार्थ यन्मयोक्तोऽसि दारुणम् ॥३१॥
8.71.33: तमुत्थाप्य ततो राजा परिष्वज्य च पीडितम् ।
8.71.34: माहात्म्यं विजयं चैव भूयः प्राप्नुहि शाश्वतम् ॥३४॥
8.71.35: अद्य तं पापकर्माणं सानुबन्धं रणे शरैः ।
8.71.38: इति सत्येन ते पादौ स्पृशामि जगतीपते ॥३८॥
8.72.2: कल्पतां मे रथो भूयो युज्यन्तां च हयोत्तमाः ।
आयुधानि च सर्वाणि सज्जन्तां मे महारथे ॥२॥
8.72.5: उवाच दारुकं कृष्णः कुरु सर्वं यथाब्रवीत् ।
8.72.7: युक्तं तु तं रथं दृष्ट्वा दारुकेण महात्मना ॥७॥
8.72.8: आपृच्छ्य धर्मराजानं ब्राह्मणान् स्वस्ति वाच्य च ।
8.72.9: आशिषोऽयुङ्क्त स ततः प्रायात् कर्णरथं प्रति ॥९॥
8.72.12: बहवः पक्षिणो राजन् पुन्नामानः शुभाः शिवाः ॥१२॥
8.72.13: कङ्का गृध्रा बकाः श्येना वायसाश्च विशाम्पते ॥१३॥
8.72.16: चिन्ता च विपुला जज्ञे कथं चेदं भविष्यति ।
8.72.17: दृष्ट्वा पार्थं तथा यान्तं चिन्तापरिगतं तदा ।
गाण्डीवधन्वन् सङ्ग्रामे ये त्वया धनुषा जिताः ॥१७॥
8.72.18: न तेषां मानुषो जेता त्वदन्य इह विद्यते ।
8.72.19: त्वां प्राप्य समरे शूरं ते गताः परमां गतिम् ।
को हि द्रोणं च भीष्मं च भगदत्तं च मारिष ॥१९॥
8.72.20: प्रत्युद्गम्य भवेत् क्षेमी यो न स्यात् त्वमिव प्रभो ॥२०॥
8.72.21: तव ह्यस्त्राणि दिव्यानि लाघवं बलमेव च ।
8.72.22: भवान् देवान् सगन्धर्वान् हन्यात् सह चराचरान् ॥२२॥
8.72.23: पृथिव्यां तु रणे पार्थ न योद्धा त्वत्समः पुमान् ।
धनुर्ग्राहा हि ये केचित् क्षत्रिया युद्धदुर्मदाः ॥२३॥
8.72.24: आ देवात् त्वत्समं तेषां न पश्यामि शृणोमि च ।
ब्रह्मणा च प्रजाः सृष्ट्वा गाण्डीवं च महद् धनुः ॥२४॥
8.72.25: येन त्वं युध्यसे पार्थ तस्मान्नास्ति त्वया समः ।
अवश्यं तु मया वाच्यं यत् पथ्यं तव पाण्डव ॥२५॥
8.72.26: कर्णो हि बलवान् दृप्तः कृतास्त्रश्च महारथः ॥२६॥
8.72.27: कृती च चित्रयोधी च देशकालस्य कोविदः ।
8.72.28: त्वत्समं त्वद्विशिष्टं वा कर्णं मन्ये महारथम् ।
8.72.32: ऋते त्वामिति मे बुद्धिस्तदद्य जहि सूतजम् ॥३२॥
8.72.33: अशक्यः स रथो जेतुं सर्वैरपि युयुत्सभिः ॥३३॥
8.72.37: आत्मानं मन्यते वीरं येन पापः सुयोधनः ।
तमद्य मूलं पापानां जहि सौतिं धनञ्जय ॥३७॥
8.72.39: अहं त्वामनुजानामि वीर्येण च बलेन च ।
जहि कर्णं रणे शूर मातङ्गमिव केसरी ॥३९॥
8.72.40: तमद्य पार्थ सङ्ग्रामे कर्णं वैकर्तनं जहि ॥४०॥
8.73.3: भूत्वा हि विपुला सेना तावकानां परैः सह ।
8.73.4: त्वां वै शत्रुं समासाद्य विनष्टा रणमूर्धनि ॥४॥
8.73.7: को हि शक्तो रणे जेतुं कौरवांस्तात संयुगे ।
अन्यत्र पाण्डवान् युद्धे त्वया गुप्तान् महारथान् ॥७॥
8.73.8: त्रील्लोँकान् समरे युक्तान् किं पुनः कौरवं बलम् ॥८॥
8.73.9: भगदत्तं च राजानं कोऽन्यः शक्तस्त्वया विना ।
8.73.10: तथेमां विपुलां सेनां गुप्तां पार्थ त्वयानघ ।
न शेकुः पार्थिवाः सर्वे चक्षर्भिरपि वीक्षितुम् ॥१०॥
8.73.11: तथैव सततं पार्थ रक्षिताभ्यां त्वया रणे ।
8.73.12: को हि शक्तो रणे पार्थ भारतानां महारथौ ।
8.73.13: को हि शान्तनवं भीष्मं द्रोणं वैकर्तनं कृपम् ।
द्रौणिं च सौमदत्तिं च कृतवर्माणमेव च ॥१३॥
8.73.18: त्वां समासाद्य निधनं गता भीमं च भारत ॥१८॥
8.73.22: न शक्या युधि निर्जेतुं त्वदन्येन परन्तप ।
धार्तराष्ट्रमुदग्रं हि व्यूढं दृष्ट्वा महद् बलम् ॥२२॥
8.73.23: यदि त्वं न भवेस्त्राता प्रतीयात् को नु मानवः ।
8.73.27: भीमसेनं समासाद्य त्वां च पाण्डव कौरवाः ॥२७॥
8.73.28: तथा सेनामुखे तत्र निहते पार्थ पाण्डवैः ॥२८॥
8.73.33: दिनानि दश भीष्मेण निघ्नता तावकं बलम् ॥३३॥
8.73.38: न शेकुः सृञ्जया द्रष्टुं तथैवान्ये महीक्षितः ।
विचरन्तं तथा तं तु सङ्ग्रामे जितकाशिनम् ॥३८॥
8.73.39: स तु विद्राव्य समरे पाण्डवान् सृञ्जयानपि ॥३९॥
8.73.40: तं शिखण्डी समासाद्य त्वया गुप्तो महाव्रतम् ॥४०॥
8.73.41: स एष पतितः शेते शरतल्पे पितामहः ॥४१॥
8.73.42: त्वां प्राप्य पुरुषव्याघ्रं वृत्रः प्राप्येव वासवम् ।
8.73.45: धृष्टद्युम्नं समासाद्य स गतः परमां गतिम् ।
यदि वाद्य भवान् युद्धे सूतपुत्रमुखान् रथान् ॥४५॥
8.73.46: नावारयिष्यः सङ्ग्रामे न स्म द्रोणो व्यनङ्क्ष्यत ।
भवता तु बलं सर्वं धार्तराष्ट्रस्य वारितम् ॥४६॥
8.73.47: ततो द्रोणो हतो युद्धे पार्षतेन धनञ्जय ।
एवं वा को रणे कुर्यात् त्वदन्यः क्षत्रियो युधि ॥४७॥
8.73.48: यादृशं ते कृतं पार्थ जयद्रथवधं प्रति ।
निवार्य सेनां महतीं हत्वा शूरांश्च पार्थिवान् ॥४८॥
8.73.50: अनाश्चर्यं हि तत् त्वत्तस्त्वं हि पार्थ महारथः ।
त्वां हि प्राप्य रणे क्षत्रमेकाहादिति भारत ॥५०॥
8.73.53: विध्वस्ता हि रणे पार्थ सेनेयं भीमविक्रम ॥५३॥
8.73.59: यदि वा द्विपदां श्रेष्ठं द्रोणं मानयतो गुरुम् ।
अश्वत्थाम्नि कृपा तेऽस्ति कृपे वाचार्य गौरवात् ॥५९॥
8.73.63: एतत् ते सुकृतं कर्म नात्र किञ्चन युज्यते ।
8.73.65: तस्य सर्वस्य दुष्टात्मा कर्णो वै मूलमित्युत ।
8.73.67: कर्णः पार्थात् रणे सर्वान् विजेष्यति न संशयः ।
8.73.68: रोचितो भवता सार्धं जानतापि बल तव ।
कर्णो हि भाषते नित्यमहं पार्थान् समागतान् ॥६८॥
8.73.70: यच्च युष्मासु पापं वै धार्तराष्ट्रः प्रयुक्तवान् ॥७०॥
8.73.76: तन्मे दहति गात्राणि सखे सत्येन ते शपे ।
यत् तत्रापि च दुष्टात्मा कर्णोऽभ्यद्रुह्यत प्रभो ॥७६॥
8.73.80: श्रुत्वा कर्णो वचः क्रूरं ततश्चिच्छेद कार्मुकम् ।
8.73.82: प्राहसत् स तु दुष्टात्मा कर्णः स च सुयोधनः ।
यच्च कर्णोऽब्रवीत् कृष्णां सभायां परुषं वचः ॥८२॥
8.73.83: विनष्टाः पाण्डवाः कृष्णे शाश्वतं नरकं गताः ॥८३॥
8.73.85: न पाण्डवाः प्रभवन्ति तव कृष्णे कथञ्चन ॥८५॥
8.73.86: दासभार्या च पाञ्चालि स्वयं दासी च शोभने ।
अद्य दुर्योधनो ह्योकः पृथिव्यां नृपतिः स्मृतः ॥८६॥
8.73.87: पश्येदानीं यथा भद्रे विनष्टाः पाण्डवाः समम् ॥८७॥
8.73.88: व्यक्तं षण्ढतिला ह्येते निरये च निमज्जिताः ॥८८॥
8.73.90: अद्य पापस्य तद् वाक्यं सुवर्णविकृताः शराः ॥९०॥
8.73.99: त्वं चेत् कर्णसुतं पार्थ सूतपुत्रस्य पश्यतः ।
8.73.100: हतं कर्णस्तु तं दृष्ट्वा प्रियं पुत्रं दुरात्मवान् ।
8.73.101: निराशो जीविते त्वद्य राज्ये चैव भवत्वरिः ॥१०१॥
8.73.102: एते द्रवन्ति पञ्चाला वध्यमानाः शितैः शरैः ।
8.73.104: सुधर्माणं सात्यकिं च विद्धि कर्णवशं गतान् ॥१०४॥
8.73.106: न त्वेव भीताः पञ्चालाः कथञ्चित् स्युः पराङ्मुखाः ।
न हि मृत्युं महेष्वासा गणयन्ति महारणे ॥१०६॥
8.73.107: य एकः पाण्डवीं सेनां शरौघैः समवेष्टयत् ।
तं समासाद्य पञ्चाला भीष्मं नासन् पराङ्मुखाः ॥१०७॥
8.73.119: एते द्रवन्ति पञ्चाला दिक्षु सर्वासु भारत ।
8.73.120: एष भीमो दृढक्रोधो वृतः पार्थ समन्ततः ।
8.73.122: नान्यं त्वत्तो हि पश्यामि योधं यौधिष्ठिरे बले ।
8.73.124: त्वं हि शक्तो रणे जेतुं सकर्णानपि कौरवान् ।
नान्यो युधि युधां श्रेष्ठ सत्यमेतद् ब्रवीमि ते ॥१२४॥
8.73.125: एतत् कृत्वा महत् कर्म हत्वा कर्णं महारथम् ।
कृतार्थः सफलः पार्थ सुखी भव नरोत्तम ॥१२५॥
8.74.1: स केशवस्य बीभत्सुः श्रुत्वा भारत भाषितम् ।
8.74.3: त्वया नाथेन गोविन्द ध्रुव एव जयो मम ।
प्रसन्नो यस्य मेऽद्य त्वं लोके भूतभविष्यकृत् ॥३॥
8.74.4: त्वत्सहायो ह्यहं कृष्ण त्रीँल्लोकान् वै समागतान् ।
प्रापयेयं परं लोकं किमु कर्णं महाहवे ॥४॥
8.74.6: भार्गवास्त्रं च पश्यामि ज्वलन्तं कृष्ण सर्वशः ।
8.74.7: अयं खलु स सङ्ग्रामो यत्र कर्णं मया हतम् ।
8.74.8: अद्य कृष्ण विकर्णा मे कर्णं नेष्यन्ति मृत्यवे ।
8.74.10: अद्य राज्यात् सुखाच्चैव श्रियो राष्ट्रात् तथा पुरात् ।
8.74.11: गुणवन्तं हि यो द्वेष्टि निर्गुणं कुरुते प्रभुम् ।
स शोचति नृपः कृष्ण क्षिप्रमेवागते क्षये ॥११॥
8.74.12: यथा च पुरुषः कश्चिच्छित्त्वा चाम्रवणं महत् ।
फलं दृष्ट्वा भृशं दुःखी भविष्यति जनार्दन ।
सूतपुत्रे हते त्वद्य निराशो भविता प्रभुः ॥१२॥
8.74.13: भविष्यति हते कर्णे कृष्ण सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते ॥१३॥
8.74.14: स्मरतां तव वाक्यानि शमं प्रति जनेश्वरः ॥१४॥
8.74.15: अद्यासौ सौबलः कृष्ण ग्लहाञ्जानातु वै शरान् ।
दुरोदरं च गाण्डीवं मण्डलं च रथं प्रति ॥१५॥
8.74.16: व्यपनेष्यामि गोविन्द हत्वा कर्णं शितैः शरैः ॥१६॥
8.74.17: अद्य कुन्तीसुतो राजा हते सूतसुते मया ।
8.74.19: यस्य चैतद् व्रतं मह्यं वधे किल दुरात्मनः ।
पादौ न धावये तावद् यावद्धन्यां न फाल्गुनम् ॥१९॥
8.74.20: मृषा कृत्वा व्रतं तस्य पापस्य मधुसूदन ।
8.74.23: अनृतं तत् करिष्यन्ति मामका निशिताः शराः ।
8.74.25: सभामध्ये वचः क्रूरं कुत्सयन् पाण्डवान् प्रति ॥२५॥
8.74.26: ये वै षण्ढतिलास्तत्र भवितारोऽद्य ते तिलाः ।
8.74.28: अनृतं तत् करिष्यन्ति मामका निशिताः शराः ।
8.74.33: अद्य कर्णे हते कृष्ण धार्तराष्ट्राः सराजकाः ॥३३॥
8.74.34: विद्रवन्तु दिशो भीताः सिंहत्रस्ता मृगा इव ।
8.74.35: हते कर्णे मया सङ्ख्ये सपुत्रे ससुहृज्जने ।
8.74.36: जानातु मां रणे कृष्ण प्रवरं सर्वधन्विनाम् ।
8.74.40: अद्य राजा महत् कृच्छ्रं सन्त्यक्ष्यति युधिष्ठिरः ॥४०॥
8.74.45: प्रमथिष्यामि गात्राणि शिरांसि च शितैः शरैः ।
अद्य निर्धार्तराष्ट्रां च भ्रात्रे दास्यामि मेदिनीम् ॥४५॥
8.74.47: कोपस्य च कुरूणां च शराणां गाण्डिवस्य च ।
8.74.48: हत्वा कर्णं रणे कृष्ण शम्बरं मघवानिव ।
अद्य कर्णे हते युद्धे सोमकानां महारथाः ॥४८॥
8.74.49: कृतं कार्यं च मन्यन्तां मित्रकार्येप्सवो युधि ।
न जाने च कथं प्रीतिः शैनेयस्याद्य माधव ॥४९॥
8.74.50: भविष्यति हते कर्णे मयि चापि जयाधिके ।
अहं हत्वा रणे कर्णं पुत्रं चास्य महारथम् ॥५०॥
8.74.51: प्रीतिं दास्यामि भीमस्य यमयोः सात्यकस्य च ।
8.74.53: युध्यन्तं कौरवान् सङ्ख्ये घातयन्तं च सूतजम् ।
8.74.57: पादौ च मे सरथौ सध्वजौ च
8.76.15: किं शिष्टं स्यात् सायकानां रथे मे ।
का वा जातिः किं प्रमाणं च तेषां
8.76.15d1: कति वा सहस्राणि कति वा शतानि
8.77.1: श्रुत्वा तु रथनिर्घोषं सिंहनदं च संयुगे ।
अर्जुनः प्राह गोविन्दं शीघ्रं नोदय वाजिनः ॥१॥
8.77.2: एष गच्छामि सुक्षिप्रं यत्र भीमो व्यवस्थितः ॥२॥
8.77.13: ते तु तं पुरुषव्याघ्रं व्याघ्रा इव महारथाः ।
8.77.17: तत्र तत्र स्म लीयन्ते भये जाते महारथाः ॥१७॥
8.77.19: ते वध्यमानाः समरे नानालिङ्गैः शितैः शरैः ।
8.77.21: तां तु सेनां भृशं विद्ध्वा द्रावयित्वार्जुनः शरैः ।
8.77.24: त्यक्त्वा प्राणान् महाराज सेनां तव ममर्द ह ॥२४॥
8.77.27: तां तु सेनां तदा भीमो दर्शयन् पाणिलाघवम् ।
8.77.30: समादिशन् रणे सर्वान् हत भीममिति स्म ह ॥३०॥
8.77.31: प्रतिगृह्य च तामाज्ञां तव पुत्रस्य पार्थिवाः ॥३१॥
8.77.33: स तैः परिवृतः शूरैः शूरो राजन् समन्ततः ॥३३॥
8.77.35: स रराज तथा सङ्ख्ये दर्शनीयो नरोत्तमः ।
8.77.36: तस्य ते पार्थिवाः सर्वे शरवृष्टिं समासृजन् ।
8.77.38: नृणां शतसहस्रे द्वे द्वे शते चैव भारत ॥३८॥
8.77.47: एवं दृष्ट्वा कृतं कर्म भीमसेनेन संयुगे ।
8.77.48: अस्मिन् जिते जितं मन्ये पाण्डवेयं महाबलम् ॥४८॥
8.77.51: संन्यवर्तत तं भीमो वार्यमाणः शितैः शरैः ।
8.77.52: वर्म भित्त्वा तु ते घोराः पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः ॥५२॥
8.77.54: प्रेषयामास स रुषा सौबलं प्रति भारत ।
8.77.55: तस्मिन् निपतिते भूमौ भीमः क्रुद्धो विशाम्पते ॥५५॥
8.77.58: द्वाभ्यां स सारथिं ह्यार्च्छद् भीमं सप्तभिरेव च ।
8.77.62: सा निर्भिद्य भुजं सव्यं पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः ॥६२॥
8.77.64: न तु तं ममृषे भीमः सिंहनादं तरस्विनाम् ।
अन्यद् गृह्य धनुः सज्यं त्वरमाणो महाबलः ॥६४॥
8.77.69: धनुश्चिच्छेद सङ्क्रुद्धो विव्याध च शितैः शरैः ।
8.77.74: पराङ्मुखं तु राजानं दृष्ट्वा सैन्यानि भारत ।
8.77.75: तान् दृष्ट्वा विद्रुतान् सर्वान् धार्तराष्ट्रान् पराङ्मुखान् ।
8.77.77: स हि तेषां महावीर्यो द्वीपोऽभूत् सुमहाबलः ।
8.78.1: दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत् किं नु सौबलो वापि सञ्जय ॥१॥
8.78.2: कर्णो वा जयतां श्रेष्ठो योधा वा मामका युधि ।
कृपो वा कृतवर्मा वा द्रौणिर्दुःशासनोऽपि वा ॥२॥
8.78.5: शर्म वर्म प्रतिष्ठा च जीविताशा च सञ्जय ।
8.78.6: पुत्रा वा मम दुर्धर्षा राजानो वा महारथाः ।
8.78.11: प्रविश्य च महत् सैन्यं शल्यः परबलार्दनः ।
8.78.16: तं शिखण्डी च भीमश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः ।
8.78.17: सात्यकिस्तु तदा कर्णं विंशत्या निशितैः शरैः ॥१७॥
8.78.22: तान् प्रत्यविध्यद् राधेयः पञ्चभिः पञ्चभिः शरैः ।
8.78.23: भीमसेनं ततः क्रुद्धो विव्याध त्रिंशता शरैः ॥२३॥
8.78.29: प्राद्रवन्त रणे भीताः सिंहत्रस्ता मृगा इव ।
8.78.35: प्राद्रवन्त रणे भीताः कर्णं दृष्ट्वा महारथम् ।
8.78.37: कर्णमेकं रणे योधं मेनिरे तत्र शात्रवाः ।
8.78.39: तथा तत् पाण्डवं सैन्यं कर्णमासाद्य दीर्यते ।
8.78.41: बाहूंश्च वीरो वीराणां चिच्छेद लघु चेषुभिः ।
8.78.42: रथांश्च विविधान् राजन् पताका व्यजनानि च ।
अक्षं च युगयोक्त्राणि चक्राणि विविधानि च ॥४२॥
8.78.45: नापि स्वे न परे योधाः प्राज्ञायन्त परस्परम् ॥४५॥
8.78.46: घोरे शरान्धकारे तु कर्णास्त्रे च विजृम्भिते ।
8.78.47: ते पाण्डवेयाः समरे राधेयेन पुनः पुनः ॥४७॥
8.78.48: मृगसङ्घान् यथा क्रुद्धः सिंहो द्रावयते वने ॥४८॥
8.78.50: कालयामास तत् सैन्यं यथा पशुगणान् वृकः ।
दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवीं सेनां धार्तराष्ट्राः पराङ्मुखीम् ॥५०॥
8.78.51: दुर्योधनो हि राजेन्द्र मुदा परमया युतः ॥५१॥
8.78.53: न्यवर्तन्त यथा शूरं मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम् ।
तान् निवृत्तान् रणे शूरान् राधेयः शत्रुतापनः ॥५३॥
8.78.54: तत्र भारत कर्णेन पञ्चाला विंशती रथाः ॥५४॥
8.78.59: तथा स सोमकान् हत्वा तस्थावेको महारथः ।
8.78.63: तत्र युद्धं महच्चासीत् क्रूरं विशसनं महत् ।
8.79.1: सूतपुत्रं च सङ्क्रुद्धं दृष्ट्वा चैव महारणे ॥१॥
8.79.5: जयैषिणां च सुतरां भीरूणां च सुदुस्तराम् ॥५॥
8.79.7: एष केतू रणे कृष्ण सूतपुत्रस्य दृश्यते ।
8.79.9: कर्णेन भग्नान् पञ्चालान् द्रावयन् बहु शोभते ।
8.79.13: निःशेषान् समरे कुर्यात् पश्यतां नो जनार्दन ॥१३॥
8.79.19: अयं स रथ आयाति श्वेताश्वः कृष्णसारथिः ।
8.79.20: एष तिष्ठति कौन्तेयः संस्पृशन् गाण्डिवं धनुः ।
तं हनिष्यसि चेदद्य तन्नः श्रेयो भविष्यति ॥२०॥
8.79.23: एतच्चक्रं गदा शङ्खः शार्ङ्गं कृष्णस्य च प्रभो ।
8.79.24: एते हस्तवता मुक्ता घ्नन्त्यमित्रान् शिताः शराः ॥२४॥
8.79.31: असह्यमानो राधेय तं याहि प्रति भारत ॥३१॥
8.79.31d1: घृणां त्यक्त्वा प्रमादं च भृगोरस्त्रं च संस्मर ।
दृष्टिं मुष्टिं च सन्धानं स्मृत्वा रामोपदेशजम् ।
8.79.32: अर्जुनस्य भयात् तूर्णं निघ्नतः शात्रवान् बहून् ॥३२॥
8.79.34: न ह्यवस्थास्यते पार्थो युयुत्सुः केनचित् सह ।
8.79.35: शिखण्डिनं सात्यकिं च धृष्टद्युम्नं च पार्षतम् ॥३५॥
8.79.36: नकुलं सहदेवं च भ्रातरौ द्वौ समीक्ष्य च ॥३६॥
8.79.38: त्वं कर्ण प्रतियाह्येनं नास्त्यन्यो हि धनुर्धरः ॥३८॥
8.79.39: न तं पश्यामि लोकेऽस्मिंस्त्वत्तो ह्यन्यं धनुर्धरम् ।
अर्जुनं समरे क्रुद्धं यो वेलामिव धारयेत् ॥३९॥
8.79.40: न चास्य रक्षां पश्यामि पार्श्वतो न च पृष्ठतः ।
8.79.41: त्वं हि कृष्णौ रणे सक्तः संसाधयितुमाहवे ।
8.79.43: वनस्थितं यथा व्याघ्रं जहि कर्ण धनञ्जयम् ॥४३॥
8.79.45: द्रवतामथ तेषां तु नान्योऽस्ति युधि मानवः ।
8.79.46: एते त्वां कुरवः सर्वे द्वीपमासाद्य संयुगे ।
8.79.47: गान्धाराश्च यया धृत्या जिताः सङ्ख्ये सुदुर्जयाः ।
तां धृतिं कुरु राधेय ततः प्रत्येहि पाण्डवम् ॥४७॥
8.79.48d1: यथैकेन त्वया पूर्वं कृतो दिग्विजयः पुरा ।
8.79.50: पश्य बाह्वोर्बलं मेऽद्य शिक्षितस्य च पश्य मे ।
8.79.51: कृष्णौ च पुरुषव्याघ्र ततः सत्यं ब्रवीमि ते ।
नाहत्वा युधि तौ वीरौ व्यपयास्ये कथञ्चन ॥५१॥
8.79.52: स्वप्स्ये वा निहतस्ताभ्यामनित्यो हि रणे जयः ।
8.79.66: भयं मे वै जायते साध्वसं च
8.80.5: गात्राणि प्राच्छिनत् पार्थः शिरांसि च चकर्त ह ॥५॥
8.80.20: कृतं प्रविहतं बाणैः सर्वतः प्रद्रुतं दिशः ।
8.80.21: उत्सृज्य च महाबाहुं भीमसेनं तथा रणे ॥२१॥
8.80.23: समागम्य च भीमेन मन्त्रयित्वा च फाल्गुनः ॥२३॥
8.80.25: नादयन् रथघोषेण पृथिवीं द्यां च भारत ।
8.80.28: न युक्तान् हि स तान् मेने यमायाशु किरीटिना ।
8.81.6: सविमाना यथा सिद्धाः स्वर्गात् पुण्यक्षये तथा ॥६॥
8.81.11: पार्श्वतो व्यहनन् पार्थं तव पुत्रस्य शासनात् ॥११॥
8.81.14: अथ तान् द्विरदान् सर्वान् नानालिङ्गैः शरोत्तमैः ।
8.81.20d1: असंयुक्ताश्च ते राजन् परिवृत्ता रणं प्रति ।
8.81.23: दृष्ट्वार्जुनं तदा भीमो जगाम भ्रातरं प्रति ॥२३॥
8.81.31: गदापाणिं ततो भीमं दृष्ट्वा भारत तावकाः ।
8.81.32: स मत्त इव मातङ्गः सङ्क्रुद्धः पाण्डुनन्दनः ।
8.81.33: विगाह्य च गजानीकं प्रगृह्य महतीं गदाम् ।
8.81.35: हत्वा तु तद् गजानीकं भीमसेनो महाबलः ।
8.81.41: न ह्यत्रासीदनिर्भिन्नो रथः सादी हयो गजः ॥४१॥
8.81.42d1: तत् सैन्यं भरतश्रेष्ठ वध्यमानं शितैः शरैः ।
न जहौ समरं प्राप्य फाल्गुनं शत्रुतापनम् ॥
8.81.45: ते हित्वा समरे कर्णं वध्यमानाश्च सायकैः ।
8.81.46: अभ्यद्रवत तान् पार्थः किरन् शरशतान् बहून् ।
8.81.47: पुत्रास्तु ते महाराज जग्मुः कर्णरथं प्रति ।
8.81.48: कुरवो हि महाराज निर्विषाः पन्नगा इव ।
8.81.51: मा भैष्टेत्यब्रवीत् कर्णो ह्यभीतो मामितेति च ॥५१॥
8.81.52: सम्भग्नं हि बलं दृष्ट्वा बलात् पार्थेन तावकम् ।
8.81.53: तान् प्रद्रुतान् कुरून् दृष्ट्वा कर्णः शस्त्रभृतां वरः ।
8.82.32d1: समं च शूरौ च ससारथी तदा ।
8.83.4: दृष्ट्वा तु तत् कर्म कृतं सुदुष्करं
8.83.24: अनेन याज्ञसेन्या मे भीम केशा विकर्षिताः ।
8.83.42: एष ते रुधिरं कण्ठात् पिबामि पुरुषाधम ॥४२॥
8.83.49: इत्युक्त्वा वचनं राजन् जयं प्राप्य वृकोदरः ।
8.84.1: दुःशासने तु निहते तव पुत्रा महारथाः ।
8.84.2: दश राजन् महावीर्या भीमं प्राच्छादयन् शरैः ।
8.84.6: हतेषु तेषु वीरेषु प्रदुद्राव बलं तव ॥६॥
8.84.7: ततः कर्णो महाराज प्रविवेश महद् भयम् ॥७॥
8.84.9: मा व्यथां कुरु राधेय नैवं त्वय्युपपद्यते ॥९॥
8.84.15: भारो हि धार्तराष्ट्रेण त्वयि सर्वः समाहितः ।
8.84.16: जये स्याद् विपुला कीर्तिर्ध्रुवः स्वर्गः पराजये ।
8.84.17: हृदि चावश्यकं भावं चक्रे युद्धाय सुस्थिरम् ॥१७॥
8.84.iti: इति श्रीमहाभारते कर्णपर्वणि वृषसेनयुद्धे नकुलपराजये चतुरशीतितमोऽध्यायः ॥८४॥
8.85.4: तव नृप रथिवर्यांस्तान् दशैकं च वीरान्
8.85.13: शितैः शरीरं व्यहनद् द्विपं च तम् ॥१३॥
8.86.3: येन ते सह योद्धव्यं स्थिरो भव धनञ्जय ।
पश्य चैनं समायुक्तं रथं कर्णस्य पाण्डव ॥३॥
8.86.5: ध्वजं च पश्य कर्णस्य नागकक्षं महात्मनः ॥५॥
8.86.11: दृष्ट्वा केसरिणं क्रुद्धं मृगा इव महावने ।
8.86.13: त्वं हि जेतुं रणे शक्तस्तथैव विदितं मम ।
8.86.14: न शक्ता द्रष्टुमीशानं किं पुनर्योधितुं प्रभुम् ।
8.86.16: जहि कर्णं महाबाहो नमुचिं वृत्रहा यथा ।
8.86.17: ध्रुव एव जयः कृष्ण मम नास्त्यत्र संशयः ।
8.86.19: अद्य कर्णं हतं पश्य मच्छरैः शकलीकृतम् ।
मां वा द्रक्ष्यसि गोविन्द कर्णेन निहतं शरैः ॥१९॥
8.86.iti: इति श्रीमहाभारते कर्णपर्वणि कर्णार्जुनद्वैरथे वासुदेववाक्ये षडशीतितमोऽध्यायः ॥८६॥
8.87.5: तौ दृष्ट्वा विस्मयं जग्मुः सर्वसैन्यानि मारिष ।
8.87.7: ध्वजौ च दृष्ट्वा संसक्तौ विस्मयः समपद्यत ।
हस्तिकक्षं च कर्णस्य वानरं च किरीटिनः ॥७॥
8.87.8: तौ रथौ सम्प्रसक्तौ तु दृष्ट्वा भारत पार्थिवाः ।
8.87.9: दृष्ट्वा च द्वैरथं ताभ्यां तत्र योधाः सहस्रशः ।
8.87.13: तौ दृष्ट्वा पुरुषव्याघ्रौ रथस्थौ रथिनां वरौ ।
8.87.31: तावकानां रणे कर्णो ग्लहो ह्यासीद् विशाम्पते ।
8.87.32: त एव सभ्यास्तत्रासन् प्रेक्षकाश्चाभवन् स्म ते ।
8.87.34: तौ तु स्थितौ महाराज समरे युद्धशालिनौ ।
8.87.46: वसवो मरुतः साध्या रुद्रा विश्वेऽश्विनौ तथा ॥४६॥
8.87.48: विशः शूद्राश्च सूताश्च ये च सङ्करजातयः ।
8.87.50: ब्रह्म क्षत्रं च यज्ञाश्च दक्षिणाश्चार्जुनं श्रिताः ।
8.87.52d4: ते भावाः सहिताः कर्णं प्रविष्टाः सूतनन्दनम् ।
8.87.52d7: ततो देवगणैः सार्धं सिद्धाश्च सह चारणैः ।
8.87.57: भवश्चैव स्थितो याने दिव्ये तं देशमागमत् ।
8.87.59: हत्वार्जुनं मम सुतः कर्णो जयतु संयुगे ।
हत्वा कर्णं जयत्वद्य मम पुत्रो धनञ्जयः ॥५९॥
8.87.60: इति सूर्यस्य चैवासीद् विवादो वासवस्य च ।
8.87.68: तत् तथास्तु नमस्तेऽस्तु प्रसीद भगवन् मम ।
8.87.70: स्वर्गं च समनुप्राप्य साहाय्यं शक्र ते कृतम् ।
कर्णश्च दानवः पक्ष अतः कार्यः पराजयः ॥७०॥

8.1.18: āpageyaṁ hataṁ śrutvā droṇaṁ cāpi mahāratham,
8.1.20: tasmin hate sa kauravyaḥ kathaṁ prāṇānadhārayat ॥20॥
8.1.21: durmaraṁ tadahaṁ manye nr̥ṇāṁ kr̥cchre’pi vartatām,
yatra karṇaṁ hataṁ śrutvā nātyajajjīvitaṁ nr̥paḥ ॥21॥
8.1.22: tathā śāntanavaṁ vr̥ddhaṁ brahman bāhlīkameva ca,
droṇaṁ ca somadattaṁ ca bhūriśravasameva ca ॥22॥
8.1.23: tathaiva cānyān suhr̥daḥ putrān pautrāṁśca pātitān,
8.1.24: na hi tr̥pyāmi pūrveṣāṁ śr̥ṇvānaścaritaṁ mahat ॥24॥
8.1.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate karṇaparvaṇi janamejayavākyaṁ nāma prathamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥1॥
8.2.3: vavande prāñjalirbhūtvā mūrdhnā pādau nr̥pasya ha ॥3॥
8.2.4: hā kaṣṭamiti coktvā sa tato vacanamādade ॥4॥
8.2.8: nihatān yudhi saṁsmr̥tya kaccinna kuruṣe vyathām ॥8॥
8.2.10: droṇe ca parameṣvāse bhr̥śaṁ me vyathitaṁ manaḥ ॥10॥
8.2.11: yo rathānāṁ sahasrāṇi daṁśitānāṁ daśaiva tu,
8.2.13: sākṣād rāmeṇa yo bālye dhanurveda upākr̥taḥ ॥13॥
8.2.15: taṁ droṇaṁ nihataṁ śrutvā dhr̥ṣṭadyumnena saṁyuge,
satyasandhaṁ maheṣvāsaṁ bhr̥śaṁ me vyathitaṁ manaḥ ॥15॥
8.2.16: tau droṇabhīṣmau śrutvā tu hatau me vyathitaṁ manaḥ ॥16॥
8.2.17: trailokye yasya cāstreṣu na pumān vidyate samaḥ,
taṁ droṇaṁ nihataṁ śrutvā kimakurvata māmakāḥ ॥17॥
8.2.22: matputrasya ca śeṣasya tathānyeṣāṁ ca sañjaya,
8.2.23: etat sarvaṁ yathāvr̥ttaṁ tathā gāvalgaṇe mama,
8.2.24: tacchrutvā mā vyathāṁ kārṣīrdiṣṭe na vyathate budhaḥ ॥24॥
8.2.25: yasmādabhāvī bhāvī vā bhavedartho naraṁ prati,
aprāptau tasya vā prāptau na kaścid vyathate budhaḥ ॥25॥
8.2.26: na vyathābhyadhikā kācid vidyate mama sañjaya,
8.3.1: hate droṇe maheṣvāse tava putrā mahārathāḥ,
8.3.3: tān dr̥ṣṭvā vyathitākārān sainyāni tava bhārata,
8.3.4: prābhraśyanta karāgrebhyo dr̥ṣṭvā droṇaṁ hataṁ yudhi ॥4॥
8.3.7: bhavatāṁ bāhuvīryaṁ hi samāśritya mayā yudhi,
8.3.9: jayo vāpi vadho vāpi yudhyamānasya saṁyuge,
bhavet kimatra citraṁ vai yudhyadhvaṁ sarvatomukhāḥ ॥9॥
8.3.10: paśyadhvaṁ ca mahātmānaṁ karṇaṁ vaikartanaṁ yudhi,
8.3.11: yasya vai yudhi santrāsāt kuntīputro dhanañjayaḥ,
nivartate sadā mandaḥ siṁhāt kṣudramr̥go yathā ॥11॥
8.3.13: amoghayā raṇe śaktyā nihato bhairavaṁ nadan ॥13॥
8.3.16: sarva eva bhavantaśca śaktāḥ pratyekaśo’pi vā,
pāṇḍuputrān raṇe hantuṁ sasainyān kimu saṁhatāḥ ॥16॥
8.3.17: evamuktvā tataḥ karṇaṁ cakre senāpatiṁ tadā,
8.3.19: sa sr̥ñjayānāṁ sarveṣāṁ pañcālānāṁ ca māriṣa,
8.3.20: agre puṅkhe ca saṁsaktā yathā bhramarapaṅktayaḥ ॥20॥
8.3.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate karṇaparvaṇi sañjayavākyaṁ nāma tr̥tīyo’dhyāyaḥ ॥3॥
8.4.2: vihvalaḥ patito bhūmau naṣṭacetā iva dvipaḥ,
8.4.3: sa śabdaḥ pr̥thivīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ pūrayāmāsa sarvaśaḥ ॥3॥
8.4.9: sa labdhvā śanakaiḥ sañjñāṁ tāśca dr̥ṣṭvā striyo nr̥paḥ,
8.4.10: tato dhyātvā ciraṁ kālaṁ niḥśvasya ca punaḥ punaḥ,
svān putrān garhayāmāsa bahu mene ca pāṇḍavān ॥10॥
8.4.11: dhyātvā tu suciraṁ kālaṁ vepamāno muhurmuhuḥ ॥11॥
8.4.12: saṁstabhya ca mano bhūyo rājā dhairyasamanvitaḥ,
8.4.13: yat tvayā kathitaṁ vākyaṁ śrutaṁ sañjaya tanmayā,
kaccid duryodhanaḥ sūta na gato vai yamakṣayam ॥13॥
8.4.14: jaye nirāśaḥ putro me satataṁ jayakāmukaḥ,
8.4.16: pītaṁ ca rudhiraṁ kopād bhīmasenena saṁyuge ॥16॥
8.4.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate karṇaparvaṇi dhr̥tarāṣṭraśoko nāma caturtho’dhyāyaḥ ॥4॥
8.5.2: hataṁ vaikartanaṁ śrutvā śoko marmāṇi kr̥ntati ॥2॥
8.5.3: tasya me saṁśayaṁ chindhi duḥkhapāraṁ titīrṣataḥ,
kurūṇāṁ sr̥ñjayānāṁ ca ke ca jīvanti ke mr̥tāḥ ॥3॥
8.5.5: nihatya yudhi durdharṣaḥ paścād rukmaratho hataḥ ॥5॥
8.5.6: ardhaṁ nihatya sainyasya karṇo vaikartano hataḥ ॥6॥
8.5.11: vaśe tiṣṭhanti vīrasya yaḥ sthitastava śāsane ॥11॥
8.5.17: hato bhūriśravā rājan śūraḥ sātyakinā yudhi ॥17॥
8.5.23: samaḥ karṇasya samare yaḥ sa karṇasya paśyataḥ,
8.5.25: viśrāvya vairaṁ pārthena śrutāyuḥ sa nipātitaḥ ॥25॥
8.5.26: hato rukmaratho rājan bhrātā mātulajo yudhi ॥26॥
8.5.44: sumahat kadanaṁ kr̥tvā hataḥ sātyakinā raṇe ॥44॥
8.5.49: pattīnāṁ nihatāḥ saṅghā hayānāṁ prayutāni ca,
8.5.50: kālena mahatā yattāḥ kuśalairye ca vardhitāḥ ॥50॥
8.5.52: ete cānye ca bahavo rājānaḥ sagaṇā raṇe,
hatāḥ sahasraśo rājan yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥52॥
8.5.53: mahendreṇa yathā vr̥tro yathā rāmeṇa rāvaṇaḥ ॥53॥
8.5.55: raṇe kr̥tvā mahad yuddhaṁ ghoraṁ trailokyamohanam ॥55॥
8.5.56: yathā skandena mahiṣo yathā rudreṇa cāndhakaḥ,
8.5.57: jayāśā dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṁ vairasya ca mukhaṁ yataḥ ॥57॥
8.5.58: tīrṇastat pāṇḍavo rājan yat purā nāvabudhyase,
8.6.4: samaḥ kirīṭinā saṅkhye vīryeṇa ca balena ca,
8.6.7: yo bāla eva samare sammitaḥ savyasācinā,
keśavena ca durdharṣo baladevena vā vibho ॥7॥
8.6.9: kr̥taṁ taṁ virathaṁ vīraṁ kṣatradharme vyavasthitam ॥9॥
8.6.10: sapatnānāṁ nihantā ca mahatyā senayā vr̥taḥ ॥10॥
8.6.19: kaikeyena ca vikramya bhrātrā bhrātā nipātitaḥ,
8.6.21: droṇena yugapad rājan divaṁ samprāpitau śaraiḥ,
8.6.25: mitravarmā ca pāñcālyaḥ kṣatradharmā ca bhārata ॥25॥
8.6.33: nihatya śātravān saṅkhye droṇena nihato yudhi ॥33॥
8.6.39: ete cānye ca bahavaḥ pāṇḍavānāṁ mahārathāḥ,
hatā droṇena vikramya yanmāṁ tvaṁ paripr̥cchasi ॥39॥
8.7.1: avaśeṣaṁ na paśyāmi kakude mr̥dite sati ॥1॥
8.7.2: tau hi vīrau maheṣvāsau madarthe kurusattamau,
bhīṣmadroṇau hatau śrutvā nārtho vai jīvite’sati ॥2॥
8.7.3: yasya bāhvorbalaṁ tulyaṁ kuñjarāṇāṁ śataṁ śatam ॥3॥
8.7.4: ahatānapi me śaṁsa ye’tra jīvanti kecana ॥4॥
8.7.5: eteṣu hi mr̥teṣvadya ye tvayā parikīrtitāḥ,
ye’pi jīvanti te sarve mr̥tā iti matirmama ॥5॥
8.7.27: mano muhyati cāṅgāni na ca śaknomi dhāritum ॥27॥
8.7.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate karṇaparvaṇi sañjayavākyaṁ nāma saptamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥7॥
8.8.1: śrutvā karṇaṁ hataṁ yuddhe putrāṁścaiva nipātitān,
8.8.11: vr̥ṣabho vr̥ṣabhasyeva yo yuddhe na nivartate,
8.8.14: sa kathaṁ rathināṁ śreṣṭhaḥ karṇaḥ pārthena saṁyuge,
8.8.15: yo nāmanyata vai nityamacyutaṁ ca dhanañjayam,
8.8.23: vr̥ṣo mahendro deveṣu vr̥ṣaḥ karṇo nareṣvapi ॥23॥
8.8.25: varo mahendro devānāṁ karṇaḥ praharatāṁ varaḥ,
8.8.26: yaṁ labdhvā māgadho rājā sāntvamāno’tha sauhr̥daiḥ ॥26॥
8.8.27: taṁ śrutvā nihataṁ karṇaṁ dvairathe savyasācinā ॥27॥
8.8.28: taṁ vr̥ṣaṁ nihataṁ śrutvā dvairathe rathināṁ varam ॥28॥
8.8.30: vajrād dr̥ḍhataraṁ manye hr̥dayaṁ mama durbhidam,
8.8.31: ko madanyaḥ pumām̐lloke na jahyāt sūta jīvitam,
na hi śakṣyāmi duḥkhāni soḍhuṁ kaṣṭāni sañjaya ॥31॥
8.9.1: śriyā kulena yaśasā tapasā ca śrutena ca,
8.9.5: sa kathaṁ nihataḥ śete vāyurugṇa iva drumaḥ ॥5॥
8.9.6: cintā me vardhate’tīva mumūrṣā cāpi jāyate ॥6॥
8.9.7: karṇasya nidhanaṁ śrutvā vijayaṁ phālgunasya ca,
8.9.8: yacchrutvā puruṣavyāghraṁ hataṁ karṇaṁ na dīryate ॥8॥
8.9.9: āyurnūnaṁ sudīrghaṁ me vihitaṁ daivataiḥ purā,
yatra karṇaṁ hataṁ śrutvā jīvāmīha suduḥkhitaḥ ॥9॥
8.9.10: adya cāhaṁ daśāmetāṁ gataḥ sañjaya garhitām ॥10॥
8.9.12: paribhūtaḥ kathaṁ sūta paraiḥ śakṣyāmi jīvitum,
8.9.14: sa hi pāro mahānāsīt putrāṇāṁ mama sañjaya,
yuddhe hi nihataḥ śūro visr̥jan sāyakān bahūn ॥14॥
8.9.16: sa śete pr̥thivīṁ nūnaṁ śobhayan rudhirokṣitaḥ ॥16॥
8.9.17: yo balaṁ dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ yato bhayam ॥17॥
8.9.20: anyathā cintitaṁ kāryamanyathā tat tu jāyate ॥20॥
8.9.21: aho nu balavad daivaṁ kālaśca duratikramaḥ,
8.9.22: kaccid vinihataḥ sūta putro duḥśāsano mama,
8.9.25: jalasya dhārāṁ janitāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pāṇḍusutena ca ॥25॥
8.9.27: akurvan vacanaṁ tasya nūnaṁ śocati putrakaḥ ॥27॥
8.9.29: yathā hi śakuniṁ gr̥hya chittvā pakṣau ca sañjaya ॥29॥
8.9.31: kāṁ diśaṁ pratipatsyāmi dīnaḥ śatruvaśaṁ gataḥ ॥31॥
8.9.34: sa jitaḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ śūraiḥ samare bāhuśālibhiḥ ॥34॥
8.9.35: tasmin hate maheṣvāse karṇe yudhi kirīṭinā,
8.9.36: uktaṁ tvayā purā tāta yathā vīro nipātitaḥ ॥36॥
8.9.40: bhīṣmadroṇau hi samare na hanyād vajrabhr̥t svayam ॥40॥
8.9.41: nyāyena yudhyamānau hi tad vai satyaṁ bravīmi te,
karṇaṁ tvasyantamastrāṇi divyāni ca bahūni ca ॥41॥
8.9.49: etāṁśca divasān yasya yuddhe bhīto dhanañjayaḥ ॥49॥
8.9.50: nāgamad dvairathaṁ vīraḥ sa kathaṁ nihato raṇe,
8.9.51: etān hatvā haniṣyāmi paścād vaikartanaṁ raṇe,
iti vyapadiśan pārtho varjayan sūtajaṁ raṇe ॥51॥
8.9.52: sa kathaṁ nihato vīraḥ pārthena paravīrahā,
rathabhaṅgo na cet tasya dhanurvā na vyaśīryata ॥52॥
8.9.53: na cedastrāṇi nirṇeśuḥ sa kathaṁ nihataḥ pareḥ,
ko hi śakto raṇe karṇaṁ vidhunvānaṁ mahad dhanuḥ ॥53॥
8.9.55: dhruvaṁ tasya dhanuśchinnaṁ ratho vāpi mahīṁ gataḥ,
astrāṇi vā praṇaṣṭāni yathā śaṁsasi me hatam ॥55॥
8.9.56: na hyanyadapi paśyāmi kāraṇaṁ tasya nāśane,
na hanmi phālgunaṁ yāvat tāvat pādau na dhāvaye ॥56॥
8.9.57: yasya bhīto raṇe nidrāṁ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥57॥
8.9.59: mama putraḥ sabhāṁ bhāryāṁ pāṇḍūnāṁ nītavān balāt,
tatrāpi ca sabhāmadhye pāṇḍavānāṁ ca paśyatām ॥59॥
8.9.60: na santi patayaḥ kr̥ṣṇe sarve ṣaṇḍhatilaiḥ samāḥ ॥60॥
8.9.61: ityevaṁ yaḥ purā vāco rūkṣāścāśrāvayad ruṣā ॥61॥
8.9.62: sabhāyāṁ sūtajaḥ kr̥ṣṇāṁ sa kathaṁ nihataḥ paraiḥ,
yadi bhīṣmo raṇaślāghī droṇo vā yudhi durmadaḥ ॥62॥
8.9.63: sarvāneva haniṣyāmi vyetu te mānaso jvaraḥ ॥63॥
8.9.66: yasya nāsīd bhayaṁ pārthaiḥ saputraiḥ sajanārdanaiḥ ॥66॥
8.9.67: tasya nāhaṁ vadhaṁ manye devairapi savāsavaiḥ ॥67॥
8.9.68: na hi jyāṁ saṁspr̥śānasya talatre vāpi gr̥hṇataḥ ॥68॥
8.9.70: yena mandaḥ sahāyena bhrātrā duḥśāsanena ca ॥70॥
8.9.71: sa nūnaṁ vr̥ṣabhaskandhaṁ karṇaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nipātitam ॥71॥
8.9.72: duḥśāsanaṁ ca nihataṁ manye śocati putrakaḥ,
8.9.73: durmarṣaṇaṁ hataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vr̥ṣasenaṁ ca saṁyuge ॥73॥
8.9.74: prabhagnaṁ ca balaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vadhyamānaṁ mahārathaiḥ,
8.9.75: vidrutān rathino dr̥ṣṭvā manye śocati putrakaḥ,
8.9.76: svayaṁ vairaṁ mahat kr̥tvā vāryamāṇaḥ suhr̥dgaṇaiḥ ॥76॥
8.9.79: karṇo’rjunaṁ raṇe hantā hate tasmin kimabravīt,
dyūtaṁ kr̥tvā purā hr̥ṣṭho vañcayitvā ca pāṇḍavān ॥79॥
8.9.85: dr̥ṣṭvā vinihataṁ karṇaṁ sārathye rathināṁ varaḥ,
8.9.86: dr̥ṣṭvā vinihataṁ sarve yodhā vā raṇadurjayāḥ,
ye ca kecana rājānaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ yoddhumāgatāḥ,
8.9.87: droṇe tu nihate vīre rathavyāghre nararṣabhe,
8.9.88: madrarājaḥ kathaṁ śalyo niyukto rathināṁ varaḥ,
8.9.89: vāmaṁ cakraṁ rarakṣurvā ke vā vīrasya pr̥ṣṭhataḥ ॥89॥
8.9.90: ke karṇaṁ na jahuḥ śūrāḥ ke kṣudrāḥ prādravaṁstataḥ,
kathaṁ ca vaḥ sametānāṁ hataḥ karṇo mahārathaḥ ॥90॥
8.9.93: avaśeṣaṁ na paśyāmi kakude mr̥dite sati ॥93॥
8.9.94: tau hi vīrau maheṣvāsau madarthe tyaktajīvitau,
bhīṣmadroṇau hatau śrutvā ko nyartho jīvitena me ॥94॥
8.9.95: punaḥ punarna mr̥ṣyāmi hataṁ karṇaṁ ca pāṇḍavaiḥ,
yasya bāhvorbalaṁ tulyaṁ kuñjarāṇāṁ śataṁ śataiḥ ॥95॥
8.9.96: ḍhroṇe hate ca yad vr̥ttaṁ kauravāṇāṁ paraiḥ saha,
8.9.97: yathā ca dviṣatāṁ hantā raṇe śāntastaducyatām ॥97॥
8.10.4: yuddhvā ca suciraṁ kālaṁ pāṇḍavaiḥ saha bhārata ॥4॥
8.10.9: mataṁ matimatāṁ śreṣṭhāḥ sarve prabrūta mā ciram,
evaṁ gate tu kiṁ kāryaṁ kiṁ ca kāryataraṁ nr̥pāḥ ॥9॥
8.10.14: nītimantastathā yuktā dakṣā raktāśca te hatāḥ,
8.10.17: vaivasvata ivāsahyaḥ śakto jetuṁ raṇe ripūn ॥17॥
8.10.18: āśāṁ bahumatīṁ cakre karṇaṁ prati sa vai tadā ॥18॥
8.10.19: hate bhīṣme ca droṇe ca karṇo jeṣyati pāṇḍavān,
tāmāśāṁ hr̥daye kr̥tvā samāśvasya ca bhārata ॥19॥
8.10.20: tato duryodhanaḥ prītaḥ priyaṁ śrutvāsya tad vacaḥ,
8.10.22: karṇa jānāmi te vīryaṁ sauhr̥daṁ paramaṁ mayi,
tathāpi tvāṁ mahābāho pravakṣyāmi hitaṁ vacaḥ ॥22॥
8.10.23: śrutvā yatheṣṭaṁ ca kuru vīra yat tava rocate,
bhavān prājñatamo nityaṁ mama caiva parā gatiḥ ॥23॥
8.10.25: vr̥ddhau ca tau maheṣvāsau sāpekṣau ca dhanañjaye,
mānitau ca mayā vīrau rādheya vacanāt tava ॥25॥
8.10.27: nyastaśastre ca bhavati hato bhīṣmaḥ pitāmahaḥ,
8.10.29: tenāpi rakṣitāḥ pārthāḥ śiṣyatvāditi me matiḥ,
sa cāpi nihato vr̥ddho dhr̥ṣṭadyumnena satvaram ॥29॥
8.10.30: tvatsamaṁ samare yodhaṁ nānyaṁ paśyāmi cintayan ॥30॥
8.10.31: bhavāneva tu naḥ śakto vijayāya na saṁśayaḥ,
pūrvaṁ madhye ca paścācca tathaiva vihitaṁ hitam ॥31॥
8.10.33: tathā bhavānimāṁ senāṁ dhārtarāṣṭrīṁ bibhartu vai ॥33॥
8.10.35: draviṣyanti ca pañcālā viṣṇuṁ dr̥ṣṭveva dānavāḥ,
8.10.37: yathā hyabhyuditaḥ sūryaḥ pratapan svena tejasā,
8.10.38: āśā balavatī rājan putrasya tava yābhavat,
hate bhīṣme ca droṇe ca karṇo jeṣyati pāṇḍavān ॥38॥
8.10.39: sūtaputra na te pārthaḥ sthitvāgre saṁyuyutsati ॥39॥
8.10.41: sthiro bhava mahārāja jitān viddhi ca pāṇḍavān ॥41॥
8.10.50: jahi pārthān sapāñcālān rādheya vijayāya naḥ,
8.10.51: na hyalaṁ tvadvisr̥ṣṭānāṁ śarāṇāṁ vai sakeśavāḥ,
8.10.52: na hi pārthāḥ sapāñcālāḥ sthātuṁ śaktāstavāgrataḥ,
8.10.56: tava putrairvr̥taḥ karṇaḥ śuśubhe tatra bhārata,
8.11.1: tathoktaśca svayaṁ rājñā snigdhaṁ bhrātr̥samaṁ vacaḥ ॥1॥
8.11.5: saṁnahyatāṁ narāṇāṁ ca vājināṁ ca viśāmpate ॥5॥
8.11.11: dr̥ṣṭvā karṇaṁ maheṣvāsaṁ rathasthaṁ rathināṁ varam,
8.11.15: makarasya tu tuṇḍe vai karṇo rājan vyavasthitaḥ,
8.11.16: madhye duryodhano rājā balena mahatā vr̥taḥ ॥16॥
8.11.18: pāde tu dakṣiṇe rājan gautamaḥ satyavikramaḥ,
8.11.19: anupāde tu yo vāmastatra śalyo vyavasthitaḥ,
8.11.20: vr̥to rathasahasreṇa dantināṁ ca tribhiḥ śataiḥ ॥20॥
8.11.21: pucche hyāstāṁ mahāvīryau bhrātarau pārthivau tadā,
8.11.23: paśya pārtha yathā senā dhārtarāṣṭrīha saṁyuge,
8.11.27: evaṁ jñātvā mahābāho vyūhaṁ vyūha yathecchasi ॥27॥
8.11.30: madhye vyūhasya rājā tu pāṇḍavaśca dhanañjayaḥ,
8.11.32: śeṣā nr̥patayo vīrāḥ sthitā vyūhasya daṁśitāḥ,
8.11.34: dr̥ṣṭvā vyūḍhāṁ tava camūṁ sūtaputreṇa saṁyuge,
8.11.35: tathaiva pāṇḍavīṁ senāṁ vyūḍhāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
dhārtarāṣṭrān hatān mene sakarṇān vai janādhipaḥ ॥35॥
8.11.39: dr̥ṣṭvā karṇaṁ maheṣvāsaṁ mukhe vyūhasya daṁśitam ॥39॥
8.11.42: nr̥tyamāne ca te sene sameyātāṁ parasparam,
8.12.13: tathā tasmin bale śūrairvadhyamāne hate’pi ca,
8.12.29: tau janaṁ harṣayantau ca siṁhanādaṁ pracakratuḥ ॥29॥
8.12.41: tataḥ kruddho raṇe bhīmaṁ kṣemadhūrtiḥ parābhinat,
8.12.45: taṁ hataṁ nr̥patiṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kulūtānāṁ yaśaskaram,
8.13.3: karṇo’pi rājan samare vyahanat pāṇḍavīṁ camūm,
8.13.4: neduḥ seduśca mamluśca babhramuśca diśo daśa ॥4॥
8.13.17: athānye dhanuṣī citre pragr̥hya ca mahāśarān,
8.13.20: dhanuranyat samādāya sajyaṁ kr̥tvā ca saṁyuge ॥20॥
8.13.23: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nihataṁ śūraṁ bhrātā tasya mahārathaḥ,
8.13.24: sa ṣaṣṭyā sātyakiṁ viddhvā svarṇapuṅkhai śilāśitaiḥ,
8.13.26: rarāja samare rājan sapuṣpa iva kiṁśuka ॥26॥
8.13.28: hatvā ca sārathī tūrṇaṁ hayāṁśca rathināṁ varau ॥28॥
8.13.35: savarmā kekayo rājan dvidhā chinno mahāraṇe ॥35॥
8.13.36: taṁ nihatya raṇe śūraḥ śaineyo rathasattamaḥ ॥36॥
8.13.37: kekayānāṁ mahat sainyaṁ vyadhamat sātyakiḥ śaraiḥ ॥37॥
8.13.38: tamutsr̥jya raṇe śatruṁ pradudrāva diśo daśa ॥38॥
8.14.6: dhanuściccheda bhallena taṁ ca vivyādha saptabhiḥ ॥6॥
8.14.11: rarāja samare vīraḥ sapuṣpa iva kiṁśukaḥ ॥11॥
8.14.13: chādayan samare rājan vivyādha ca supatribhiḥ ॥13॥
8.14.16: rājānaṁ nihataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā te’bhisāraṁ tu māriṣa,
8.14.18: te vadhyamānāḥ samare tava pautreṇa dhanvinā,
8.14.25: sā papāta dvidhā chinnā prativindhyaśaraiḥ śitaiḥ,
8.14.26: śaktiṁ tāṁ prahatāṁ dr̥ṣṭvā citro gr̥hya mahāgadām,
8.14.27: sā jaghāna hayāṁstasya sārathiṁ ca mahāraṇe,
8.14.32: sa tasya gātrāvaraṇaṁ bhittvā hr̥dayameva ca,
8.14.33: sa papāta tadā rājā tomareṇa samāhataḥ,
8.14.39: tataḥ samāgamo ghoro babhūva sahasā tayoḥ,
8.15.1: bhīmasenaṁ tato drauṇī rājan vivyādha patriṇā,
8.15.5: śaraiḥ śarāṁstato drauṇiḥ saṁvārya yudhi pāṇḍavam,
8.15.6: yathā śr̥ṅgaṁ vane dr̥ptaḥ khaḍgo dhārayate nr̥pa ॥6॥
8.15.7: tato drauṇiṁ raṇe bhīmo yatamānaṁ parākramī,
8.15.10: tathaiva pāṇḍavo yuddhe drauṇiṁ śaraśataiḥ śitaiḥ,
8.15.13: tataḥ pratikr̥te yatnaṁ kurvāṇau tau mahāraṇe,
8.15.24: te bāṇāḥ samasajjanta muktāstābhyāṁ tu bhārata ॥24॥
8.15.30: aho bhīmabalo bhīma etasya ca kr̥tāstratā ॥30॥
8.15.32: rudrau dvāviva sambhūtau yathā dvāviva bhāskarau,
8.15.33: iti vācaḥ sma śrūyante siddhānāṁ vai muhurmuhuḥ,
8.15.34: adbhutaṁ cāpyacintyaṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvā karma tayo raṇe,
8.15.35: sādhu drauṇe mahābāho sādhu bhīmeti cābruvan ॥35॥
8.15.39: tāvanyonyaṁ dhvajaṁ viddhvā sārathiṁ ca mahāraṇe,
8.15.40: tataḥ kruddhau mahārāja bāṇau gr̥hya mahāhave,
8.16.1: anyeṣāṁ ca mahīpānāṁ pāṇḍavaistad bravīhi me ॥1॥
8.16.2: anyeṣāṁ ca mahīpānāṁ pāṇḍavaistad bravīhi me ॥2॥
8.16.3: śr̥ṇu rājan yathā vr̥ttaṁ saṅgrāmaṁ bruvato mama,
8.16.23: tataḥ sarvātmanā tvadya yuddhātithyaṁ prayaccha me,
8.16.24: saṁśaptakāśca me vadhyā drauṇirāhvayate ca mām ॥24॥
8.16.25: yadatrānantaraṁ prāptaṁ śaṁsa me taddhi mādhava,
8.16.27: aśvatthāman sthiro bhūtvā praharāśu sahasva ca ॥27॥
8.16.28: sūkṣmo vivādo viprāṇāṁ sthūlau kṣātrau jayājayau ॥28॥
8.16.36d5: na mayā tādr̥śo rājan dr̥ṣṭapūrvaḥ parākramaḥ,
sañjajñe yādr̥śo drauṇeḥ kr̥ṣṇau chādayato raṇe.
8.16.36d6: drauṇestu dhanuṣaḥ śabdaṁ rathānāṁ trāsanaṁ raṇe,
aśrauṣaṁ bahuśo rājan siṁhasya nadato yathā.
8.16.36d7: jyā cāsya carato yuddhe savyaṁ dakṣiṇamasyataḥ,
8.16.36d8: sa tadā kṣiprakārī ca dr̥ḍhahastaśca pāṇḍavaḥ,
8.16.36d9: vikramaṁ ca hr̥taṁ mene ātmanastena saṁyuge,
8.16.36d11: hīyamāne ca kaunteye kr̥ṣṇaṁ roṣaḥ samāviśat,
8.16.36d12: drauṇiṁ dadarśa saṅgrāme phālgunaṁ ca muhurmuhuḥ,
tataḥ kruddho’bravīt kr̥ṣṇaḥ pārthaṁ sapraṇayaṁ vacaḥ.
8.16.36d14: kaccitte gāṇḍivaṁ haste muṣṭirvā na vyaśīryata,
kaccid vīryaṁ yathāpūrvaṁ bhujayorvā balaṁ tava.
8.16.36d15: upekṣāṁ mā kr̥thāḥ pārtha nāyaṁ kālo hyupekṣitum.
8.16.37: paśya mādhava daurātmyaṁ guruputrasya māṁ prati ॥37॥
8.16.38: vadhaṁ prāptau manyate nau prāveśya śaraveśmani,
eṣo’smi hanmi saṅkalpaṁ śikṣayā ca balena ca ॥38॥
8.16.41: ye ye dadr̥śire tatra yadyadrūpāstadā janāḥ,
8.16.42: krośe sāgre sthitān ghnanti dvipāṁśca puruṣān raṇe ॥42॥
8.16.44: paścāttu śailavat petuste gajāḥ saha sādibhiḥ,
8.17.24: niyamya sa hayān drauṇiḥ samāśvāsya ca māriṣa,
8.18.21: tathā kr̥tāste ca yathaiva tau dvipau
8.19.3: pāṇīn pāṇigataṁ śastraṁ bāhūnapi śirāṁsi ca ॥3॥
8.19.17: sarathāḥ sadhvajā vīrā hatāḥ pārthena śerate ॥17॥
8.19.25: vimuñcan vā śarān śīghraṁ dr̥śyante vai narā hatāḥ ॥25॥
8.19.53: divi vā devarājasya tvayā yat kr̥tamāhave,
evaṁ tāṁ darśayan kr̥ṣṇo yuddhabhūmiṁ kirīṭine ॥53॥
8.20.1: na tvasya karma saṅgrāme tvayā sañjaya kīrtitam ॥1॥
8.20.2: śikṣāṁ prabhāvaṁ vīryaṁ ca pramāṇaṁ darpameva ca ॥2॥
8.20.3: samāptavidyān dhanuṣi śreṣṭhān yān manyase rathān ॥3॥
8.20.4: na mene cātmanā tulyaṁ kañcideva nareśvaram ॥4॥
8.20.18: mahatā rathaghoṣeṇa divaṁ bhūmiṁ ca nādayan,
varṣānte sasyahā megho bhāsi hrādīva pārthiva ॥18॥
8.20.25: prekṣya cāśu rathe yuktān narairanyān hayottamān ॥25॥
8.20.29: prāsyad droṇasuto bāṇān vr̥ṣṭiṁ pūṣānujo yathā ॥29॥
8.20.31: ye ye dadr̥śire tatra visañjñāḥ prāyaśo’bhavan ॥31॥
8.20.32: parjanya iva gharmānte vr̥ṣṭyā sādridrumāṁ mahīm,
8.20.37: drāvayāmāsa sa tadā pāṇḍavānāṁ mahad balam ॥37॥
8.20.46: rnr̥pasya bāhū ca śiro’tha ca tribhiḥ,
8.21.2: samāptavidyo balavān yukto vīraḥ sa pāṇḍavaḥ,
8.21.7: etacchrutvā ca dr̥ṣṭvā ca bhrāturghoraṁ mahadbhayam,
8.21.12: gadāḥ prāsāñchitān kuntān bhindipālān mahāṅ kuśān,
8.21.15: pādātānāṁ ca patatāṁ nr̥ṇāṁ nādo mahānabhūt ॥15॥
8.21.16: śrutvā tatra bhr̥śaṁ tresuḥ peturmamluśca sainikāḥ ॥16॥
8.21.17: teṣāṁ ninadatāṁ caiva śastravarṣaṁ ca muñcatām,
8.21.18: pañca pāñcālavīrāṇāṁ rathān daśa ca pañca ca,
8.21.23: maurvyā talatre nyahanat kaśayā vājino yathā ॥23॥
8.21.26: priyānasūn raṇe tyaktvā yodhā jaghnuḥ parasparam ॥26॥
8.21.35: dhvajāḥ śirāṁsi cchatrāṇi dvipahastā nr̥ṇāṁ bhujāḥ,
8.21.39: mr̥ditānīva padmāni pramlānā iva ca srajaḥ ॥39॥
8.22.10: te mlecchaiḥ preṣitā nāgā narānaśvān rathānapi,
8.22.12: pramukhe vartamānaṁ tu dvipaṁ vaṅgasya sātyakiḥ,
8.22.18: sa papāta hato mlecchastenaiva saha dantinā ॥18॥
8.22.24: nāgānāṁ prāsphuṭan kumbhā marmāṇi vividhāni ca,
8.22.30: tāṁ te senāṁ samāloḍya pāṇḍuputrasya sainikāḥ,
8.23.1: sahadevaṁ tathā kruddhaṁ dahantaṁ tava vāhinīm,
8.23.2: tau sametau mahāyuddhe dr̥ṣṭvā tatra mahārathāḥ,
8.23.3: tato bhārata kruddhena tava putreṇa dhanvinā,
8.23.4: viddhvā vivyādha saptatyā sārathiṁ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥4॥
8.23.6: āvidhya prāsr̥jat tūrṇaṁ tava putrarathaṁ prati ॥6॥
8.23.7: nipapāta tato bhūmau cyutaḥ sarpa ivāmbarāt ॥7॥
8.23.13: tān śarān samare rājan vegenāpatato bahūn,
8.23.15: tān bāṇāṁstava putro’pi chittvaikaikaṁ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.23.16: tato duḥśāsano rājan viddhvā pāṇḍusutaṁ raṇe,
8.23.18: sa taṁ nirbhidya vegena bhittvā ca kavacaṁ mahat ॥18॥
8.23.20: apovāha bhr̥śaṁ trasto vadhyamānaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥20॥
8.23.21: parājitya raṇe taṁ tu kauravyaṁ pāṇḍunandanaḥ,
8.23.22: tathā sā kauravī senā mr̥ditā tena bhārata ॥22॥
8.24.1: karṇo vaikartano rājan vārayāmāsa vai ruṣā ॥1॥
8.24.3: paśya māṁ tvaṁ raṇe pāpa cakṣurviṣayamāgatam,
tvaṁ hi mūlamanarthānāṁ vairasya kalahasya ca ॥3॥
8.24.6: praharasva ca me vīra paśyāmastava pauruṣam,
karma kr̥tvā raṇe śūra tataḥ katthitumarhasi ॥6॥
8.24.7: anuktvā samare tāta śūrā yudhyanti śaktitaḥ,
prayudhyasva mayā śaktyā haniṣye darpameva te ॥7॥
8.24.11: te tasya kavacaṁ bhittvā papuḥ śoṇitamāhave,
āśīviṣā yathā nāgā bhittvā gāṁ salilaṁ papuḥ ॥11॥
8.24.12: karṇaṁ vivyādha saptatyā sārathiṁ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥12॥
8.24.15: vismayaṁ paramaṁ jagmū rathinaḥ saha daivataiḥ ॥15॥
8.24.21: tato bāṇamayaṁ jālaṁ vitataṁ vyomni dr̥śyate,
8.24.25: niruddhe tatra mārge ca śarasaṅghaiḥ samantataḥ,
8.24.28: te sene hanyamāne tu tābhyāṁ divyairmahāśaraiḥ,
8.24.34: tataḥ kruddho raṇe karṇaḥ kr̥tvā ghorataraṁ vapuḥ,
8.24.35: na cakāra vyathāṁ rājan bhāskaro jaladairyathā ॥35॥
8.24.40: athāsya taṁ rathaṁ divyaṁ tilaśo vyadhamaccharaiḥ,
patākāṁ cakrarakṣāṁśca gadāṁ khaḍgaṁ ca māriṣa ॥40॥
8.24.44: ārpayad bahubhiḥ karṇo na cainaṁ samapīḍayat,
8.24.45: tamabhidrutya rādheyaḥ prahasan vai punaḥ punaḥ ॥45॥
8.24.49: mā yotsīḥ kurubhiḥ sārdhaṁ balavadbhiśca pāṇḍava,
sadr̥śaistāta yudhyasva vrīḍāṁ mā kuru pāṇḍava ॥49॥
8.24.50: gr̥haṁ vā gaccha mādreya yatra vā kr̥ṣṇaphālgunau,
8.24.51: vadhaprāptaṁ tu taṁ śūro nāhanad dharmavittadā,
smr̥tvā kuntyā vaco rājaṁstata enaṁ vyasarjayat ॥51॥
8.24.56: madhyaṁ prāpte dinakare cakravad vicaran prabhuḥ ॥56॥
8.24.77: tān prabhagnān drutān vīraḥ pr̥ṣṭhato vikirañcharaiḥ ॥77॥
8.25.1: yuyutsuṁ tava putrasya drāvayantaṁ balaṁ mahat,
8.25.5: śākuniṁ tu tataḥ ṣaṣṭyā vivyādha bharatarṣabha,
8.25.6: athāsya samare kruddho dhvajaṁ ciccheda kāñcanam ॥6॥
8.25.11: jaghāna caturo’śvāṁśca taṁ ca vivyādha pañcabhiḥ,
8.25.14: hatāśve tu rathe tiṣṭhan śatānīko mahārathaḥ,
8.25.15: sā kr̥tvā syandanaṁ bhasma hayāṁścaiva sasārathīn,
8.25.18: sutasomaṁ tu śakunirviddhvā tu niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.25.21: nivārya samare cāpi śarāṁstān niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.25.24: chādayāmāsa samare tava syālasya taṁ ratham ॥24॥
8.25.35: ciccheda tāṁstu khaḍgena śikṣayā ca balena ca,
8.25.37: sa cchinnaḥ sahasā bhūmau nipapāta mahānasiḥ,
8.25.39: tacchittvā saguṇaṁ cāpaṁ raṇe tasya mahātmanaḥ,
8.25.43: yathā daityacamūṁ rājan devarājo mamarda ha,
8.26.1: yathā dr̥ṣṭvā vane siṁhaṁ śarabho vārayed yudhi ॥1॥
8.26.3: vitresuḥ sarvabhūtāni kṣayaṁ prāptaṁ ca menire ॥3॥
8.26.6: apīyaṁ vāhinī kr̥tsnā mucyeta mahato bhayāt,
apyayaṁ brāhmaṇaḥ sarvān na no hanyāt samāgatān ॥6॥
8.26.8: ācāryaḥ kṣiprahastaśca vijayī ca sadā yudhi,
8.26.10: viniḥśvasya tataḥ krodhāt kr̥paḥ śāradvato nr̥pa ॥10॥
8.26.12: kartavyaṁ na sma jānāti mohena mahatā’’vr̥taḥ,
tamabravīttato yantā kaccit kṣemaṁ tu pārṣata ॥12॥
8.26.13: īdr̥śaṁ vyasanaṁ yuddhe na te dr̥ṣṭaṁ mayā kvacit,
8.26.15: avadhyaṁ brāhmaṇaṁ manye yena te vikramo hataḥ,
8.26.17: arjunaṁ bhīmasenaṁ vā samare prāpya sārathe ॥17॥
8.26.19: yato bhīmo maheṣvāso yuyudhe tava sainikaiḥ,
pradrutaṁ ca rathaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā dhr̥ṣṭadyumnasya māriṣa ॥19॥
8.26.23: kr̥tavarmā tu saṅkruddho bhittvā ṣaṣṭyā patatribhiḥ ॥23॥
8.26.33: anyonyasya vadhe yatnaṁ kurvāṇau tau mahārathau ॥33॥
8.26.35: tato’sya samare bāṇaṁ bhojaḥ praharatāṁ varaḥ ॥35॥
8.27.6: agacchan vilayaṁ sarve tārkṣyaṁ dr̥ṣṭve pannagāḥ ॥6॥
8.27.7: te hanyamānāḥ samare nājahuḥ pāṇḍavaṁ raṇe,
8.27.10: sa viddho bahubhiḥ saṅkhye prativivyādha tān nr̥pān,
8.27.12: śrutañjayaṁ ca rājānaṁ hatvā tatra śilāśitaiḥ ॥12॥
8.27.15: samuddiśya raṇe kr̥ṣṇaṁ siṁhanādaṁ nanāda ca ॥15॥
8.27.16: sa nirbhidya bhujaṁ savyaṁ mādhavasya mahātmanaḥ,
8.27.20: pratodaṁ gr̥hya so’nyattu raśmīnapi yathā purā,
8.27.21: viṣvaksenaṁ tu nirbhinnaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā pārtho dhanañjayaḥ,
8.27.33: chatrāṇāṁ vyajanānāṁ ca śirasāṁ mukuṭaiḥ saha ॥33॥
8.27.41: vadhyamānaṁ tu tat sainyaṁ pāṇḍuputreṇa dhanvinā ॥41॥
8.28.2: dharmarājo drutaṁ viddhvā tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt ॥2॥
8.28.3: sa tu taṁ prativivyādha navabhirniśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.28.6: ṣaṣṭhena tu dhvajaṁ rājñaḥ saptamena tu kārmukam,
8.28.14: te śūrāḥ samare sarve citraṁ laghu ca suṣṭhu ca,
8.28.15: na hi te samaraṁ cakruḥ pr̥ṣṭhato vai kathañcana ॥15॥
8.28.17: rathī nāgaṁ samāsādya dārayan niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.28.18: nāgā hayān samāsādya vikṣipanto bahūn raṇe,
8.28.21: vidrāvya ca bahūnaśvān nāgā rājan madotkaṭāḥ,
8.28.26: tāṁstu tatra prasaktān vai parivārya padātayaḥ,
8.28.29: kṣuṇṇagātrā mahārāja vikṣipya ca punaḥ punaḥ,
8.28.34: rathān nāgāḥ samāsādya parigr̥hya ca māriṣa ॥34॥
8.28.37: udyamya ca bhujāvanyo nikṣipya ca mahītale ॥37॥
8.28.41: saṁsakteṣu ca yodheṣu vartamāne ca saṅkule ॥41॥
8.28.44: naiva sve na pare rājan vijñāyante śarāturāḥ ॥44॥
8.28.49: bhīmasenaḥ kurūn rājan hastyanīkaṁ ca sarvaśaḥ,
aparāhṇe gate sūrye kāṅkṣatāṁ vipulaṁ yaśaḥ ॥49॥
8.29.2: yathā tvaṁ me kathayase tathā yuddhamavartata,
na santi sūta kauravyā iti me niścitā matiḥ ॥2॥
8.29.3: dharmaputraḥ kathaṁ cakre tasya vā nr̥patiḥ katham ॥3॥
8.29.6: krodhena mahatā yuktaḥ saviṣo bhujago yathā,
8.29.6d2: śriyā jvalantaṁ kaunteyaṁ yathā vajradharaṁ yudhi,
8.29.7: provāca sūtaṁ tvarito yāhi yāhīti bhārata,
tatra māṁ prāpaya kṣipraṁ sārathe yatra pāṇḍavaḥ ॥7॥
8.29.9: tato yudhiṣṭhiraḥ kruddhaḥ prabhinna iva kuñjaraḥ ॥9॥
8.29.20: tato yudhiṣṭhiro rājā putraṁ tava śaraistribhiḥ ॥20॥
8.29.21: prativivyādha taṁ tūrṇaṁ tava putro mahīpatiḥ ॥21॥
8.29.22: tato duryodhano rājā śaktiṁ cikṣepa bhārata ॥22॥
8.29.24: tribhiściccheda sahasā taṁ ca vivyādha pañcabhiḥ,
8.29.27: samādhatta ca taṁ bāṇaṁ dhanurmadhye mahābalaḥ ॥27॥
8.29.28: cikṣepa ca mahārāja tataḥ kruddhaḥ parākramī,
sa tu bāṇaḥ samāsādya tava putraṁ mahāratham ॥28॥
8.29.29: vyāmohayata rājānaṁ dharaṇīṁ ca dadāra ha,
8.29.32: rathasthaḥ sa tayā viddho varma bhittvā stanāntare,
bhr̥śaṁ saṁvignahr̥dayaḥ papāta ca mumoha ca ॥32॥
8.29.33: nāyaṁ vadhyastava nr̥pa ityuktaḥ sa nyavartata ॥33॥
8.29.36: evaṁ tadabhavad yuddhaṁ tvadīyānāṁ paraiḥ saha,
8.30.19: tasyārjuno dhanuḥ sūtamaśvān ketuṁ ca sāyakaiḥ,
8.30.25: atha sātyakirāgatya karṇaṁ viddhvā śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.30.27: uttamaujā yuyutsuśca yamau pārṣata eva ca,
8.30.30: tāṁ śastravr̥ṣṭiṁ bahudhā karṇaśchittvā śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.30.33: diśaṁ khaṁ caiva bhūmiṁ ca prāvr̥ṇoccharavr̥ṣṭibhiḥ ॥33॥
8.30.38: tamasā ca mahārāja rajasā ca viśeṣataḥ,
na kiñcit pratyapaśyāma śubhaṁ vā yadi vāśubham ॥38॥
8.30.40: jayaṁ sumanasaḥ prāpya pārthāḥ svaśibiraṁ yayuḥ ॥40॥
8.30.42: kr̥te’vahāre tairvīraiḥ sainikāḥ sarva eva te,
8.30.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate karṇaparvaṇi prathame yuddhadivase triṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥30॥
8.31.2: ekaścemāṁ mahīṁ jitvā cakre balibhūto nr̥pān ॥2॥
8.31.5: na te nindyāḥ praśasyāste yatte cakrurbravīhi tat,
tato duryodhanaḥ sūta paścāt kimakarot tadā ॥5॥
8.31.8: tānabravīt tataḥ karṇaḥ kruddhaḥ sarpa iva śvasan,
8.31.10: śvastvahaṁ tasya saṅkalpaṁ sarvaṁ hantā mahīpate ॥10॥
8.31.11: te’nujñātā nr̥pāḥ sarve svāni veśmāni bhejire ॥11॥
8.31.17: kr̥te’vahāre sainyānāṁ pravr̥tte ca raṇe punaḥ ॥17॥
8.31.18: kathaṁ ca pāṇḍavāḥ sarve yuyudhustatra sūtajam ॥18॥
8.31.23: aho bata mahad duḥkhaṁ yatra pāṇḍusutān raṇe,
nātarad rabhasaḥ karṇo daivaṁ nūnaṁ parāyaṇam ॥23॥
8.31.24: aho dyūtasya niṣṭheyaṁ ghorā samprati vartate,
8.31.25: saubalaṁ ca tadā tāta nītimāniti manyate ॥25॥
8.31.26: karṇaśca rabhaso nityaṁ rājā taṁ cāpyanuvrataḥ,
8.31.29: atikāntaṁ hi yat kāryaṁ paścāccintayate naraḥ,
taccāsya na bhavet kāryaṁ cintayā ca vinaśyati ॥29॥
8.31.30: tadidaṁ tava kāryaṁ tu dūraprāptaṁ vijānatā,
na kr̥taṁ yat tvayā pūrvaṁ prāptāprāptavicāraṇam ॥30॥
8.31.31: ukto’si bahudhā rājan mā yudhyasveti pāpaḍavaiḥ,
gr̥hṇīṣe na ca tanmohād vacanaṁ ca viśāmpate ॥31॥
8.31.35: nihaniṣyāmi taṁ vīraṁ sa vā māṁ nihaniṣyati ॥35॥
8.31.36: nābhūt samāgamo rājan mama caivārjunasya ca ॥36॥
8.31.37: idaṁ tu me yathāprājñaṁ śr̥ṇu vākyaṁ viśāmpate,
8.31.39: āyudhānāṁ ca me vīryaṁ divyānāmarjunasya ca ॥39॥
8.31.40: sauṣṭhave cāstrapāte ca savyasācī na matsamaḥ ॥40॥
8.31.41: prāṇe śaurye’tha vijñāne vikrame cāpi bhārata,
8.31.43: yasya ghoṣeṇa daityānāṁ vyāmuhyanta diśo daśa ॥43॥
8.31.45: yathendraḥ samare sarvān daiteyān vai samāgatān ॥45॥
8.31.47: dhanuṣo hyasya karmāṇi divyāni prāha bhārgavaḥ,
tad rāmo hyadadānmahyaṁ tena yotsyāmi pāṇḍavam ॥47॥
8.31.51: na hi māṁ samare soḍhuṁ saṁśakto’gniṁ taruryathā,
avaśyaṁ tu mayā vācyaṁ yena hīno’smi phālgunāt ॥51॥
8.31.52: jyā tasya dhanuṣo divyā tathākṣayye maheṣudhī,
sārathistasya govindo mama tādr̥ṅ na vidyate ॥52॥
8.31.53: tasya divyaṁ dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṁ gāṇḍīvamajitaṁ yudhi,
8.31.58: ayaṁ tu sadr̥śaḥ śaureḥ śalyaḥ samitiśobhanaḥ,
sārathyaṁ yadi me kuryād dhruvaste vijayo bhavet ॥58॥
8.31.59: tasya me sārathiḥ śalyo bhavatvasukaraḥ paraiḥ,
8.31.64: tathā śalyasamo nāsti hayajñāne hi kaścana,
8.31.65: bhave yudhi jayeyaṁ ca phālgunaṁ kurusattama ॥65॥
8.31.66: samudyātuṁ na śakṣyanti devā api savāsavāḥ,
8.31.67: kriyatāmeṣa kāmo me mā vaḥ kālo’tyagādayam,
8.31.68: tato drakṣyasi saṅgrāme yat kariṣyāmi bhārata,
sarvathā pāṇḍavān saṅkhye vijeṣye vai samāgatān ॥68॥
8.31.69: na hi me samare śaktāḥ samudyātuṁ surasurāḥ,
8.31.71: evametat kariṣyāmi yathā tvaṁ karṇa manyase,
8.31.72: anuyāsyāma karṇa tvāṁ vayaṁ sarve ca pārthivāḥ ॥72॥
8.32.3: yathā nr̥patisiṁhānāṁ madhye tvāṁ varaye svayam ॥3॥
8.32.5: tasmāt pārthavināśārthaṁ hitārthaṁ mama caiva hi,
8.32.6: tvayi yantari rādheyo vidviṣo me vijeṣyate,
abhīṣūṇāṁ hi karṇasya grahītānyo na vidyate ॥6॥
8.32.7: r̥te hi tvāṁ mahābhāga vāsudevasamaṁ yudhi,
sa pāhi sarvathā karṇaṁ yathā brahmā maheśvarama ॥7॥
8.32.8: yathā ca sarvathā’’patsu vārṣṇeyaḥ pāti pāṇḍavam,
8.32.9: bhīṣmo droṇaḥ kr̥paḥ karṇobhavān bhojaśca vīryavān,
śakuniḥ saubalo drauṇirahameva ca no balam ॥9॥
8.32.10: na ca bhāgo’tra bhīṣmasya droṇasya ca mahātmanaḥ ॥10॥
8.32.11: tābhyāmatītya tau bhāgau nihatā mama śatravaḥ,
vr̥ddhau hi tau maheṣvāsau chalena nihatau yudhi ॥11॥
8.32.13: tyaktvā prāṇān yathāśakti ceṣṭāṁ kr̥tvā ca puṣkalām ॥13॥
8.32.15: balaṁ śeṣaṁ na hanyūrme yathā tat kuru pārthiva ॥15॥
8.32.20: tena yukto raṇe pārtho rakṣyamāṇaśca pārthiva,
yāni karmāṇi kurute pratyakṣāṇi tathaiva tat ॥20॥
8.32.21: idānīṁ vikramo hyasya kr̥ṣṇena sahitasya ca ॥21॥
8.32.23: taṁ bhāgaṁ saha karṇena yugapannāśayādya hi ॥23॥
8.32.24: aruṇena yathā sārdhaṁ tamaḥ sūryo vyapohati,
tathā karṇena sahito jahi pārthaṁ mahāhave ॥24॥
8.32.26: sūryāruṇau yathā dr̥ṣṭvā tamo naśyati māriṣa,
8.32.27: rathināṁ pravaraḥ karṇo yantr̥̄ṇāṁ pravaro bhavān,
8.32.28: tathā bhavān paritrātuṁ karṇaṁ vaikartanaṁ raṇe ॥28॥
8.32.29: kiṁ punaḥ pāṇḍaveyānāṁ mā viśaṅkīrvaco mama ॥29॥
8.32.30: viśikhāṁ bhrukuṭiṁ kr̥tvā dhunvan hastau punaḥ punaḥ ॥30॥
8.32.33: na cāhaṁ yudhi rādheyaṁ gaṇaye tulyamātmanaḥ ॥33॥
8.32.35: paśya vīryaṁ mamādya tvaṁ saṅgrāme dahato ripūn ॥35॥
8.32.36: na cāpi kāmān kauravya nidhāya hr̥daye pumān,
8.32.37: yudhi vāpyavamāno me na kartavyaḥ kathañcana,
paśya pīnau mama bhujau vajrasaṁhananau dr̥ḍhau ॥37॥
8.32.38: dhanuḥ paśya ca me citraṁ śarāṁścāśīviṣopamān,
rathaṁ paśya ca me klr̥ptaṁ sadaśvairvātavegitaiḥ ॥38॥
8.32.39: dārayeyaṁ mahīṁ kr̥tsnāṁ vikireyaṁ ca parvatān ॥39॥
8.32.42: na hi pāpīyasaḥ śreyān bhūtvā preṣyatvamutsahe,
yo hyabhyupagataṁ prītyā garīyāṁsaṁ vaśe sthitam ॥42॥
8.32.43: brahmaṇā brāhmaṇāḥ sr̥ṣṭā mukhāt kṣatraṁ ca bāhutaḥ ॥43॥
8.32.47: kr̥ṣiśca pāśupālyaṁ ca viśāṁ dānaṁ ca dharmataḥ,
8.32.48: na kṣatriyo vai sūtānāṁ śr̥ṇuyācca kathañcana ॥48॥
8.32.51: āpr̥cche tvādya gāndhāre gamiṣyāmi gr̥hāya vai ॥51॥
8.32.54: abhiprāyastu me kaścit taṁ nibodha janeśvara ॥54॥
8.32.55: na karṇo’bhyadhikastvatto na śaṅke tvāṁ ca pārthiva,
na hi madreśvaro rājā kuryād yadanr̥taṁ bhavet ॥55॥
8.32.57: tasmācchalyo hi te nāma kathyate pr̥thivītale ॥57॥
8.32.58: tadeva kuru dharmajña madarthaṁ yad yaducyate ॥58॥
8.32.59: na ca tvatto hi rādheyo na cāhamapi vīryavān,
8.32.60: manye cābhyadhikaṁ śalya guṇaiḥ karṇaṁ dhanañjayāt,
8.32.63: yanmāṁ bravīṣi gāndhāre madhye sainyasya kaurava,
8.32.64: yudhyataḥ pāṇḍavāgryeṇa yathā tvaṁ vīra manyase ॥64॥
8.32.65: samayaśca hi me vīra kaścid vaikartanaṁ prati,
8.32.66: tatheti rājan putraste saha karṇena bhārata,
8.33.1: bhūya eva tu madreśa yatte vakṣyāmi tacchr̥ṇu,
8.33.3: nibodha manasā cātra na te kāryā vicāraṇā,
8.33.4: nirjitāśca tadā daityā daivatairiti naḥ śrutam ॥4॥
8.33.6: tapa ugraṁ samāsthāya niyame parame sthitāḥ,
8.33.7: teṣāṁ pitāmahaḥ prīto varadaḥ pradadau baram ॥7॥
8.33.8: avadhyatvaṁ ca te rājan sarvabhūtasya sarvadā,
8.33.10: anyaṁ varaṁ vr̥ṇīdhvaṁ vai yādr̥śaṁ samprarocate,
8.33.11: asmabhyaṁ tvaṁ varaṁ deva samprayaccha pitāmaha ॥11॥
8.33.11d3: vadhyeta tripuraṁ deva prasanne tvayi sādaram.
8.33.15: evamastviti tān devaḥ pratyuktvā prāviśad divam,
te tu labdhavarāḥ prītāḥ sampradhārya parasparam ॥15॥
8.33.17: tato mayaḥ svatapasā cakre dhīmān purāṇi ca,
trīṇi kāñcanamekaṁ vai raupyaṁ kārṣṇāyasaṁ tathā ॥17॥
8.33.21: pureṣu cābhavan rājan rājāno vai pr̥thak pr̥thak,
8.33.26: yo hi yanmanasā kāmaṁ dadhyau tripurasaṁśrayaḥ ॥26॥
8.33.27: tasmai kāmaṁ mayastaṁ tai vidadhe māyayā tadā,
8.33.28: santuṣṭamavr̥ṇod devaṁ vāpī bhavatu naḥ pure ॥28॥
8.33.29: sa tu labdhvā varaṁ vīrastārakākṣasuto hariḥ ॥29॥
8.33.30: sasr̥je tatra vāpīṁ tāṁ mr̥tānāṁ jīvinīṁ prabho,
yena rūpeṇa daityastu yena veṣeṇa caiva ha ॥30॥
8.33.31: tāṁ prāpya te punastāṁstu lokān sarvān babādhire ॥31॥
8.33.32: na teṣāmabhavad rājan kṣayo yuddhe kadācana ॥32॥
8.33.34: vidrāvya sagaṇān devāṁstatra tatra tadā tadā,
8.33.36d1: niḥsthānāśca kr̥tā devā r̥ṣayaḥ pitr̥bhiḥ saha,
8.33.40: te tattvaṁ sarvamākhyāya śirobhiḥ sampraṇamya ca,
8.33.41: śrutvā tad bhagavān devo devānidamuvāca ha,
8.33.42: asurā hi durātmānaḥ sarva eva suradviṣaḥ,
8.33.43: ahaṁ hi tulyaḥ sarveṣāṁ bhūtānāṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ,
8.33.44: na ca sthāṇumr̥te śakto bhettumekeṣuṇā puraḥ ॥44॥
8.33.45: yoddhāraṁ vr̥ṇutādityāḥ sa tān hantā suretarān ॥45॥
8.33.46: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ,
8.33.47: r̥ṣibhiḥ saha dharmajñā bhavaṁ sarvātmanā gatāḥ ॥47॥
8.33.49: yaḥ sāṅkhyamātmano vetti yasya cātmā vaśe sadā ॥49॥
8.33.55: namo namo namaste’stu prabho ityabruvat vacaḥ,
8.33.58: arhāya caiva śuddhāya kṣayāya krathanāya ca,
8.33.61: gavāṁ ca pataye nityaṁ yajñānāṁ pataye namaḥ ॥61॥
8.33.63: provāca vyetu vastrāso brūta kiṁ karavāṇi vaḥ ॥63॥
8.34.1: satkr̥tya śaṅkaraṁ prāha brahmā lokahitaṁ vacaḥ ॥1॥
8.34.4: sa tvaṁ deva prapannānāṁ yācatāṁ ca divaukasām,
8.34.5: śaraṇyastvaṁ hi lokeśa te vayaṁ śaraṇaṁ gatāḥ ॥5॥
8.34.6: hantavyāḥ śatravaḥ sarve yuṣmākamiti me matiḥ,
na tveka utsahe hantuṁ balasthā hi suradviṣaḥ ॥6॥
8.34.7: jayadhvaṁ yudhi tāñśatrūn saṁhatā hi mahābalāḥ ॥7॥
8.34.8: teṣāmiti hi manyāmo dr̥ṣṭatejobalā hi te ॥8॥
8.34.10: bibhartuṁ bhavato’rdhaṁ tu na śakṣyāmo maheśvara,
sarveṣāṁ no balārdhena tvameva jahi śātravān ॥10॥
8.34.11: yadi śaktirna vaḥ kācid bibhartuṁ māmakaṁ balam,
8.34.13: sa tu devo balenāsīt sarvebhyo balavattaraḥ,
8.34.14: haniṣyāmi rathenājau tān ripūn vo divaukasaḥ ॥14॥
8.34.15: te yūyaṁ me rathaṁ caiva dhanurbāṇaṁ tathaiva ca,
8.34.18: viṣṇuṁ somaṁ hutāśaṁ ca tasyeṣuṁ samakalpayan,
8.34.25: anukarṣaṁ grahā dīptā varūthaṁ cāpi tārakāḥ ॥25॥
8.34.27: pakṣau pūrvāparau tatra kr̥te satryahanī śubhe ॥27॥
8.34.31: sandhyāṁ dhr̥tiṁ ca medhāṁ ca sthitiṁ saṁnatimeva ca,
8.34.36: saṁvatsaro dhanustad vai sāvitrī jyā mahāsvanā ॥36॥
8.34.37: divyaṁ ca varma vihitaṁ mahārhaṁ ratnabhūṣitam,
8.34.39: klr̥ptaṁ tu taṁ rathaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā vismitā devatā’bhavan ॥39॥
8.34.48: kālo hi bhagavān rudrastasya saṁvatsaro dhanuḥ,
8.34.49: agnīṣomau jagat kr̥tsnaṁ vaiṣṇavaṁ cocyate jagat ॥49॥
8.34.53: nityaṁ trātā ca hantā ca dharmādharmāśritān narān ॥53॥
8.34.56: dr̥ṣṭvā tu taṁ rathaṁ yuktaṁ kavacī sa śarāsanī,
8.34.61: sa śobhamāno varadaḥ khaḍgī bāṇī śarāsanī,
8.34.62: sa bhaviṣyati deveśa sārathiste na saṁśayaḥ ॥62॥
8.34.63: tānabravīt punardevo mattaḥ śreṣṭhataro hi yaḥ,
taṁ sārathiṁ kurudhvaṁ me svayaṁ sañcintya mā ciram ॥63॥
8.34.65: tathā ca kr̥tamasmābhiḥ prasanno no vr̥ṣadhvajaḥ ॥65॥
8.34.66: sārathiṁ ca na jānīmaḥ kaḥ syāt tasmin rathottame ॥66॥
8.34.67: saphalāṁ tāṁ giraṁ deva kartumarhasi no vibho ॥67॥
8.34.71: tatpratiṣṭho ratho deva hayā yoddhā tathaiva ca ॥71॥
8.34.72: tvāmr̥te sārathiṁ tatra nānyaṁ paśyāmahe vayam ॥72॥
8.34.73: sa rathaṁ tūrṇamāruhya saṁyaccha paramān hayān ॥73॥
8.34.73d1: tvaṁ deva śakto loke’smin niyantuṁ pradrutānimān,
8.34.73d2: yoddhuṁ balena sattvena vīryeṇa vinayena ca,
adhikaḥ sārathiḥ kāryo nāsti cāndo’dhiko bhavāt.
8.34.73d4: tvaṁ hi deveśa sarvaistu viśiṣṭo vadatāṁ vara,
8.34.74: iti te śirasā gatvā trilokeśaṁ pitāmaham ॥74॥
8.34.74d1: sa no rakṣa mahābāho daityebhyo mahato bhayāt.
8.34.74d2: tvaṁ hi no gatiravyagra tvaṁ no goptā mahāvrata,
tvatprasādāt surāḥ sarve pūjyante tridive prabho.
8.34.76: tataḥ sa bhagavān devo lokasraṣṭā pitāmahaḥ ॥76॥
8.34.79: abhīṣūn hi pratodaṁ ca sañjagrāha pitāmahaḥ,
8.34.82: sa śobhamāno varadaḥ khaḍgī bāṇī śarāsanī ॥82॥
8.34.83: pradīpayan rathe tasthau trīm̐llokān svena tejasā,
8.34.84: na hanyāditi kartavyo na śoko vaḥ kathañcana,
8.34.85: na ca tad vacanaṁ mithyā yadāha bhagavān prabhuḥ ॥85॥
8.34.86: iti sañcintya vai devāḥ parāṁ tuṣṭimavāpnuvan,
8.34.87: rathena mahatā rājannupamā nāsti yasya ha,
8.34.94: paśya bāhvorbalaṁ me’dya nighnataḥ śātravān raṇe ॥94॥
8.34.100: nimittāni ca ghorāṇi tatra sandadhataḥ śaram ॥100॥
8.34.103: sa sambhramāt tu bhagavān nādaṁ cakre mahābalaḥ ॥103॥
8.34.104: vr̥ṣabhasya sthito mūrdhni hayapr̥ṣṭhe ca mānada,
tadā sa bhagavān rudro niraikṣad dānavaṁ puram ॥104॥
8.34.106: tataḥprabhr̥ti bhadraṁ te gavāṁ dvaidhīkr̥tāḥ khurāḥ,
8.34.107: athādhijyaṁ dhanuḥ kr̥tvā śarvaḥ sandhāya taṁ śaram ॥107॥
8.34.112: sa tad vikr̥ṣya bhagavān divyaṁ lokeśvaro dhanuḥ ॥112॥
8.34.119: evaṁ sa bhagavān devo lokasraṣṭā maheśvaraḥ,
8.34.122: tvaṁ hi kr̥ṣṇācca karṇācca phālgunācca viśeṣataḥ,
8.34.123: yuddhe hyayaṁ rudrakalpastvaṁ ca brahmasamo naye,
8.34.124: pramathya hanyāt kaunteyaṁ tathā śīghraṁ vidhīyatām ॥124॥
8.34.125: tvayi madreśa rājyāśā jīvitāśā tathaiva ca,
8.34.126: tvayi karṇaśca rājyaṁ ca vayaṁ caiva pratiṣṭhitāḥ,
8.34.127: imaṁ cāpyaparaṁ bhūya itihāsaṁ nibodha me,
piturmama sakāśe yad brāhmaṇaḥ prāha dharmavit ॥127॥
8.34.130: sa tīvraṁ tapa āsthāya prasādayitavān bhavam,
8.34.131: tasya tuṣṭo mahādevo bhaktyā ca praśamena ca,
8.34.132: rāma tuṣṭo’smi bhadraṁ te viditaṁ me tavepsitam,
8.34.133: dāsyāmi te tadāstrāṇi yadā pūto bhaviṣyasi,
8.34.136: tataḥ sa tapasā caiva damena niyamena ca,
8.34.138: abravīt tasya bahuśo guṇān devyāḥ samīpataḥ,
8.34.139: evaṁ tasya guṇān prīto bahuśo’kathayat prabhuḥ,
8.34.140: etasminneva kāle tu daityā hyāsan mahābalāḥ,
8.34.141: cakruḥ śatruvadhe yatnaṁ na śekurjetumeva tān ॥141॥
8.34.144: ripūn bhārgava devānāṁ jahi sarvān samāgatān,
8.34.147: vijitya ca ripūn sarvān guṇān prāpyasi puṣkalān,
etacchrutvā tu vacanaṁ pratigr̥hya ca sarvaśaḥ ॥147॥
8.34.150: sa tān nihatya samare daityān bhārgavanandanaḥ ॥150॥
8.34.152: prītaśca bhagavān devaḥ karmaṇā tena tasya vai ॥152॥
8.34.154: tayā te mānuṣaṁ karma vyapoḍhaṁ bhr̥gunandana ॥154॥
8.34.156: labdhvā bahuvidhān rāmaḥ praṇamya śirasā bhavam,
8.34.158: vr̥jinaṁ hi bhavet kiñcid yadi karṇasya pārthiva ॥158॥
8.34.159: nāpi sūtakule jātaṁ karṇaṁ manye kathañcana ॥159॥
8.34.161: sarvathā na hyayaṁ śalya karṇaḥ sūtakulodbhavaḥ,
8.34.163: na tveṣa prākr̥taḥ kaścit karṇo vaikartano vr̥ṣaḥ,
8.35.6: yathā ca cakre sārathyaṁ bhavasya prapitāmahaḥ ॥6॥
8.35.7: kr̥ṣṇasya cāpi viditaṁ sarvametat purā hyabhūt ॥7॥
8.35.10: dr̥ṣṭvā pārthaṁ hi nihataṁ svayaṁ yotsyati keśavaḥ ॥10॥
8.35.11: na cāpi tasya kruddhasya vārṣṇeyasya mahātmanaḥ ॥11॥
8.35.15: pratyakṣaṁ te mahābāho yathā rātrau ghaṭotkacaḥ ॥15॥
8.35.17: etāṁśca divasān sarvān bhayena mahatā vr̥taḥ,
8.35.18: uktaśca sañjñayā rājan mūḍha audariko yathā,
mādrīputrau tathā śūrau yena jitvā mahāraṇe ॥18॥
8.35.19: kamapyarthaṁ puraskr̥tya na hatau yudhi māriṣa,
8.35.20: nirjitya samare śūro virathaśca balāt kr̥taḥ,
8.35.21: taṁ kathaṁ pāṇḍavā yuddhe vijeṣyanti mahāratham ॥21॥
8.35.22: yo hanyāt samare kruddho vajrahastaṁ purandaram,
8.35.23: bāhuvīryeṇa te tulyaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ nāsti kaścana,
8.35.24: tava bāhubalaṁ prāpya na śekuḥ sarvasātvatāḥ ॥24॥
8.35.25: tava bāhubalād rājan kiṁ nu kr̥ṣṇo balādhikaḥ,
yathā hi kr̥ṣṇena balaṁ dhāryaṁ vai phālgune hate ॥25॥
8.35.26: tathā karṇātyayībhāve tvayā dhāryaṁ mahad balam,
8.35.27: kimarthaṁ ca bhavān sainyaṁ na haniṣyati māriṣa,
sodarāṇāṁ ca vīrāṇāṁ sarveṣāṁ ca mahīkṣitām ॥27॥
8.35.28: yanmāṁ bravīṣi gāndhāre agre sainyasya mānada,
8.35.29: yudhyataḥ pāṇḍavāgryeṇa yathā tvaṁ vīra manyase ॥29॥
8.35.30: samayaśca hi me vīra kaścid vaikartanaṁ prati,
8.35.31: tatheti rājan putraste saha karṇena māriṣa,
8.35.33: jahi pārthān raṇe sarvān mahendro dānavāniva ॥33॥
8.35.35: rājan madhurayā vācā punarenaṁ bravīhi vai ॥35॥
8.35.38: tasya tvaṁ puruṣavyāghra niyaccha turagān yudhi,
8.35.39: tasyābhīṣugrahe rājan prayāce tvāṁ punaḥ punaḥ,
8.35.40: tataḥ śalyaḥ pariṣvajya sutaṁ te vākyamabravīt,
8.35.41: tasmāt te yat priyaṁ kiñcit tat sarvaṁ karavāṇyaham ॥41॥
8.35.42: tatra sarvātmanā yukto vakṣye kāryadhuraṁ tava ॥42॥
8.35.43: mama tat kṣamatāṁ sarvaṁ bhavān karṇaśca sarvaśaḥ ॥43॥
8.35.44: īśānasya yathā brahmā yathā pārthasya keśavaḥ,
tathā nityaṁ hite yukto madrarāja bhavasva naḥ ॥44॥
8.35.46: yat tu vidvan pravakṣyāmi pratyayārthamahaṁ tava,
8.35.47: ahaṁ śakrasya sārathye yogyo mātalivat prabho,
8.36.1: ayaṁ te karṇa sārathyaṁ madrarājaḥ kariṣyati,
8.36.3: yodhe tvayi rathasthe ca madrarāje ca sārathau,
8.36.7: tvaṁ sūta syandanaṁ mahyaṁ kalpayetyasakr̥t tvaran,
8.36.8: taṁ rathaṁ rathināṁ śreṣṭhaḥ karṇo’bhyarcya yathāvidhi ॥8॥
8.36.11: tataḥ śalyāśritaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā karṇaḥ svaṁ rathamuttamam ॥11॥
8.36.13: abhrājetāṁ yathā meghaṁ sūryāgnī sahitau divi,
8.36.14: sa śalyasaṅgr̥hītāśve rathe karṇaḥ sthito babhau ॥14॥
8.36.20: gr̥hāṇa dharmarājaṁ vā jahi vā tvaṁ dhanañjayam ॥20॥
8.36.21: jayaśca te’stu bhadraṁ te prayāhi puruṣarṣabha ॥21॥
8.36.23: pratigr̥hya tu tad vākyaṁ rathastho rathasattamaḥ ॥23॥
8.36.25: bhīmasenaṁ yamau cobhau rājānaṁ ca yudhiṣṭhiram,
adya paśyatu me śalya bāhuvīryaṁ dhanañjayaḥ ॥25॥
8.36.31: yadā drakṣyasi saṅgrāme dharmaputraṁ yamau tathā ॥31॥
8.36.33: anādr̥tya tu tad vākyaṁ madrarājena bhāṣitam,
8.37.3: prayāte tu tataḥ karṇe yodheṣu muditeṣu ca ॥3॥
8.37.4: cacāla pr̥thivī rājan vavāśa ca suvistaram,
8.37.9: ete cānye ca bahava utpātāstatra dāruṇāḥ,
8.37.10: na ca tān gaṇayāmāsuḥ sarve devena mohitāḥ,
8.37.39: kimu na jitaḥ sa tadā tvayārjunaḥ ॥39॥
8.37.43: yāhi śalyeti cāpyenaṁ karṇaḥ prāha yuyutsayā ॥43॥
8.37.44: sa rathaḥ prayayau śatrūn śvetāśvaḥ śalyasārathiḥ,
nighnannamitrān samare tamo ghnan savitā yathā ॥44॥
8.38.1: prayāṇe ca tataḥ karṇo harṣayan vāhinīṁ tava,
8.38.3: na cet tadabhimanyeta tasmai dadyāmahaṁ punaḥ,
śakaṭaṁ ratnasampūrṇaṁ yo me brūbād dhanañjayam ॥3॥
8.38.4: śataṁ dadyāṁ gavāṁ tasmai naityikaṁ kāṁsyadohanam ॥4॥
8.38.9: tasmai dadyāṁ śataṁ nāgān śataṁ grāmān śataṁ rathān,
suvarṇasya ca mukhyasya hayāgryeṇāṁ śataṁ śatān ॥9॥
8.38.11: dadyāṁ tasmai savatsānāṁ yo me brūyād dhanañjayam,
8.38.12: anyadasmai varaṁ dadyāṁ śvetān pañcaśatān hayān,
8.38.13: rathaṁ ca śubhraṁ sauvarṇaṁ dadyāṁ tasmai svalaṅkr̥tam ॥13॥
8.38.15: anyadasmai varaṁ dadyāṁ kuñjarāṇāṁ śatāni ṣaṭ,
8.38.18: pratyagravayasāṁ dadyāṁ yo me brūyād dhanañjayam ॥18॥
8.38.19: anyaṁ tasmai varaṁ dadyāṁ yamasau kāmayet svayam ॥19॥
8.38.20: tacca tasmai punardadyāṁ yad yacca manasecchati ॥20॥
8.38.21: hatvā ca sahitau kr̥ṣṇau tayorvittāni sarvaśaḥ,
tasmai dadyāmahaṁ yo me prabrūyāt keśavārjunau ॥21॥
8.38.22: etā vācaḥ subahuśaḥ karṇa uccārayan yudhi,
8.38.23: tā vācaḥ sūtaputrasya tathā yuktā niśamya tu,
8.38.26: tathā prahr̥ṣṭe sainye tu plavamānaṁ mahāratham,
8.39.2: bālyādiha tvaṁ tyajasi vasu vaiśravaṇo yathā,
8.39.3: parān sr̥jasi yad vittaṁ kiñcittvaṁ bahu mūḍhavat,
8.39.4: yat tvaṁ prerayase vittaṁ bahu tena khalu tvayā,
8.39.5: yacca prārthayase hantuṁ kr̥ṣṇau mohād vr̥thaiva tat,
na hi śuśruma sammarde kroṣṭrā siṁhau nipātitau ॥5॥
8.39.6: aprārthitaṁ prārthayase suhr̥do na hi santi te,
ye tvāṁ na vārayantyāśu prapatantaṁ hutāśane ॥6॥
8.39.8: samudrataraṇaṁ dorbhyāṁ kaṇṭhe baddhvā yathā śilām,
giryagrād vā nipatanaṁ tādr̥k tava cikīrṣitam ॥8॥
8.39.10: hitārthaṁ dhārtarāṣṭrasya bravīmi tvāṁ na hiṁsayā,
śraddhasvaivaṁ mayā proktaṁ yadi te’sti jijīviṣā ॥10॥
8.39.13: iti karṇasya vākyānte śalyaḥ prāhottaraṁ vacaḥ,
8.39.20: śaśako hvayase yuddhe karṇa pārthaṁ dhanañjayam ॥20॥
8.39.21: bilasthaṁ kr̥ṣṇasarpaṁ tvaṁ bālyāt kāṣṭhena vidhyasi,
8.39.22: śr̥gāla iva mūḍhastvaṁ nr̥siṁhaṁ karṇa pāṇḍavam ॥22॥
8.39.25: vatsa āhvayase yuddhe karṇa pārthaṁ dhanañjayam ॥25॥
8.39.27: yathā ca svagr̥hasthaḥ śvā vyāghraṁ vanagataṁ bhaṣet,
tathā tvaṁ bhaṣase karṇa naravyāghraṁ dhanañjayam ॥27॥
8.39.28: śr̥gālo’pi vane karṇa śaśaiḥ parivr̥to vasan,
manyate siṁhamātmānaṁ yāvat siṁhaṁ na paśyati ॥28॥
8.39.30: vyāghraṁ tvaṁ manyase’’tmānaṁ yāvat kr̥ṣṇau na paśyasi,
8.39.31: yāvad gāṇḍīvaghoṣaṁ tvaṁ na śr̥ṇoṣi mahāhave,
tāvadeva tvayā karṇa śakyaṁ vaktuṁ yathecchasi ॥31॥
8.39.34: yathākhuḥ syād viḍālaśca śvā vyāghraśca balābale,
yathā śr̥gālaḥ siṁhaśca yathā ca śaśakuñjarau ॥34॥
8.39.35: yathānr̥taṁ ca satyaṁ ca yathā cāpi viṣāmr̥te,
8.40.2: guṇān guṇavatāṁ śalya guṇavān vetti nāguṇaḥ,
tvaṁ tu śalya guṇairhīnaḥ kiṁ jñāsyasi guṇāguṇam ॥2॥
8.40.3: arjunasya mahāstrāṇi krodhaṁ vīryaṁ dhanuḥ śarān,
8.40.4: yathāhaṁ śalya jānāmi na tvaṁ jānāsi tat tathā ॥4॥
8.40.9: kr̥ṣṇād vā devakīputrāt satyaṁ cāpi śr̥ṇuṣva me ॥9॥
8.40.14: maṇī sūtra iva protau draṣṭāsi nihatau mayā,
8.40.16: saṁstauṣi tau tu kenāpi hetunā tvaṁ kudeśaja ॥16॥
8.40.17: tau hatvā samare hantā tvāmadya sahabāndhavam,
8.40.18: suhr̥d bhūtvā ripuḥ kiṁ māṁ kr̥ṣṇābhyāṁ bhīṣayiṣyasi,
tau vā māmadya hantārau haniṣye vāpi tāvaham ॥18॥
8.40.20: striyo bālāśca vr̥ddhāśca prāyaḥ krīḍāgatā janāḥ ॥20॥
8.40.21: tā gāthāḥ śr̥ṇu me śalya madrakeṣu durātmasu ॥21॥
8.40.22: śrutvā caikamanā mūḍha kṣama vā brūhi cottaram ॥22॥
8.40.23: mitradhruṅmadrako nityaṁ yo no dveṣṭi sa madrakaḥ,
8.40.24: yāvadantyaṁ hi daurātmyaṁ madrakeṣviti naḥ śrutam ॥24॥
8.40.25: jāmātā duhitā bhrātā naptānye te ca bāndhavāḥ ॥25॥
8.40.27: pītvā sīdhu sagomāṁsaṁ krandanti ca hasanti ca ॥27॥
8.40.29: nāpi vairaṁ na sauhārdaṁ madrakeṇa samācaret ॥29॥
8.40.30: madrake saṅgataṁ nāsti madrako hi sadāmalaḥ,
madrakeṣu ca saṁsr̥ṣṭaṁ śaucaṁ gāndhārakeṣu ca ॥30॥
8.40.32: yathaiva saṅgataṁ kr̥tvā naraḥ patati madrakaiḥ ॥32॥
8.40.33: madrake saṅgataṁ nāsti hataṁ vr̥ścika te viṣam,
ātharvaṇena mantreṇa yathā śāntiḥ kr̥tā mayā ॥33॥
8.40.34: kurvanti bheṣajaṁ prājñāḥ satyaṁ taccāpi dr̥śyate ॥34॥
8.40.36: tāsāṁ putraḥ kathaṁ dharmaṁ madrako vaktumarhati ॥36॥
8.40.39: mā māṁ suvīrakaṁ kaścid yācatāṁ dayitaṁ mama ॥39॥
8.40.40: putraṁ dadyāṁ patiṁ dadyāṁ na tu dadyāṁ suvīrakam,
8.40.41: evamādi mayānyairvā śakyaṁ vaktuṁ bhaved bahu ॥41॥
8.40.42: madrakāḥ sindhusauvīrāḥ dharmaṁ vidyuḥ kathaṁ tviha ॥42॥
8.40.43: eṣa mukhyatamo dharmaḥ kṣatriyasyeti naḥ śrutam ॥43॥
8.40.45: so’yaṁ priyaḥ sakhā cāsmi dhārtarāṣṭrasya dhīmataḥ ॥45॥
8.40.46: tadarthe hi mama prāṇā yacca me vidyate vasu,
8.40.47: kāmaṁ na khalu śakyo’haṁ tvadvidhānāṁ śatairapi ॥47॥
8.40.48: saṅgrāmād vimukhaḥ kartuṁ dharmajña iva nāstikaiḥ,
sāraṅga iva gharmārtaḥ kāmaṁ vilapa śuṣya ca ॥48॥
8.40.50: yā gatirguruṇā proktā purā rāmeṇa tāṁ smare,
8.40.51: na tad bhūtaṁ prapaśyāmi triṣu lokeṣu madrapa ॥51॥
8.40.52: evaṁ vidvañjoṣamāssva trāsāt kiṁ bahu bhāṣase ॥52॥
8.40.53: mā tvāṁ hatvā pradāsyāmi kravyādbhyo madrakādhama,
8.40.56: karṇaṁ vā jaghnatuḥ kr̥ṣṇau karṇo vā nijaghāna tau,
8.41.3: yathaiva matto madyena tvaṁ tathā lakṣyase vr̥ṣa,
8.41.4: imāṁ kākopamāṁ karṇa procyamānāṁ nibodha me,
8.41.5: nāhamātmani kiñcid vai kilbiṣaṁ karṇa saṁsmare,
8.41.6: avaśyaṁ tu mayā vācyaṁ buddhyatā tvaddhitāhitam,
8.41.7: samaṁ ca viṣamaṁ caiva rathinaśca balābalam,
śramaḥ khedaśca satataṁ hayānāṁ rathinā saha ॥7॥
8.41.9: astrayogaśca yuddhaṁ ca nimittāni tathaiva ca,
8.41.17d1: ebhistvamapi śakto hi kāmānna patitaṁ tvayā.
8.41.18: tān so’bhipatya jijñāsuḥ ka eṣāṁ śreṣṭhabhāgiti ॥18॥
8.41.19: teṣāṁ yaṁ pravaraṁ mene haṁsānāṁ dūrapātinām ॥19॥
8.41.20: tacchrutvā prāhasan haṁsā ye tatrāsan samāgatāḥ ॥20॥
8.41.21: bhāṣato bahu kākasya balinaḥ patatāṁ varāḥ,
idamūcuḥ sma cakrāṅgā vacaḥ kākaṁ vihaṅgamāḥ ॥21॥
8.41.22: pakṣiṇāṁ ca vayaṁ nityaṁ dūrapātena pūjitāḥ ॥22॥
8.41.23: kathaṁ haṁsaṁ nu balinaṁ cakrāṅgaṁ dūrapātinam,
8.41.24: kathaṁ tvaṁ patitā kāka sahāsmābhirbravīhi tat,
atha haṁsavaco mūḍhaḥ kutsayitvā punaḥ punaḥ,
8.41.25: śatamekaṁ ca pātānāṁ patitāsmi na saṁśayaḥ,
8.41.30: kartāsmi miṣatāṁ vo’dya tato drakṣyatha me balam,
8.41.31: te vai dhruvaṁ viniścitya patadhvaṁ na mayā saha ॥31॥
8.41.32: pātairebhiḥ khalu khagāḥ patituṁ khe nirāśraye,
8.41.33: uvāca kākaṁ rādheya vacanaṁ tannibodha me,
śatamekaṁ ca pātānāṁ tvaṁ kāka patitā dhruvam ॥33॥
8.41.34: ekameva tu yaṁ pātaṁ viduḥ sarve vihaṅgamāḥ,
tamahaṁ patitā kāka nānyaṁ jānāmi kañcana ॥34॥
8.41.35: pata tvamapi tāmrākṣa yena pātena manyase,
8.41.38: ekapātī ca cakrāṅgaḥ kākaḥ pātaśatena ca,
8.41.44: atha haṁsaḥ sa tacchrutvā prāpatat paścimāṁ diśam ॥44॥
8.41.45: tato bhīḥ prāviśat kākaṁ tadā tatra vicetasam ॥45॥
8.41.46: nipateyaṁ kva nu śrānta iti tasmiñjalārṇave ॥46॥
8.41.48: gāmbhīryāddhi samudrasya na viśeṣaṁ hi sūtaja,
8.41.49: vidūrapātāt toyasya kiṁ punaḥ karṇa vāyasaḥ,
8.41.50: atikramya ca cakrāṅgaḥ kākaṁ taṁ samudaikṣata ॥50॥
8.41.51: yāvad gatvā patatyeṣa kāko māmiti cintayan,
8.41.52: taṁ tathā hīyamānaṁ tu haṁso dr̥ṣṭvābravīdidam,
8.41.53: pātasya vyāharaṁścedaṁ na no guhyaṁ prabhāṣase ॥53॥
8.41.54: kiṁ nāma patitaṁ kāka yattvaṁ patasi sāmpratam,
jalaṁ spr̥śasi pakṣābhyāṁ tuṇḍena ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥54॥
8.41.55: prabrūhi katame tatra pāte vartasi vāyasa,
ehyehi kāka śīghraṁ tvameṣa tvāṁ pratipālaye ॥55॥
8.41.56: sa pakṣābhyāṁ spr̥śannārtastuṇḍena ca jalaṁ tadā,
8.41.58: vayaṁ kākāḥ kuto nāma carāmaḥ kākavāśikāḥ,
haṁsa prāṇaiḥ prapadye tvāmudakāntaṁ nayasva mām ॥58॥
8.41.63: pratyuvāca tataḥ kākaḥ sīdamāna idaṁ vacaḥ,
8.41.65: prāṇairhaṁsa prapadye tvāṁ dvīpāntaṁ prāpayasva mām,
yadyahaṁ svastimān haṁsa svaṁ deśaṁ prāpnuyāṁ prabho ॥65॥
8.41.68: āropya pr̥ṣṭhaṁ haṁsastaṁ kākaṁ tūrṇaṁ vicetanam ॥68॥
8.41.69: saṁsthāpya taṁ cāpi punaḥ samāśvāsya ca khecaram ॥69॥
8.41.70: gato yathepsitaṁ deśaṁ haṁso mana ivāśugaḥ,
8.41.74: yatra vyastāḥ samastāśca nirjitāḥ stha kirīṭinā,
śr̥gālā iva siṁhena kva te vīryamabhūt tadā ॥74॥
8.41.78: punaḥ prabhāvaḥ pārthasya paurāṇaḥ keśavasya ca,
8.41.79: avadhyau vadataḥ kr̥ṣṇau saṁnidhau ca mahīkṣitām ॥79॥
8.41.80: kiyat tat tat pravakṣyāmi yena yena dhanañjayaḥ,
8.41.81: putraṁ ca vasudevasya kuntīputraṁ ca pāṇḍavam ॥81॥
8.41.84: yadā śaraśataiḥ pārtho darpaṁ tava vadhiṣyati,
8.41.85: tau māvamaṁsthā maurkhyāt tvaṁ khadyota iva rocanau ॥85॥
8.41.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate karṇaparvaṇi karṇaśalyasaṁvāde haṁsakākīyopākhyāne ekacatvāriṁśo’dhyāyaḥ ॥41॥
8.42.7: na tvaṁ vipraḥ ko’si satyaṁ vadeti,
8.42.9: dabrāhmaṇe brahma na hi dhruvaṁ syāt,
8.42.34: yotsye yatnāt karma tat paśya me’dya,
8.42.35: na cet pated viṣame me’dya cakram ॥35॥
8.42.36: sagadād vā dhanapateḥ savajrād vāpi vāsavāt ॥36॥
8.42.36d1: iti śalya vijānīhi yathā nāhaṁ bibhemyataḥ.
8.42.37: tasmānna me bhayaṁ pārthānnāpi caiva janārdanāt ॥37॥
8.42.38: saha yuddhaṁ hi me tābhyāṁ sāmparāye bhaviṣyati,
8.42.40: yasmāt tvayā pramattena homadhenvā hataḥ sutaḥ ॥40॥
8.42.41: śvabhre te patatāṁ cakramiti māṁ brāhmaṇo’bravīt,
8.42.44: dadato dvijamukhyo me prasādaṁ na cakāra saḥ ॥44॥
8.42.45: āharaṁ na labhe tasmāt prasādaṁ dvijasattamāt ॥45॥
8.42.46: r̥ddhaṁ gr̥haṁ sarvakāmairyacca me vasu kiñcana,
tat sarvamasmai satkr̥tya prayacchāmi na cecchati ॥46॥
8.42.47: vyāhr̥taṁ yanmayā sūta tat tathā na tadanyathā ॥47॥
8.42.49: mā tvaṁ brahmagatiṁ hiṁsyāḥ prāyaścittaṁ kr̥taṁ tvayā,
madvākyaṁ nānr̥taṁ loke kaścit kuryāt samāpnuhi ॥49॥
8.43.2: yat tvaṁ nidarśanārthaṁ māṁ śalya jalpitavānasi,
8.43.3: yadi māṁ devatāḥ sarvā yodhayeyuḥ savāsavāḥ,
tathāpi me bhayaṁ na syāt kimu pārthāt sakeśavāt ॥3॥
8.43.4: anyaṁ jānīhi yaḥ śakyastvayā bhīṣayituṁ raṇe ॥4॥
8.43.5: aśakto madguṇān vaktuṁ valgase bahu durmate ॥5॥
8.43.6: na hi karṇaḥ samudbhūto bhayārthamiha madraka,
8.43.8: mayi taccāhitaṁ śalya tena jīvasi me kṣaṇam ॥8॥
8.43.9: kr̥taśca samayaḥ pūrvaṁ kṣantavyaṁ vipriyaṁ tava,
8.44.1: nanu pralāpāḥ karṇaite yān bravīṣi parān prati,
r̥te karṇasahasreṇa śakyā jetuṁ pare yudhi ॥1॥
8.44.2: tathā bruvantaṁ paruṣaṁ karṇo madrādhipaṁ tadā,
8.44.3: idaṁ tu te tvamekāgraḥ śr̥ṇu madrajanādhipa,
8.44.5: tatra vr̥ddhaḥ purāvr̥ttāḥ kathāḥ kaścid dvijottamaḥ,
8.44.8: govardhano nāma vaṭaḥ subhadraṁ nāma catvaram,
8.44.9: tata eṣāṁ samācāraḥ saṁvāsād vidito mama ॥9॥
8.44.11: dhānā gauḍyāsavaṁ pītvā gomāṁsaṁ laśunaiḥ saha,
8.44.12: gāyantyatha ca nr̥tyanti striyo mattā vivāsasaḥ,
8.44.14: he hate he hatetyevaṁ svāmibhartr̥hateti ca ॥14॥
8.44.18: gatvā svadeśaṁ drakṣyāmi sthūlaśaṅkhāḥ śubhāḥ striyaḥ,
8.44.25: tatra sma rākṣasī gāti sadā kr̥ṣṇacaturdaśīm ॥25॥
8.44.26: nagare śākale sphīte āhatya niśi dundubhim,
8.44.27: gavyasya tr̥ptā māṁsasya pītvā gauḍaṁ surāsavam,
8.44.29: aiḍaṁ ca ye na khādanti teṣāṁ janma nirarthakam,
iti gāyanti ye mattāḥ sīdhunā śākalāśca ye ॥29॥
8.44.30: iti śalya vijānīhi hanta bhūyo bravīmi te ॥30॥
8.44.33: āraṭṭā nāma te deśā naṣṭadharmā na tān vrajet,
8.44.36: āvikaṁ cauṣṭrikaṁ caiva kṣīraṁ gārdabhameva ca ॥36॥
8.44.37: tadvikārāṁśca vāhīkāḥ khādanti ca pibanti ca,
8.44.38: hanta śalya vijānīhi hanta bhūyo bravīmi te ॥38॥
8.44.40: tadvad bhūtilaye snātvā kathaṁ svargaṁ gamiṣyati,
pañca nadyo vahantyetā yatra niḥsr̥tya parvatāt ॥40॥
8.44.41: āraṭṭā nāma vāhīkā na teṣvāryodvyahaṁ vaset,
8.44.42: te kathaṁ vividhān dharmān jñāsyante hīnayonayaḥ ॥42॥
8.44.45: āraṭṭā nāma te deśā vāhīkaṁ nāma tajjalam,
8.44.46: vedā na teṣāṁ vedyaśca yajñā yajanameva ca,
8.45.1: hanta śalya vijānīhi hanta bhūyo bravīmi te,
8.45.4: na ca kena ca dharmeṇa virudhyante prajā imāḥ,
sarvaṁ hi te’bruvan dharmaṁ yaduktaṁ vedapāragaiḥ ॥4॥
8.45.6: tatra vai brāhmaṇo bhūtvā tato bhavati kṣatriyaḥ,
8.45.10: hanta śalya vijānīhi hanta bhūyo bravīmi te,
8.45.11: satī purā hr̥tā kācidāraṭṭāt kila dasyubhiḥ,
8.45.12: tasmānnāryo bhaviṣyanti bandhakyo vai kulasya ca ॥12॥
8.45.13: tasmāt teṣāṁ bhāgaharā bhāgineyā na sūnavaḥ ॥13॥
8.45.17: tvaṁ tasya goptā ca janasya rājā
8.45.18: rakṣitā puṇyabhāg rājā prajānāṁ tvaṁ hyapuṇyabhāk ॥18॥
8.45.20: brahmaṇā nindite dharme sa tvaṁ loke kimabravīḥ ॥20॥
8.45.22: hanta śalya vijānīhi hanta bhūyo bravīmi te,
8.45.23: malaṁ pr̥thivyāṁ vāhīkāḥ strīṇāṁ madrastriyo malam ॥23॥
8.45.25: mānuṣāṇāṁ malaṁ mlecchā mlecchānāṁ śauṇḍikā malam,
8.45.26: tad bhaved vai tava malaṁ yadyasmānna vimuñcasi ॥26॥
8.45.32: pratīcīṁ varuṇaḥ pāti pālayānaḥ surān balī,
udīcīṁ bhagavān somo brāhmaṇaiḥ saha rakṣati ॥32॥
8.45.34: dhruvaḥ sarvāṇi bhūtāni viṣṇuḥ pāti janārdanaḥ,
8.45.37: pratirabdhāstu vāhīkā na ca kecana madrakāḥ,
8.45.39: etajjñātvā joṣamāssva pratīpaṁ mā sma vai kr̥thāḥ,
mā tvāṁ pūrvamahaṁ hatvā haniṣye keśavārjunau ॥39॥
8.45.41: tān viditvā’’tmano doṣān nirmanyurbhava mā krudhaḥ ॥41॥
8.45.42: sarvatra brāhmaṇāḥ santi santi sarvatra kṣatriyāḥ,
vaiśyāḥ śūdrāstathā karṇa striyaḥ sādhvyaśca suvratāḥ ॥42॥
8.45.44: ātmavācyaṁ na jānīte jānannapi ca muhyati ॥44॥
8.45.45: sarvatra santi rājānaḥ svaṁ svaṁ dharmamanuvratāḥ,
8.45.46: na karṇa deśasāmānyāt sarvaḥ pāpaṁ niṣevate,
yādr̥śāḥ svasvabhāvena devā api na tādr̥śāḥ ॥46॥
8.46.4d1: tāni sarvāṇi sainyāni karṇaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā viśāmpate,
8.46.4d3: adya karṇaṁ raṇe dr̥ṣṭvā phālguno vidraviṣyati,
8.46.4d7: athavā kaṁ naraṁ loke na spr̥śanti manorathāḥ,
8.46.6: ke ca prapakṣau pakṣau vā mama sainyasya sañjaya ॥6॥
8.46.8: kathaṁ caiva mahad yuddhaṁ prāvartata sudāruṇam,
kva ca bībhatsurabhavad yat karṇo’yād yudhiṣṭhiram ॥8॥
8.46.9: sarvabhūtāni yo hyekaḥ khāṇḍave jitavān purā,
8.46.10: parivārya nr̥paṁ svaṁ svaṁ saṅgrāmaścābhavad yathā ॥10॥
8.46.15: teṣāṁ prapakṣāḥ kāmbojāḥ śakāśca yavanaiḥ saha ॥15॥
8.46.20: duḥśāsano vr̥taḥ sainyaiḥ sthito vyūhasya pr̥ṣṭhataḥ,
8.46.22: aśvatthāmā kurūṇāṁ ca ye pravīrā mahārathāḥ ॥22॥
8.46.29: tataḥ senāmukhe karṇaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
8.46.31: tadetad vai samālokya pratyamitraṁ mahad balam,
8.46.32: yathā bhavānāha tathā tat sarvaṁ na tadanyathā ॥32॥
8.46.36: te te ca tāṁstānahitānasmākaṁ ghnantu māmakāḥ ॥36॥
8.46.38: tasmād yaḥ prathamaṁ jātastaṁ devā brāhmaṇaṁ viduḥ ॥38॥
8.46.42: śrūyate tumulaḥ śabdo yathā meghasvano mahān ॥42॥
8.46.52: ānakānāṁ ca rādheya mr̥daṅgānāṁ ca sarvaśaḥ,
8.46.56: vibhrājanti rathe karṇa vimāne daivate yathā,
8.46.59: etaccakraṁ gadā śārṅgaṁ śaṅkhaḥ kr̥ṣṇasya dhīmataḥ,
8.46.69: eṣa sūrya ivāmbhodaiśchannaḥ pārtho na dr̥śyate,
8.46.70: adya drakṣyasi taṁ vīraṁ śvetāśvaṁ kr̥ṣṇasārathim,
nighnantaṁ śātravān saṅkhye yaṁ karṇa paripr̥cchasi ॥70॥
8.46.72: taṁ ceddhantāsi rādheya tvaṁ no rājā bhaviṣyasi ॥72॥
8.46.73: karoti kadanaṁ caiṣāṁ saṅgrāme dviṣatāṁ balī ॥73॥
8.46.75: eṣa sūrya ivāmbhodaiśchannaḥ pārtho na dr̥śyate,
8.46.76: ko vānilaṁ nigr̥hṇīyāt pibed vā ko mahārṇavam ॥76॥
8.46.77: na hi śakyo’rjuno jetuṁ yudhi sendraiḥ surāsuraiḥ ॥77॥
8.46.78: na sa śakyo yudhā jetumanyaṁ kuru manoratham ॥78॥
8.46.79: bāhubhyāmuddhared bhūmiṁ dahet kruddha imāḥ prajāḥ,
pātayet tridivād devān yo’rjunaṁ samare jayet ॥79॥
8.46.84: amī sthitā draupadeyāḥ pañca pañcācalā iva,
8.47.1: saṁśaptakān kathaṁ pārtho gataḥ karṇaśca pāṇḍavān ॥1॥
8.47.2: etad vistaraśo yuddhaṁ prabrūhi kuśalo hyasi,
na hi tr̥pyāmi vīrāṇāṁ śr̥ṇvāno vikramān raṇe ॥2॥
8.47.12: iṣūn dhanūṁṣi khaḍgāṁśca cakrāṇi ca paraśvadhān,
8.47.13: ciccheda dviṣatāṁ pārthaḥ śirāṁsi ca sahasraśaḥ,
8.47.14: nimagnaṁ taṁ rathaṁ matvā neduḥ saṁśaptakā mudā,
8.47.15: dakṣiṇena ca paścācca kruddho rudraḥ paśūniva,
8.48.2: ke ca pravīrāḥ pārthānāṁ yudhi karṇamavārayan,
8.48.8: iti bhūtāni taṁ śabdaṁ menire te ca vivyathuḥ,
8.48.14: tataḥ sandhāya viśikhān pañca bhārata duḥsahān,
8.48.17: punareva ca tān karṇo jaghānāśu patattribhiḥ ॥17॥
8.48.18: cakrarakṣau tu karṇasya putrau māriṣa durjayau,
8.48.19: pr̥ṣṭhagoptā tu karṇasya jyeṣṭhaḥ o mahārathaḥ,
8.48.22: ta enaṁ vividhaiḥ śastraiḥ śaradhārābhireva ca,
8.48.24: nārācaiḥ saptabhirviddhyā hr̥di bhīmaṁ nanāda ha ॥24॥
8.48.26: karṇaṁ ca tūrṇaṁ vivyādha trisaptatyā śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥26॥
8.48.30: ulūkaṁ ca patatriṁ ca cakāra virathāvubhau ॥30॥
8.48.36: ciccheda ca dhanuḥ śīghraṁ kṣurapreṇa mahārathaḥ ॥36॥
8.48.38: ājaghne sārathiṁ cāsya suṣeṇaṁ ca tatastribhiḥ ॥38॥
8.48.41d1: punarvivyādha saptatyā sārathiṁ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ.
8.48.41d3: kopaṁ cakre mahārāja kruddho vegaṁ ca dāruṇam.
8.48.41d4: jagrāheṣuvarān vīraḥ śīghraṁ vai daśa pañca ca,
8.48.45: duḥśāsanastu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā virathaṁ vyāyudhaṁ kr̥tam ॥45॥
8.48.48: nakulaṁ triṁśatā bāṇaiḥ śatānīkaṁ ca saptabhiḥ,
8.48.51: sa tvanyaṁ rathamāsthāya vidhivat kalpitaṁ punaḥ ॥51॥
8.48.55: ete cānye ca rājendra pravīrā jayagr̥ddhinaḥ,
8.48.58: na hyādadānaṁ dadr̥śuḥ sandadhānaṁ ca sāyakān,
8.48.58d1: pratīcyāṁ diśi taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā prācyāṁ paśyāma lāghavāt,
na taṁ paśyāma rājendra kva nu karṇo’dhitiṣṭhati.
8.48.64: tataste pāṇḍavā rājan śikhaṇḍī ca sasātyakiḥ,
8.48.65: tathaiva tāvakāḥ sarve karṇaṁ durvāraṇaṁ raṇe,
8.49.11: karṇa karṇa vr̥thādr̥ṣṭe sūtaputra vacaḥ śr̥ṇu,
8.49.12: yad balaṁ yacca te vīryaṁ pradveṣo yastu pāṇḍuṣu ॥12॥
8.49.20: sa tu vegavatā mukto bāṇo vajrāśanisvanaḥ,
viveśa sahasā karṇaṁ savye pārśve mahāratham ॥20॥
8.49.21: sa tu tena prahāreṇa pīḍitaḥ pramumoha vai,
8.49.26: sa hemavikr̥taṁ cāpaṁ visphārya vijayaṁ mahat,
8.49.27: jaghāna candradevaṁ ca daṇḍadhāraṁ ca saṁyuge ॥27॥
8.49.30: śalyaṁ navatyā vivyādha trisaptatyā ca sūtajam,
8.49.38d4: sr̥ñjayānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ śataśo nihatā raṇe.
8.49.41: bibheda kavacaṁ rājño raṇe karṇaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥41॥
8.49.42: tad varma hemavikr̥taṁ ratnacitraṁ babhau patat,
8.49.46: tato bāhvorlalāṭe ca hr̥di caiva yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
8.49.47: udbhinnarudhiraḥ karṇaḥ kruddhaḥ sarpa iva śvasan,
8.49.48: iṣudhī cāsya ciccheda rathaṁ ca tilaśo’cchinat,
8.49.48d3: śaineyaṁ tu tataḥ kruddhaḥ karṇaḥ pañcabhirāyasaiḥ,
8.49.48d4: dakṣiṇaṁ tu bhujaṁ tasya tribhiḥ karṇo’pyavidhyata,
8.49.48d7: hatāśvasūte tu rathe sthitaḥ sa śinipuṅgavaḥ,
8.49.52: grahītumicchan sa balāt kuntīvākyaṁ ca so’smarat ॥52॥
8.49.53: taṁ śalyaḥ prāha mā karṇa gr̥hīthāḥ pārthivottamam,
gr̥hītamātro hatvā tvāṁ mā kariṣyati bhasmasāt ॥53॥
8.49.54: kathaṁ nāma kule jātaḥ kṣatradharme vyavasthitaḥ ॥54॥
8.49.55: prajahyāt samaraṁ bhītaḥ prāṇān rakṣan mahāhave,
na bhavān kṣatradharmeṣu kuśalo hīti me matiḥ ॥55॥
8.49.56: brāhme bale bhavān yuktaḥ svādhyāye yajñakarmaṇi,
mā sma yuddhyasva kaunteya mā sma vīrān samāsadaḥ ॥56॥
8.49.57: mā caitānapriyaṁ brūhi mā vai vraja mahāraṇam,
vaktavyā māriṣānye tu na vaktavyāstu mādr̥śāḥ ॥57॥
8.49.58: svagr̥haṁ gaccha kaunteya yatra tau keśavārjunau ॥58॥
8.49.59: na hi tvāṁ samare rājan hanyāt karṇaḥ kathañcana,
evamuktvā tataḥ pārthaṁ visr̥jya ca mahābalaḥ ॥59॥
8.49.67: abhavat tumulaḥ śabdo yodhānāṁ tatra bhārata ॥67॥
8.49.75: yathā bhuvi tathā vyomni niḥsvanaṁ śuśruvurjanāḥ ॥75॥
8.49.80: sainyena rajasā vyāpte sve svāñjaghnuḥ pare parān,
8.49.87: bhūmiṁ khaṁ dyāṁ diśaścaiva prāyaḥ paśyāma lohitāḥ ॥87॥
8.49.88: lohitasya tu gandhena sparśena ca rasena ca,
8.50.2: krośatastava putrasya na sma rājan nyavartata ॥2॥
8.50.8: so’bravīt sātyakiṁ vīraṁ dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca pārṣatam,
8.50.11: hantāsmyadya raṇe karṇaṁ sa vā māṁ nihaniṣyati,
8.50.16: īdr̥śaṁ nāsya rūpaṁ me dr̥ṣṭapūrvaṁ kadācana,
abhimanyau hate karṇa rākṣase ca ghaṭotkace ॥16॥
8.50.20: bhīmasenaṁ prati vibho tat satyaṁ nātra saṁśayaḥ ॥20॥
8.50.25: arjunaṁ samare hanyāṁ māṁ vā hanyād dhanañjayaḥ,
8.50.26: nihate bhīmasene vā yadi vā virathīkr̥te,
8.50.29: nirasya bhīmasenaṁ tu tataḥ prāpsyasi phālgunam,
8.50.30: sa vai sampatsyate karṇa satyametad bravīmi te,
8.50.31: hantāhamarjunaṁ saṅkhye māṁ vā hanyād dhanañjayaḥ,
yuddhe manaḥ samādhāya yāhi yatra vr̥kodaraḥ ॥31॥
8.50.39: tasya karṇo dhanurmadhye dvidhā ciccheda patribhiḥ,
8.50.41: rājan marmasu marmajño vivyādha niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.50.47d2: bhīmasena mahābāho yat tvāṁ vakṣyāmi tacchr̥ṇu,
vacanaṁ hetusampannaṁ śrutvā caitat tathā kuru.
8.50.47d4: tāṁ tathā kuru bhadraṁ te pratijñāṁ savyasācinaḥ,
rājñastu dharṣaṇaṁ pāpaḥ kr̥tavān mama saṁnidhau.
8.50.47d5: tataḥ kopābhibhūtena śeṣaṁ na gaṇitaṁ mayā,
patite cāpi rādheye na me manyuḥ śamaṁ gataḥ.
8.50.47d7: asmākaṁ śr̥ṇvatāṁ kr̥ṣṇā yāni vākyāni mātula,
asahyāni ca nīcena bahūni śrāvitāni bhoḥ.
8.50.47d11: asmin vinaṣṭe naṣṭāḥ smaḥ sarva eva sakeśavāḥ,
adya caiva nr̥śaṁsātmā pāpaḥ pāpakr̥tāṁ varaḥ.
8.51.2: karṇo hyeko raṇe hantā pāṇḍavān sr̥ñjayaiḥ saha,
8.51.3: parājitaṁ tu rādheyaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhīmena saṁyuge,
tataḥ paraṁ kimakarot putro duryodhano mama ॥3॥
8.51.5: śīghraṁ gacchata bhadraṁ vo rādheyaṁ parirakṣata,
8.51.6: te tu rājñā samādiṣṭā bhīmasenaṁ jighāṁsavaḥ,
8.51.12: bhīmaseno mahārāja tat papāta hataṁ bhuvi ॥12॥
8.51.13: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā nihataṁ śūraṁ bhrātaraḥ sarvataḥ prabho ॥13॥
8.51.16: tatastu tvarito bhīmaḥ krāthaṁ ninye yamakṣayam ॥16॥
8.51.17: nārācena sutīkṣṇena sa hato nyapatad bhuvi,
8.51.21: haṁsavarṇān hayān bhūyaḥ praiṣayad yatra pāṇḍavaḥ,
8.51.23: dr̥ṣṭvā mama mahārāja tau sametau mahārathau ॥23॥
8.51.25: karṇaṁ raṇe mahārāja putrāṇāṁ tava paśyatām,
tataḥ karṇo bhr̥śaṁ kruddho bhīmaṁ navabhirāyasaiḥ ॥25॥
8.51.27: tataḥ karṇo mahārāja āśīviṣa iva śvasan ॥27॥
8.51.29: tataḥ karṇo bhr̥śaṁ kruddho dr̥ḍhamādāya kārmukam ॥29॥
8.51.30: kārmukaṁ cāsya ciccheda bhallena niśitena ca ॥30॥
8.51.35: tataḥ karṇo mahārāja bhīmasenaṁ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥35॥
8.51.37: tasya bhittvā tanutrāṇaṁ bhittvā kāyaṁ ca sāyakaḥ ॥37॥
8.51.41: chittvā ca kārmukaṁ tūrṇaṁ pāṇḍavasyāśu patriṇā ॥41॥
8.51.44: avaplutya ca vegena tava sainyaṁ viśāmpate,
8.51.46: dantaveṣṭeṣu netreṣu kumbheṣu ca kaṭeṣu ca,
8.51.47: tataste prādravan bhītāḥ pratīpaṁ prahitāḥ punaḥ,
8.51.52: vihāya samare bhīmaṁ dudruvurvai diśo daśa ॥52॥
