8.51.60: tataḥ sa pradrutaṁ saṅkhye rathaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā mahārathaḥ,
8.51.66: naiva sūryaprabhā rājan na diśaḥ pradiśastathā ॥66॥
8.51.67: prājñāsiṣma vayaṁ te vā śarairmuktaiḥ sahasraśaḥ,
8.51.71: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ madhyaṁ prāpte divākare ॥71॥
8.51.72: tādr̥śaṁ na kadāciddhi dr̥ṣṭapūrvaṁ na ca śrutam,
8.51.74: te tu sene samāsādya vegavatyau parasparam ॥74॥
8.51.76: kurūṇāṁ pāṇḍavānāṁ ca lipsatāṁ sumahad yaśaḥ,
8.51.77: yasya yaddhi raṇe vyaṅgaṁ pitr̥to mātr̥to’pi vā ॥77॥
8.51.78: karmataḥ śīlato vāpi sa tacchrāvayate yudhi,
8.52.3: gadānāṁ parighāṇāṁ ca kaṇapānāṁ ca kṣipyatām,
8.52.7: nāgāśca samare tryaṅgaṁ mamr̥duḥ śīghragā nr̥pa,
vadhyatāṁ tatra śūrāṇāṁ krośatāṁ ca parasparam ॥7॥
8.52.16: himāgame yathā rājan vyabhrā iva mahīdharāḥ ॥16॥
8.52.26: vegāṁścānye raṇe cakruḥ pañcāsyā iva pannagāḥ ॥26॥
8.52.29: naiva sve na pare rājan vyajñāyanta tamovr̥tāḥ ॥29॥
8.52.34: kravyādānāṁ naravyāghra nardatāṁ tatra tatra ha ॥34॥
8.52.36: pītvā ca śoṇitaṁ tatra vasāṁ pītvā ca bhārata ॥36॥
8.52.38: śūrāstu samare rājan bhayaṁ tyaktvā sudustyajam,
8.52.40: pitr̥nāmāni ca raṇe gotranāmāni vā vibho ॥40॥
8.52.42: vyaṣīdat kauravī senā bhinnā nauriva sāgare ॥42॥
8.53.4: tā vr̥ṣṭīḥ sahasā rājaṁstarasā dhārayan prabhuḥ,
vyagāhata raṇe pārtho vinighnan rathināṁ varān ॥4॥
8.53.6: sa tasya śaravarṣāṇi vavarṣa rathināṁ varaḥ,
8.53.7: suśarmā tu tataḥ pārthaṁ viddhvā daśabhirāśugaiḥ,
8.53.9: kapestu ninadaṁ śrutvā santrastā tava vāhinī ॥9॥
8.53.10: tataḥ sā śuśubhe senā niśceṣṭāvasthitā nr̥pa ॥10॥
8.53.13: te hayān rathacakre ca ratheṣāṁ cāpi māriṣa ॥13॥
8.53.14: nigr̥hya taṁ rathaṁ tasya yodhāste tu sahasraśaḥ ॥14॥
8.53.28: te baddhāḥ pādabandhena na śekuśceṣṭituṁ nr̥pa,
8.53.29: yānuddiśya raṇe pārthaḥ pādabandhaṁ cakāra ha ॥29॥
8.53.30: tataḥ suśarmā rājendra gr̥hītāṁ vīkṣya vāhinīm,
8.53.31: te vai vidudruvurnāgā dr̥ṣṭvā tān khacarān nr̥pa ॥31॥
8.53.33: vipramuktāstu te yodhāḥ phālgunasya rathaṁ prati,
8.53.37: tata uccukruśuḥ sarve hataḥ pārtha iti sma ha,
8.53.42: na hi tatra pumān kaścid yo’rjunaṁ pratyavidhyata,
8.53.43: ayutaṁ tatra yodhānāṁ hatvā pāṇḍusuto raṇe ॥43॥
8.53.46d1: jitvā tān nyahanat pārthaḥ śatrūñśakra ivāsurān.
8.54.1: ulūkaḥ saubalaścaiva rājā ca saha sodaraiḥ ॥1॥
8.54.5: śikhaṇḍī ca tataḥ kruddho gautamaṁ tvarito yayau,
8.54.6: śikhaṇḍinaṁ raṇe kruddho vivyādha daśabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥6॥
8.54.9: khaḍgaṁ carma tathā gr̥hya satvaraṁ brāhmaṇaṁ yayau ॥9॥
8.54.23: dr̥ṣṭvā ca yuktaṁ taṁ yuddhe brāhmaṇaṁ caritavratam,
8.54.24: suketustu tato rājan gautamaṁ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
viddhvā vivyādha saptatyā punaścainaṁ tribhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥24॥
8.54.26: gautamastu tataḥ kruddho dhanurgr̥hya navaṁ dr̥ḍham,
8.54.30: gautamaṁ samare tyaktvā dudruvuste diśo daśa ॥30॥
8.54.39: dr̥ṣṭvā tu vāritāṁ yuddhe śastravr̥ṣṭiṁ durāsadām,
8.54.40: bhallena śitadhāreṇa sa hataḥ prāpatad rathāt ॥40॥
8.55.8: tathetarāṇi sainyāni na sma cakruḥ parākramam ॥8॥
8.55.14: anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā vivyadhustaṁ samantataḥ ॥14॥
8.55.15: sa tu kruddhastato rājannāśīviṣa iva śvasan,
8.55.16: śrutakīrtiṁ ca navabhiḥ sutasomaṁ ca pañcabhiḥ,
8.55.22: sātyakistu tataḥ kruddho drauṇeḥ praharato raṇe ॥22॥
8.55.23: chinnadhanvā tato drauṇiḥ śaktyā śaktimatāṁ varaḥ ॥23॥
8.55.31: nihatān menire sarvān pāṇḍūn droṇasutena vai,
8.55.32: naiva nāma tava prītirnaiva nāma kr̥tajñatā ॥32॥
8.55.32d1: jānāmi tvāṁ yudhi śreṣṭhaṁ vīryavantaṁ mahābalam,
8.55.32d2: balametad bhavān sarvaṁ pārṣate yadi darśayet,
tatastvāṁ balavantaṁ ca kr̥tavidyaṁ ca vidmahe.
8.55.32d3: na hi vai pārṣataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā samare śatrusūdanam,
bhavet tava balaṁ kiñcid bravīmi tvā na tu dvijam.
8.55.36: yuktaṁ tattvaṁ ca sañcintya nottaraṁ kiñcidabravīt,
8.55.38: pārtho’payātaḥ śīghraṁ vai vihāya mahatīṁ camūm,
8.55.39: prayayau tāvakaṁ sainyaṁ yuktaḥ krūrāya karmaṇe ॥39॥
8.56.7: tato duryodhanaḥ kruddho nakulaṁ navabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.56.9: nakulastu tataḥ kruddhastava putraṁ ca saptabhiḥ,
8.56.11: yamayoḥ sahasā rājan vivyādha ca trisaptabhiḥ ॥11॥
8.56.13: tatastau rabhasau yuddhe bhrātarau bhrātaraṁ yudhi,
8.56.14: tataḥ kruddho mahārāja tava putro mahārathaḥ,
8.56.17: parākramaṁ tu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tava sūnormahārathāḥ ॥17॥
8.56.19: pārṣataḥ prayayau tatra yatra rājā suyodhanaḥ,
8.56.22: viddhvā nanāda pāñcālyaṁ ṣaṣṭyā pañcabhireva ca,
tathāsya saśaraṁ cāpaṁ hastāvāpaṁ ca māriṣa ॥22॥
8.56.26: te varma hemavikr̥taṁ bhittvā rājñaḥ śilāśitāḥ ॥26॥
8.56.32: tato duryodhanasyāśvān hatvā sūtaṁ ca pañcabhiḥ ॥32॥
8.56.33: rathaṁ sopaskaraṁ chatraṁ śaktiṁ khaḍgaṁ gadāṁ dhvajam ॥33॥
8.56.40: na pāṇḍavānāṁ nāsmākaṁ yodhaḥ kaścit parāṅmukhaḥ ॥40॥
8.56.43: te sarve’bhyadravan karṇaṁ patatriṇa iva drumam,
8.56.45: śuklaṁ ca rocamānaṁ ca siṁhasenaṁ ca durjayam,
8.56.48: jiṣṇuṁ ca jiṣṇukarmāṇaṁ devāpiṁ bhadrameva ca ॥48॥
8.56.49: daṇḍaṁ ca rājan samare citraṁ citrāyudhaṁ harim,
8.56.54: naivaṁ bhīṣmo na ca droṇo nānye yudhi ca tāvakāḥ ॥54॥
8.56.55: cakruḥ sma tādr̥śaṁ karma yādr̥śaṁ vai kr̥taṁ raṇe,
sūtaputreṇa nāgeṣu hayeṣu ca ratheṣu ca ॥55॥
8.56.56: nareṣu ca mahārāja kr̥taṁ sma kadanaṁ mahat,
8.56.58: siṁhāsyaṁ ca yathā prāpya na jīvanti mr̥gāḥ kvacit ॥58॥
8.56.59: vaiśvānaraṁ yathā prāpya pratidahyanti vai janāḥ ॥59॥
8.56.60: karṇāgninā raṇe tadvad dagdhā bhārata sr̥ñjayāḥ,
8.56.61: mama cāsīnmatī rājan dr̥ṣṭvā karṇasya vikramam ॥61॥
8.56.62: pañcālān vyadhamat saṅkhye sūtaputraḥ punaḥ punaḥ ॥62॥
8.56.68: tādr̥g yādr̥k purā vr̥ttaṁ devānāṁ dānavaiḥ saha ॥68॥
8.56.73: śerate yudhi nirbhinnā vamanto rudhiraṁ bahu,
8.56.76: niśceṣṭaṁ tumulaṁ dīnaṁ babhau tasmin mahāraṇe ॥76॥
8.56.77: prasannasalile kāle yathā syāt sāgaro nr̥pa,
tadvat tava balaṁ tad vai niścalaṁ samavasthitam ॥77॥
8.56.78: abhavat tava putrasya tat sainyaṁ niṣprabhaṁ tadā ॥78॥
8.56.84: dīryate ca mahat sainyaṁ sr̥ñjayānāṁ mahāraṇe ॥84॥
8.56.85: hastikakṣo hyasau kr̥ṣṇa ketuḥ karṇasya dhīmataḥ,
8.56.86: na ca karṇaṁ raṇe śaktā jetumanye mahārathāḥ,
jānīte hi bhavān karṇaṁ vīryavantaṁ parākrame ॥86॥
8.56.87: tatra yāhi yataḥ karṇo drāvayatyeṣa no balam,
8.56.88: etanme rocate kr̥ṣṇa yathā vā tava rocate,
8.56.94: kruddhau tau tu naravyāghrau vegavantau babhūvatuḥ ॥94॥
8.56.96: taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā yudhi vikrāntaṁ senāyāṁ tava bhārata ॥96॥
8.56.105: mahī viyad diśaḥ sarvāḥ samudrā girayo’pi vā,
8.56.108: śastraṁ pāṇiṁ tathā bāhuṁ tathāpi ca śirāṁsyuta ॥108॥
8.56.118: tasmin prapakṣe pakṣe ca nihate savyasācinā,
8.56.122: sa dr̥ṣṭvaiva tu dāśārhaṁ syandanasthaṁ viśāmpate,
8.56.127: na mayā tādr̥śo rājan dr̥ṣṭapūrvaḥ parākramaḥ,
8.56.128: aśrauṣaṁ bahuśo rājan siṁhasya ninado yathā ॥128॥
8.56.130: sa tathā kṣiprakārī ca dr̥ḍhahastaśca pāṇḍavaḥ,
pramohaṁ paramaṁ gatvā prekṣya taṁ droṇajaṁ tataḥ ॥130॥
8.56.131: vikramaṁ vihataṁ mena ātmanaḥ sa mahāyaśāḥ,
8.56.133: hīyamāne ca kaunteye kr̥ṣṇe roṣaḥ samāviśat,
8.56.134: drauṇiṁ hyapaśyat saṅgrāme phālgunaṁ ca muhurmuhuḥ,
tataḥ kruddho’bravīt kr̥ṣṇaḥ pārthaṁ sapraṇayaṁ tadā ॥134॥
8.56.135: atiśete hi yatra tvāṁ droṇaputro’dya bhārata ॥135॥
8.56.136: kaccid vīryaṁ yathāpūrvaṁ bhujayorvā balaṁ tava,
kaccit te gāṇḍivaṁ haste rathe tiṣṭhasi cārjuna ॥136॥
8.56.137: kaccit kuśalinau bāhū muṣṭirvā na vyaśīryata,
8.56.138: upekṣāṁ kuru mā pārtha nāyaṁ kāla upekṣitum ॥138॥
8.56.140: dhvajaṁ chatraṁ patākāśca khaḍgaṁ śaktiṁ gadāṁ tathā,
8.56.141: sa mūrcchāṁ paramāṁ gatvā dhvajayaṣṭiṁ samāśritaḥ,
8.56.144: krūro viśasano ghoro rājan durmantrite tava ॥144॥
8.57.3: sadr̥śauḥ kṣatriyaiḥ śūraiḥ śūrāṇāṁ yuddhyatāṁ yudhi,
8.57.8: satyaṁ vaḥ pratijānāmi tad vākyaṁ me nibodhata ॥8॥
8.57.10: arjuno bhīmasenaśca yodho yo rakṣitā raṇe,
8.58.1: kruddhe’rjune tathā karṇe bhīmasene ca pāṇḍave ॥1॥
8.58.3: paśya kr̥ṣṇa mahābāho dravantīṁ pāṇḍavīṁ camūm,
karṇaṁ paśya ca saṅgrāme kālayantaṁ mahārathān ॥3॥
8.58.4: na ca paśyāmi dāśārha dharmarājaṁ yudhiṣṭhiram,
8.58.5: na ca māṁ dhārtarāṣṭreṣu kaccid yudhyati saṁyuge ॥5॥
8.58.6: tasmāt tvaṁ matpriyaṁ kurvan yāhi yatra yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
8.58.38: saṁnivr̥ttāśca te śūrāstān vai dr̥ṣṭvā vicetasaḥ ॥38॥
8.58.39: jalaṁ pītvā mr̥tān paśya pibato’nyāṁśca māriṣa ॥39॥
8.58.42: evaṁ bruvaṁstadā kr̥ṣṇo yayau yatra yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
8.58.43: tāṁ yuddhabhūmiṁ pārthasya darśayitvā ca mādhavaḥ ॥43॥
8.58.45: asau bhīmo maheṣvāsaḥ saṁnivr̥tto raṇaṁ prati ॥45॥
8.58.46: pāñcālasr̥ñjayānāṁ ca pāṇḍavānāṁ ca ye mukham ॥46॥
8.58.48: asau gacchati kauravya drauṇiḥ śastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ ॥48॥
8.58.49: anuprayāti saṅgrāme hatān paśya ca sr̥ñjayān ॥49॥
8.58.51: ubhayoḥ senayo rājan mr̥tyuṁ kr̥tvā nivartanam ॥51॥
8.58.52: tāvakānāṁ pareṣāṁ ca rājan durmantrite tava ॥52॥
8.59.6: samāsādya tu te karṇaṁ vyaśīryanta mahārathāḥ,
8.59.8: vijayaṁ ca dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṁ vidhunvāno mahārathaḥ ॥8॥
8.59.10: te varma hemavikr̥taṁ bhittvā tasya mahātmanaḥ,
8.59.16: dr̥ṣṭvā vinihataṁ bāṇaṁ śaraiḥ karṇo viśāmpate,
8.59.18: āsīd ghoraṁ ca citraṁ ca prekṣaṇīyaṁ samantataḥ ॥18॥
8.59.21: tiṣṭha tiṣṭhādya brahmaghna na me jīvan vimokṣyase ॥21॥
8.59.23: yathā hi samare droṇaḥ pārṣataṁ vīkṣya māriṣa ॥23॥
8.59.24: tathā drauṇiṁ raṇe dr̥ṣṭvā pārṣataḥ paravīrahā,
8.59.27: tāvanyonyaṁ tu dr̥ṣṭvaiva saṁrambhaṁ jagmatuḥ param,
8.59.29: pāpaṁ hi yat tvayā karma ghnatā droṇaṁ purā kr̥tam,
adya tvāṁ tapsyate tad vai yathā na kuśalaṁ tathā ॥29॥
8.59.30: nāpakrāmasi vā mūḍha satyametad bravīmi te ॥30॥
8.59.33: tvāmidānīṁ kathaṁ yuddhe na haniṣyāmi vikramāt,
8.59.35: naivāntarikṣaṁ na diśo nāpi yodhāḥ samantataḥ ॥35॥
8.59.40: sa pārṣatasya rājendra dhanuḥ śaktiṁ gadāṁ dhvajam ॥40॥
8.59.41: hayān sūtaṁ rathaṁ caiva nimeṣād vyadhamaccharaiḥ,
8.59.48: paśya pārtha yathā drauṇiḥ pārṣatasya vadhaṁ prati,
yatnaṁ karoti vipulaṁ hanyāccainaṁ na saṁśayaḥ ॥48॥
8.59.53: śarāṁścikṣepa vai pārtho drauṇiṁ prati mahābalaḥ ॥53॥
8.59.56: pragr̥hya ca dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṁ pārthaṁ vivyādha sāyakaiḥ ॥56॥
8.59.61: niṣasāda rathopasthe vaiklavyaṁ ca paraṁ yayau,
tataḥ karṇo mahārāja vyākṣipad vijayaṁ dhanuḥ ॥61॥
8.59.63: vihvalaṁ taṁ tu vīkṣyātha droṇaputraṁ ca sārathiḥ,
8.59.64: mokṣitaṁ pārṣataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā droṇaputraṁ ca pīḍitam ॥64॥
8.59.66: yāhi saṁśaptakān kr̥ṣṇa kāryametat paraṁ mama ॥66॥
8.60.14: karṇena ca kr̥to rājā vimukhaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ,
8.60.16: anyairapi ca pārthasya hr̥taṁ varma mahārathaiḥ ॥16॥
8.60.17: brāhme bale sthito hyeṣa na kṣātre hi bale vibhuḥ ॥17॥
8.60.19: na jīvati mahārājo manye pārtha yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
8.60.23: āturo hi kr̥to rājā saṁniṣevyaśca bhārata,
8.60.25: na keturdr̥śyate rājñaḥ karṇena nihataḥ śaraiḥ,
8.60.26: pañcālānāṁ ca sarveṣāṁ cedīnāṁ caiva bhārata ॥26॥
8.60.28: paśya paśya yathā pārtha gacchantyete mahārathāḥ ॥28॥
8.60.31: hastikakṣyāṁ raṇe paśya carantīṁ tatra tatra ha,
8.60.33: etān paśya ca pañcālān drāvyamāṇān mahārathān,
8.60.34: eṣa karṇo raṇe jitvā pañcālān pāṇḍusr̥ñjayān,
8.60.35: paśya pārtha dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṁ vikarṣan sādhu śobhate,
śatruṁ jitvā yathā śakro devasaṅghaiḥ samāvr̥taḥ ॥35॥
8.60.36: ete nardanti kauravyā dr̥ṣṭvā karṇasya vikramam,
8.60.38: abhidravata bhadraṁ vo drutaṁ dravata kauravāḥ,
yathā jīvanna vaḥ kaścinmucyeta yudhi sr̥ñjayaḥ ॥38॥
8.60.39: tathā kuruta saṁyattā vayaṁ yāsyāma pr̥ṣṭhataḥ,
evamuktvā gato hyeṣa pr̥ṣṭhato vikiran śarān ॥39॥
8.60.42: eṣa tvāṁ prekṣate karṇaḥ sakaṭākṣaṁ viśāmpate,
8.60.43: paśya hyenaṁ mahābāho vidhunvānaṁ mahad dhanuḥ,
8.60.44: asau nivr̥tto rādheyo dr̥ṣṭvā te vānaradhvajam,
prārthayan samare pārtha tvayā saha parantapa ॥44॥
8.60.47: tvayā yaśaśca rājyaṁ ca sukhaṁ cottamamicchatā,
8.60.48: paśyantu kauravāḥ sarve tava pārtha parākramam ॥48॥
8.60.49: tvāṁ ca dr̥ṣṭvātisaṁrabdhaṁ karṇaṁ ca bharatarṣabha,
8.60.51: āryāṁ yuddhe matiṁ kr̥tvā pratyehi rathayūthapam,
8.60.57: ācakṣe ca priyaṁ pārtha tavedaṁ bharatarṣabha ॥57॥
8.60.59: vadhyanta ete samare kauravā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥59॥
8.60.62: nivr̥ttaṁ paśya kaunteya bhīmasenaṁ yudhāṁ patim ॥62॥
8.60.68: ete nardanti pañcālā dhyāpayanti ca vārijān ॥68॥
8.60.69: abhidravanti ca raṇe mr̥dnantaḥ sāyakeḥ parān,
paśyasvaiṣāṁ ca māhātmyaṁ pañcālā hi parākramāt ॥69॥
8.60.70: dhārtarāṣṭrān vinighnanti kruddhāḥ siṁhā iva dvipān,
8.60.72: rathanāgahayā vīrā yaśasyāḥ sarva eva ca,
8.60.87: na śaknuvanti vai pārthaṁ pārthivāḥ samudīkṣitum,
8.60.88: śaraiḥ santrāsitāḥ saṅkhye na labhante sukhaṁ kvacit ॥88॥
8.60.88d2: varjayitvā tu bhīmaṁ taṁ pārśvato hyānayan dhanuḥ,
8.60.89: bhīmasenena tat karma kr̥taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā suduṣkaram ॥89॥
8.60.91: prabhagnāḥ samare bhītā diśo daśa mahābalāḥ,
8.61.1: nivr̥tte bhīmasene ca pāṇḍave ca yudhiṣṭhire,
8.61.4: tāvakaṁ tu balaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhīmasenāt parāṅmukham,
8.61.11: śikhaṇḍī ca yayau karṇaṁ dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaḥ sutaṁ tava,
8.61.13: arjunaṁ ca raṇe yatto droṇaputro mahārathaḥ ॥13॥
8.61.15: bhīmasenaḥ kurūn sarvān putrāṁśca tava māriṣa,
8.61.18: dhārayaṁstu sa tān bāṇān śikhaṇḍī bahvaśobhata,
8.61.19: karṇaṁ vivyādha samare navatyā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥19॥
8.61.20: tasya karṇo hayān hatvā sārathiṁ ca tribhiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.61.26: tasya duḥśāsano bāhuṁ savyaṁ vivyādha māriṣa,
8.61.30: tataḥ sa pārṣataḥ kruddho dhanuściccheda māriṣa,
8.61.32: tava putrasya te dr̥ṣṭvā vikramaṁ sumahātmanaḥ,
8.61.35: tataḥ pravavr̥te yuddhaṁ tāvakānāṁ paraiḥ saha,
8.61.38: śatruṁ vivyādha viṁśatyā sa ca taṁ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥38॥
8.61.40: sa dr̥ṣṭvā pradrutāṁ senāṁ dhārtarāṣṭrasya sūtajaḥ,
8.61.41: nivr̥tte tu tataḥ karṇe nakulaḥ kauravān yayau,
8.61.45: sātyakiḥ śakuniṁ viddhvā viṁśatyā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.61.46: vidārya kavacaṁ bhūyo dhvajaṁ ciccheda kāñcanam ॥46॥
8.61.53: cakre lokeśvaraṁ tatra tenātuṣyanta vai janāḥ,
8.61.58: yādr̥śaṁ na mayā yuddhaṁ dr̥ṣṭapūrvaṁ viśāmpate ॥58॥
8.61.67: te vadhyamānā bhīmena gajā rājan vidudruvuḥ ॥67॥
8.62.2: tad balaṁ nr̥patiśreṣṭha tāvakaṁ vijayo raṇe,
8.62.9: tāṁstu sarvān maheṣvāsān karṇo vaikartano nr̥pa ॥9॥
8.62.14: dr̥ṣṭvā tava sutaṁ tatra gāḍhaviddhaṁ sutejanaiḥ ॥14॥
8.62.15: abhyadhāvad dr̥ḍhaṁ kruddho rādheyo rathināṁ varaḥ,
8.62.19: tato daśa diśaḥ karṇaḥ śalabhairiva yāyibhiḥ ॥19॥
8.62.26: yatra yatra sa dharmātmā duṣṭāṁ dr̥ṣṭiṁ vyasarjayat,
8.62.29: yudhiṣṭhiraścāpi sa taṁ svarṇapuṅkhaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.62.30: sa pīḍito bhr̥śaṁ tena dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥30॥
8.63.3: aviṣahyaṁ tato dr̥ṣṭvā rādheyaṁ yudhi yodhinaḥ,
8.63.20: tataḥ śalyaḥ prahasyedaṁ karṇaṁ punaruvāca ha ॥20॥
8.63.22: taṁ pārthaṁ jahi rādheya kiṁ te hatvā yudhiṣṭhiram,
8.63.22d1: hate hyasmin dhruvaṁ pārthaḥ sarvāñjeṣyati no rathān,
tasmin hi dhārtarāṣṭrasya nihate tu dhruvo jayaḥ.
8.63.22d2: enaṁ jahi mahābāho kiṁ te hatvā yudhiṣṭhiram.
8.63.24: sarvāṁ grasati naḥ senāṁ karṇa paśyainamāhave,
8.63.25: uttaraṁ cāsya vai śūraścakraṁ rakṣati sātyakiḥ,
8.63.26: yathā na hanyāttaṁ bhīmaḥ sarveṣāṁ no’dya paśyatām ॥26॥
8.63.27: tathā rādheya kriyatāṁ rājā mucyeta no yathā,
8.63.28: yadi tvāsādya mucyeta vismayaḥ sumahān bhavet,
8.63.29: kiṁ nu mādrīsutau hatvā rājānaṁ ca yudhiṣṭhiram,
8.63.32: gate karṇe tu kaunteyaḥ pāṇḍuputro yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥32॥
8.63.35d1: gacchatāṁ tvaritau vīrau yatra bhīmo vyavasthitaḥ.
8.63.36: jīmūta iva nardaṁstu yudhyate sa vr̥kodaraḥ ॥36॥
8.64.1: apatat sahasā rājan yatra pārtho vyavasthitaḥ ॥1॥
8.64.4: avacchannau tataḥ kr̥ṣṇau dr̥ṣṭvā tatra mahārathāḥ,
8.64.11: drauṇerapahatān saṅkhye dadr̥śuḥ sa ca tāṁ tathā,
8.64.12: tayostu vyākule yuddhe drauṇeḥ pārthasya dāruṇe,
8.64.14: pārthena samare rājan kr̥to ghoro janakṣayaḥ,
8.64.19: sañchādya samare drauṇiṁ cicchedāsya ca kārmukam ॥19॥
8.64.22: sa papāta tadā bhūmau nikr̥ttaḥ pārthasāyakaiḥ,
vikīrṇaḥ parvato rājan yathā vajreṇa tāḍitaḥ ॥22॥
8.64.28: sa viddhvā marmasu drauṇiṁ pāṇḍavaḥ paravīrahā,
8.64.29: sa saṅgr̥hya svayaṁ vāhān kr̥ṣṇau prācchādayaccharaiḥ,
8.64.30: yadasya samare rājan sarve yodhā apūjayan ॥30॥
8.64.33: pāṇḍavāstu jayaṁ labdhvā tava sainyaṁ samādravan,
8.64.37: abhavad vyākulaṁ bhītaṁ putrāṇāṁ te mahad balam ॥37॥
8.64.38: tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti ca tataḥ sūtaputrasya jalpataḥ,
8.64.44: adya hanmi raṇe sarvān pañcālān pāṇḍubhiḥ saha ॥44॥
8.64.46: pragr̥hya vijayaṁ vīro dhanuḥ śreṣṭhaṁ purātanam,
sajyaṁ kr̥tvā mahārāja saṅgr̥hya ca punaḥ punaḥ ॥46॥
8.64.47: saṁnivārya ca yodhān sa satyena śapathena ca,
8.64.49: sañchannā pāṇḍavī senā na prājñāyata kiñcana ॥49॥
8.64.53: karṇastveko yudhāṁ śreṣṭho vidhūma iva pāvakaḥ,
dahan śatrūn naravyāghra śuśubhe sa parantapaḥ ॥53॥
8.64.54: tatra tatra vyamuhyanta vanadāhe yathā dvipāḥ ॥54॥
8.64.56: dhāvatāṁ ca tato rājaṁstrastānāṁ ca samantataḥ,
8.64.58: arjunaṁ vāsudevaṁ ca krośanti ca muhurmuhuḥ ॥58॥
8.64.59: śrutvā tu ninadaṁ teṣāṁ vadhyatāṁ karṇasāyakaiḥ ॥59॥
8.64.61: naitadastraṁ hi samare śakyaṁ hantuṁ kathañcana ॥61॥
8.64.62: sūtaputraṁ ca saṁrabdhaṁ paśya kr̥ṣṇa mahāraṇe,
8.64.63: na ca paśyāmi samare karṇaṁ prati palāyitum ॥63॥
8.64.64: mr̥tasya tu hr̥ṣīkeśa bhaṅga eva kuto jayaḥ ॥64॥
8.64.66: karṇena hi dr̥ḍhaṁ rājā kuntīputraḥ parikṣitaḥ,
taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā’’śvāsya ca punaḥ karṇaṁ pārtha vadhiṣyasi ॥66॥
8.64.70: yuddhaṁ kr̥tvā tu kaunteyo droṇaputreṇa bhārata,
duḥsahaṁ vajriṇā saṅkhye parājitya guroḥ sutam ॥70॥
8.65.15: tato yayau hr̥ṣīkeśo yatra rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
8.65.16: sandiśya caitaṁ rājendra yuddhaṁ prati vr̥kodaram ॥16॥
8.65.19: hate mahāsure jambhe śakraviṣṇū yathā guruḥ ॥19॥
8.65.22: mahāsattvau hi tau dr̥ṣṭvā sahitau keśavārjunau,
8.65.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate karṇaparvaṇi yudhiṣṭhiraṁ prati śrīkr̥ṣṇārjunāgame pañcaṣaṣṭitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥65॥
8.66.3: agragaṁ dhārtarāṣṭrāṇāṁ sarveṣāṁ śarma varma ca,
8.66.8: antakaṁ mama mitrāṇāṁ hatvā karṇaṁ mahāmr̥dhe,
8.66.10: tena ketuśca me chinno hatau ca pārṣṇisārathī,
8.66.13: abhisr̥tya ca māṁ yuddhe paruṣāṇyuktavān bahu,
tatra tatra yudhāṁ śreṣṭha paribhūya na saṁśayaḥ ॥13॥
8.66.15: na sma nidrāṁ labhe rātrī na cāhani sukhaṁ kvacit ॥15॥
8.66.16: ātmano maraṇe yāto vādhrīṇasa iva dvipaḥ ॥16॥
8.66.17: kathaṁ karṇo mayā śakyo yuddhe kṣapayituṁ bhavet ॥17॥
8.66.19: yatra yatra hi gacchāmi karṇād bhīto dhanañjaya,
tatra tatra hi paśyāmi karṇamevāgrataḥ sthitam ॥19॥
8.66.20: sahayaḥ sarathaḥ pārtha jitvā jīvan visarjitaḥ ॥20॥
8.66.21: ko nu me jīvitenārtho rājyenārtho bhavet punaḥ,
8.66.22: na prāptapūrvaṁ yad bhīṣmāt kr̥padroṇācca saṁyuge,
8.66.23: sa tvāṁ pr̥cchāmi kaunteya yathādya kuśalaṁ tathā,
8.66.27: tava mr̥tyuṁ raṇe karṇaṁ manyate puruṣarṣabha ॥27॥
8.66.28: sa tvayā puruṣavyāghra kathaṁ yuddhe niṣūditaḥ,
8.66.29: yudhyamānasya ca śiraḥ paśyatāṁ suhr̥dāṁ hr̥tam,
8.66.33: sadā raṇe spardhate yaḥ sa pāpaḥ
8.67.15: śrutvā tu tvāṁ tena dr̥ṣṭaṁ sameta-
8.67.22: āmantraye tvāṁ brūhi jayaṁ raṇe me
8.68.6: na vai kr̥taṁ tacca tathaiva vīra,
8.68.30: kr̥śānudattaṁ ca rathaṁ ca dhik te ॥30॥
8.69.2: uvāca kimidaṁ pārtha gr̥hītaḥ khaḍga ityuta ॥2॥
8.69.3: na hi paśyāmi yoddhavyaṁ tvayā kiñcid dhanañjaya,
te grastā dhārtarāṣṭrā hi bhīmasenena dhīmatā ॥3॥
8.69.4: sa rājā bhavatā dr̥ṣṭaḥ kuśalī ca yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥4॥
8.69.6: na taṁ paśyāmi kaunteya yaste vadhyo bhaviṣyati,
prahartumicchase kasmāt kiṁ vā te cittavibhramaḥ ॥6॥
8.69.7: tat tvāṁ pr̥cchāmi kaunteya kimidaṁ te cikīrṣitam ॥7॥
8.69.9: arjunaḥ prāha govindaṁ kruddhaḥ sarpa iva śvasan,
8.69.11: samakṣaṁ tava govinda na tat kṣantumihotsahe,
8.69.14: kiṁ vā tvaṁ manyase prāptamasmin kāla upasthite,
8.69.15: tat tathā prakariṣyāmi yathā māṁ vakṣyate bhavān,
8.69.16: idānīṁ pārtha jānāmi na vr̥ddhāḥ sevitāstvayā,
kāle na puruṣavyāghra saṁrambhaṁ yad bhavānagāt ॥16॥
8.69.18: akāryāṇāṁ kriyāṇāṁ ca saṁyogaṁ yaḥ karoti vai,
8.69.20: avaśo muhyate pārtha yathā tvaṁ mūḍha eva tu ॥20॥
8.69.21: na hi kāryamakāryaṁ vā sukhaṁ jñātuṁ kathañcana,
śrutena jñāyate sarvaṁ tacca tvaṁ nāvabudhyase ॥21॥
8.69.22: avijñānād bhavān yacca dharmaṁ rakṣati dharmavit,
prāṇināṁ tvaṁ vadhaṁ pārtha dhārmiko nāvabudhyase ॥22॥
8.69.23: anr̥tāṁ vā vaded vācaṁ na tu hiṁsyāt kathañcana ॥23॥
8.69.24: sa kathaṁ bhrātaraṁ jyeṣṭhaṁ rājānaṁ dharmakovidam,
8.69.26: na vadhaḥ pūjyate sadbhistacca sarvaṁ gurau tava ॥26॥
8.69.27: tvayā caivaṁ vrataṁ pārtha bāleneva kr̥taṁ purā,
8.69.28: sa guruṁ pārtha kasmāt tvaṁ hantukāmo’bhidhāvasi,
8.69.29: idaṁ dharmarahasyaṁ ca tava vakṣyāmi pāṇḍava,
yad brūyāt tava bhīṣmo hi pāṇḍavo vā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥29॥
8.69.30: viduro vā tathā kṣattā kuntī vāpi yaśasvinī,
tat te vakṣyāmi tattvena nibodhaitad dhanañjaya ॥30॥
8.69.31: satyasya vacanaṁ sādhu na satyād vidyate param,
8.69.32: yatrānr̥taṁ bhavet satyaṁ satyaṁ cāpyanr̥taṁ bhavet ॥32॥
8.69.34: tatrānr̥taṁ bhavet satyaṁ satyaṁ cāpyanr̥taṁ bhavet ॥34॥
8.69.39: purā vyādho’bhavat kaścid balāko nāma bhārata,
yātrārthaṁ putradārasya mr̥gān hanti na kāmataḥ ॥39॥
8.69.42: adr̥ṣṭapūrvamapi tat sattvaṁ tena hataṁ tadā,
andhe hate tato vyomnaḥ puṣpavarṣaṁ papāta ca ॥42॥
8.69.47: satyaṁ mayā sadā vācyamiti tasyābhavad vratam,
8.69.48: atha dasyubhayāt kecit tadā tad vanamāviśan,
8.69.49: katamena pathā yātā bhagavan bahavo janāḥ ॥49॥
8.69.50: satyena pr̥ṣṭaḥ prabrūhi yadi tān vettha śaṁsa naḥ,
sa pr̥ṣṭaḥ kauśikaḥ satyaṁ vacanaṁ tānuvāca ha ॥50॥
8.69.51: iti tān khyāpayāmāsa tebhyastattvaṁ sa kauśikaḥ ॥51॥
8.69.52: tataste tān samāsādya krūrā jaghnuriti śrutiḥ,
8.69.55: śruterdharma iti hyeke vadanti bahavo janāḥ ॥55॥
8.69.56: tat te na pratyasūyāmi na ca sarvaṁ vidhīyate,
8.69.57: yat syādahiṁsāsaṁyuktaṁ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ,
8.69.58: yat syād dhāraṇasaṁyuktaṁ sa dharma iti niścayaḥ ॥58॥
8.69.61: yaḥ kāryebhyo vrataṁ kr̥tvā tasya nānopapādayet,
8.69.62: narmaṇyabhipravr̥tte vā na ca proktaṁ mr̥ṣā bhavet ॥62॥
8.69.64: na ca tebhyo dhanaṁ deyaṁ śakye sati kathañcana ॥64॥
8.69.65: pāpebhyo hi dhanaṁ dattaṁ dātāramapi pīḍayet,
8.69.67: etacchrutvā brūhi pārtha yadi vadhyo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
8.69.68: hitaṁ caiva yathāsmākaṁ tathaitad vacanaṁ tava,
8.69.69: gatiśca paramā kr̥ṣṇa tvameva ca parāyaṇam,
na hi te triṣu lokeṣu vidyate’viditaṁ kvacit ॥69॥
8.69.70: tasmād bhavān paraṁ dharmaṁ veda sarvaṁ yathātatham,
8.69.71: idaṁ vā paramatraiva śr̥ṇu hr̥tsthaṁ vivakṣitam ॥71॥
8.69.86: avadhena vadhaḥ prokto yad gurustvamiti prabhuḥ,
tad brūhi tvaṁ yanmayoktaṁ dharmarājasya dharmavit ॥86॥
8.70.7: na tvaṁ nityaṁ rakṣyase yaḥ suhr̥dbhiḥ ॥7॥
8.70.13: tvattaḥ sukhaṁ na vayaṁ vidma kiñcit ॥13॥
8.70.19: tvayā hi tat karma kr̥taṁ nr̥śaṁsaṁ
8.70.27: dharmād bhītastat kathaṁ nāma te syāt
8.70.33: pādau ca me sarathau sadhvajau ca
8.70.37: kuntī vātho vā mayā tena vāpi,
8.70.43: kr̥taṁ mayā pārtha yathā na sādhu
8.70.45: kiṁ te ciraṁ me hyanusr̥tya rūkṣam,
8.70.51: tataḥ satyāṁ pratijñāṁ tāṁ pārthena pratirakṣatā,
8.70.52: tasmāt tvaṁ vai mahābāho mama pārthasya cobhayoḥ ॥52॥
8.70.53: śaraṇaṁ tvāṁ mahārāja prapannau sva ubhāvapi ॥53॥
8.70.55: satyaṁ te pratijānāmi hataṁ viddhyadya sūtajam,
8.71.2: babhūva vimanāḥ pārthaḥ kiñcit kr̥tveva pātakam ॥2॥
8.71.3: kathaṁ nāma bhavedetad yadi tvaṁ pārtha dharmajam ॥3॥
8.71.5: hatvā tu nr̥patiṁ pārtha akariṣyaḥ kimuttaram,
8.71.6: narakaṁ ghorarūpaṁ ca bhrāturjyeṣṭhasya vai vadhāt ॥6॥
8.71.7: sa tvaṁ dharmabhr̥tāṁ śreṣṭhaṁ rājānaṁ dharmasaṁhitam,
8.71.8: prasādya bhaktyā rājānaṁ prīte caiva yudhiṣṭhire,
8.71.9: hatvā tu samare karṇaṁ tvamadya niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.71.10: evaṁ kr̥te kr̥taṁ caiva tava kāryaṁ bhaviṣyati ॥10॥
8.71.12: kṣamasva rājan yatra proktaṁ dharmakāmena bhīruṇā ॥12॥
8.71.13: dr̥ṣṭvā tu patitaṁ padbhyāṁ dharmarājo yudhiṣṭhiraḥ,
8.71.16: tata āśliṣya taṁ premṇā mūrdhni cāghrāya pāṇḍavaḥ,
prītyā paramayā yukto vismayaṁśca punaḥ punaḥ ॥16॥
8.71.18: kavacaṁ ca dhvajaṁ caiva dhanuḥ śaktirhayāḥ śarāḥ,
8.71.19: so’haṁ jñātvā raṇe tasya karma dr̥ṣṭvā ca phālguna,
vyavasīdāmi duḥkhena na ca me jīvitaṁ priyam ॥19॥
8.71.20: na cedadya hi taṁ vīraṁ nihaniṣyasi saṁyuge,
prāṇāneva parityakṣye jīvitārtho hi ko mama ॥20॥
8.71.21: satyena te śape rājan prasādena tathaiva ca,
bhīmena ca naraśreṣṭha yamābhyāṁ ca mahīpate ॥21॥
8.71.22: yathādya samare karṇaṁ haniṣyāmi hato’pi vā,
8.71.23: adya karṇaṁ raṇe kr̥ṣṇa sūdayiṣye na saṁśayaḥ ॥23॥
8.71.24: tava buddhyā hi bhadraṁ te vadhastasya durātmanaḥ,
8.71.25: eṣa cāpi hi me kāmo nityameva mahāratha ॥25॥
8.71.26: kathaṁ bhavān raṇe karṇaṁ nihanyāditi sattama,
8.71.29: diṣṭyāsi rājan na hato diṣṭyā na grahaṇaṁ gataḥ,
8.71.30: ehyehi pārtha bībhatso māṁ pariṣvaja pāṇḍava,
vaktavyamukto’smi hitaṁ tvayā kṣāntaṁ ca tanmayā ॥30॥
8.71.31: manyuṁ ca mā kr̥thāḥ pārtha yanmayokto’si dāruṇam ॥31॥
8.71.33: tamutthāpya tato rājā pariṣvajya ca pīḍitam,
8.71.34: māhātmyaṁ vijayaṁ caiva bhūyaḥ prāpnuhi śāśvatam ॥34॥
8.71.35: adya taṁ pāpakarmāṇaṁ sānubandhaṁ raṇe śaraiḥ,
8.71.38: iti satyena te pādau spr̥śāmi jagatīpate ॥38॥
8.72.2: kalpatāṁ me ratho bhūyo yujyantāṁ ca hayottamāḥ,
āyudhāni ca sarvāṇi sajjantāṁ me mahārathe ॥2॥
8.72.5: uvāca dārukaṁ kr̥ṣṇaḥ kuru sarvaṁ yathābravīt,
8.72.7: yuktaṁ tu taṁ rathaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā dārukeṇa mahātmanā ॥7॥
8.72.8: āpr̥cchya dharmarājānaṁ brāhmaṇān svasti vācya ca,
8.72.9: āśiṣo’yuṅkta sa tataḥ prāyāt karṇarathaṁ prati ॥9॥
8.72.12: bahavaḥ pakṣiṇo rājan punnāmānaḥ śubhāḥ śivāḥ ॥12॥
8.72.13: kaṅkā gr̥dhrā bakāḥ śyenā vāyasāśca viśāmpate ॥13॥
8.72.16: cintā ca vipulā jajñe kathaṁ cedaṁ bhaviṣyati,
8.72.17: dr̥ṣṭvā pārthaṁ tathā yāntaṁ cintāparigataṁ tadā,
gāṇḍīvadhanvan saṅgrāme ye tvayā dhanuṣā jitāḥ ॥17॥
8.72.18: na teṣāṁ mānuṣo jetā tvadanya iha vidyate,
8.72.19: tvāṁ prāpya samare śūraṁ te gatāḥ paramāṁ gatim,
ko hi droṇaṁ ca bhīṣmaṁ ca bhagadattaṁ ca māriṣa ॥19॥
8.72.20: pratyudgamya bhavet kṣemī yo na syāt tvamiva prabho ॥20॥
8.72.21: tava hyastrāṇi divyāni lāghavaṁ balameva ca,
8.72.22: bhavān devān sagandharvān hanyāt saha carācarān ॥22॥
8.72.23: pr̥thivyāṁ tu raṇe pārtha na yoddhā tvatsamaḥ pumān,
dhanurgrāhā hi ye kecit kṣatriyā yuddhadurmadāḥ ॥23॥
8.72.24: ā devāt tvatsamaṁ teṣāṁ na paśyāmi śr̥ṇomi ca,
brahmaṇā ca prajāḥ sr̥ṣṭvā gāṇḍīvaṁ ca mahad dhanuḥ ॥24॥
8.72.25: yena tvaṁ yudhyase pārtha tasmānnāsti tvayā samaḥ,
avaśyaṁ tu mayā vācyaṁ yat pathyaṁ tava pāṇḍava ॥25॥
8.72.26: karṇo hi balavān dr̥ptaḥ kr̥tāstraśca mahārathaḥ ॥26॥
8.72.27: kr̥tī ca citrayodhī ca deśakālasya kovidaḥ,
8.72.28: tvatsamaṁ tvadviśiṣṭaṁ vā karṇaṁ manye mahāratham,
8.72.32: r̥te tvāmiti me buddhistadadya jahi sūtajam ॥32॥
8.72.33: aśakyaḥ sa ratho jetuṁ sarvairapi yuyutsabhiḥ ॥33॥
8.72.37: ātmānaṁ manyate vīraṁ yena pāpaḥ suyodhanaḥ,
tamadya mūlaṁ pāpānāṁ jahi sautiṁ dhanañjaya ॥37॥
8.72.39: ahaṁ tvāmanujānāmi vīryeṇa ca balena ca,
jahi karṇaṁ raṇe śūra mātaṅgamiva kesarī ॥39॥
8.72.40: tamadya pārtha saṅgrāme karṇaṁ vaikartanaṁ jahi ॥40॥
8.73.3: bhūtvā hi vipulā senā tāvakānāṁ paraiḥ saha,
8.73.4: tvāṁ vai śatruṁ samāsādya vinaṣṭā raṇamūrdhani ॥4॥
8.73.7: ko hi śakto raṇe jetuṁ kauravāṁstāta saṁyuge,
anyatra pāṇḍavān yuddhe tvayā guptān mahārathān ॥7॥
8.73.8: trīllom̐kān samare yuktān kiṁ punaḥ kauravaṁ balam ॥8॥
8.73.9: bhagadattaṁ ca rājānaṁ ko’nyaḥ śaktastvayā vinā,
8.73.10: tathemāṁ vipulāṁ senāṁ guptāṁ pārtha tvayānagha,
na śekuḥ pārthivāḥ sarve cakṣarbhirapi vīkṣitum ॥10॥
8.73.11: tathaiva satataṁ pārtha rakṣitābhyāṁ tvayā raṇe,
8.73.12: ko hi śakto raṇe pārtha bhāratānāṁ mahārathau,
8.73.13: ko hi śāntanavaṁ bhīṣmaṁ droṇaṁ vaikartanaṁ kr̥pam,
drauṇiṁ ca saumadattiṁ ca kr̥tavarmāṇameva ca ॥13॥
8.73.18: tvāṁ samāsādya nidhanaṁ gatā bhīmaṁ ca bhārata ॥18॥
8.73.22: na śakyā yudhi nirjetuṁ tvadanyena parantapa,
dhārtarāṣṭramudagraṁ hi vyūḍhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā mahad balam ॥22॥
8.73.23: yadi tvaṁ na bhavestrātā pratīyāt ko nu mānavaḥ,
8.73.27: bhīmasenaṁ samāsādya tvāṁ ca pāṇḍava kauravāḥ ॥27॥
8.73.28: tathā senāmukhe tatra nihate pārtha pāṇḍavaiḥ ॥28॥
8.73.33: dināni daśa bhīṣmeṇa nighnatā tāvakaṁ balam ॥33॥
8.73.38: na śekuḥ sr̥ñjayā draṣṭuṁ tathaivānye mahīkṣitaḥ,
vicarantaṁ tathā taṁ tu saṅgrāme jitakāśinam ॥38॥
8.73.39: sa tu vidrāvya samare pāṇḍavān sr̥ñjayānapi ॥39॥
8.73.40: taṁ śikhaṇḍī samāsādya tvayā gupto mahāvratam ॥40॥
8.73.41: sa eṣa patitaḥ śete śaratalpe pitāmahaḥ ॥41॥
8.73.42: tvāṁ prāpya puruṣavyāghraṁ vr̥traḥ prāpyeva vāsavam,
8.73.45: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ samāsādya sa gataḥ paramāṁ gatim,
yadi vādya bhavān yuddhe sūtaputramukhān rathān ॥45॥
8.73.46: nāvārayiṣyaḥ saṅgrāme na sma droṇo vyanaṅkṣyata,
bhavatā tu balaṁ sarvaṁ dhārtarāṣṭrasya vāritam ॥46॥
8.73.47: tato droṇo hato yuddhe pārṣatena dhanañjaya,
evaṁ vā ko raṇe kuryāt tvadanyaḥ kṣatriyo yudhi ॥47॥
8.73.48: yādr̥śaṁ te kr̥taṁ pārtha jayadrathavadhaṁ prati,
nivārya senāṁ mahatīṁ hatvā śūrāṁśca pārthivān ॥48॥
8.73.50: anāścaryaṁ hi tat tvattastvaṁ hi pārtha mahārathaḥ,
tvāṁ hi prāpya raṇe kṣatramekāhāditi bhārata ॥50॥
8.73.53: vidhvastā hi raṇe pārtha seneyaṁ bhīmavikrama ॥53॥
8.73.59: yadi vā dvipadāṁ śreṣṭhaṁ droṇaṁ mānayato gurum,
aśvatthāmni kr̥pā te’sti kr̥pe vācārya gauravāt ॥59॥
8.73.63: etat te sukr̥taṁ karma nātra kiñcana yujyate,
8.73.65: tasya sarvasya duṣṭātmā karṇo vai mūlamityuta,
8.73.67: karṇaḥ pārthāt raṇe sarvān vijeṣyati na saṁśayaḥ,
8.73.68: rocito bhavatā sārdhaṁ jānatāpi bala tava,
karṇo hi bhāṣate nityamahaṁ pārthān samāgatān ॥68॥
8.73.70: yacca yuṣmāsu pāpaṁ vai dhārtarāṣṭraḥ prayuktavān ॥70॥
8.73.76: tanme dahati gātrāṇi sakhe satyena te śape,
yat tatrāpi ca duṣṭātmā karṇo’bhyadruhyata prabho ॥76॥
8.73.80: śrutvā karṇo vacaḥ krūraṁ tataściccheda kārmukam,
8.73.82: prāhasat sa tu duṣṭātmā karṇaḥ sa ca suyodhanaḥ,
yacca karṇo’bravīt kr̥ṣṇāṁ sabhāyāṁ paruṣaṁ vacaḥ ॥82॥
8.73.83: vinaṣṭāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kr̥ṣṇe śāśvataṁ narakaṁ gatāḥ ॥83॥
8.73.85: na pāṇḍavāḥ prabhavanti tava kr̥ṣṇe kathañcana ॥85॥
8.73.86: dāsabhāryā ca pāñcāli svayaṁ dāsī ca śobhane,
adya duryodhano hyokaḥ pr̥thivyāṁ nr̥patiḥ smr̥taḥ ॥86॥
8.73.87: paśyedānīṁ yathā bhadre vinaṣṭāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ samam ॥87॥
8.73.88: vyaktaṁ ṣaṇḍhatilā hyete niraye ca nimajjitāḥ ॥88॥
8.73.90: adya pāpasya tad vākyaṁ suvarṇavikr̥tāḥ śarāḥ ॥90॥
8.73.99: tvaṁ cet karṇasutaṁ pārtha sūtaputrasya paśyataḥ,
8.73.100: hataṁ karṇastu taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā priyaṁ putraṁ durātmavān,
8.73.101: nirāśo jīvite tvadya rājye caiva bhavatvariḥ ॥101॥
8.73.102: ete dravanti pañcālā vadhyamānāḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.73.104: sudharmāṇaṁ sātyakiṁ ca viddhi karṇavaśaṁ gatān ॥104॥
8.73.106: na tveva bhītāḥ pañcālāḥ kathañcit syuḥ parāṅmukhāḥ,
na hi mr̥tyuṁ maheṣvāsā gaṇayanti mahāraṇe ॥106॥
8.73.107: ya ekaḥ pāṇḍavīṁ senāṁ śaraughaiḥ samaveṣṭayat,
taṁ samāsādya pañcālā bhīṣmaṁ nāsan parāṅmukhāḥ ॥107॥
8.73.119: ete dravanti pañcālā dikṣu sarvāsu bhārata,
8.73.120: eṣa bhīmo dr̥ḍhakrodho vr̥taḥ pārtha samantataḥ,
8.73.122: nānyaṁ tvatto hi paśyāmi yodhaṁ yaudhiṣṭhire bale,
8.73.124: tvaṁ hi śakto raṇe jetuṁ sakarṇānapi kauravān,
nānyo yudhi yudhāṁ śreṣṭha satyametad bravīmi te ॥124॥
8.73.125: etat kr̥tvā mahat karma hatvā karṇaṁ mahāratham,
kr̥tārthaḥ saphalaḥ pārtha sukhī bhava narottama ॥125॥
8.74.1: sa keśavasya bībhatsuḥ śrutvā bhārata bhāṣitam,
8.74.3: tvayā nāthena govinda dhruva eva jayo mama,
prasanno yasya me’dya tvaṁ loke bhūtabhaviṣyakr̥t ॥3॥
8.74.4: tvatsahāyo hyahaṁ kr̥ṣṇa trīm̐llokān vai samāgatān,
prāpayeyaṁ paraṁ lokaṁ kimu karṇaṁ mahāhave ॥4॥
8.74.6: bhārgavāstraṁ ca paśyāmi jvalantaṁ kr̥ṣṇa sarvaśaḥ,
8.74.7: ayaṁ khalu sa saṅgrāmo yatra karṇaṁ mayā hatam,
8.74.8: adya kr̥ṣṇa vikarṇā me karṇaṁ neṣyanti mr̥tyave,
8.74.10: adya rājyāt sukhāccaiva śriyo rāṣṭrāt tathā purāt,
8.74.11: guṇavantaṁ hi yo dveṣṭi nirguṇaṁ kurute prabhum,
sa śocati nr̥paḥ kr̥ṣṇa kṣipramevāgate kṣaye ॥11॥
8.74.12: yathā ca puruṣaḥ kaścicchittvā cāmravaṇaṁ mahat,
phalaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhr̥śaṁ duḥkhī bhaviṣyati janārdana,
sūtaputre hate tvadya nirāśo bhavitā prabhuḥ ॥12॥
8.74.13: bhaviṣyati hate karṇe kr̥ṣṇa satyaṁ bravīmi te ॥13॥
8.74.14: smaratāṁ tava vākyāni śamaṁ prati janeśvaraḥ ॥14॥
8.74.15: adyāsau saubalaḥ kr̥ṣṇa glahāñjānātu vai śarān,
durodaraṁ ca gāṇḍīvaṁ maṇḍalaṁ ca rathaṁ prati ॥15॥
8.74.16: vyapaneṣyāmi govinda hatvā karṇaṁ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥16॥
8.74.17: adya kuntīsuto rājā hate sūtasute mayā,
8.74.19: yasya caitad vrataṁ mahyaṁ vadhe kila durātmanaḥ,
pādau na dhāvaye tāvad yāvaddhanyāṁ na phālgunam ॥19॥
8.74.20: mr̥ṣā kr̥tvā vrataṁ tasya pāpasya madhusūdana,
8.74.23: anr̥taṁ tat kariṣyanti māmakā niśitāḥ śarāḥ,
8.74.25: sabhāmadhye vacaḥ krūraṁ kutsayan pāṇḍavān prati ॥25॥
8.74.26: ye vai ṣaṇḍhatilāstatra bhavitāro’dya te tilāḥ,
8.74.28: anr̥taṁ tat kariṣyanti māmakā niśitāḥ śarāḥ,
8.74.33: adya karṇe hate kr̥ṣṇa dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ sarājakāḥ ॥33॥
8.74.34: vidravantu diśo bhītāḥ siṁhatrastā mr̥gā iva,
8.74.35: hate karṇe mayā saṅkhye saputre sasuhr̥jjane,
8.74.36: jānātu māṁ raṇe kr̥ṣṇa pravaraṁ sarvadhanvinām,
8.74.40: adya rājā mahat kr̥cchraṁ santyakṣyati yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥40॥
8.74.45: pramathiṣyāmi gātrāṇi śirāṁsi ca śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
adya nirdhārtarāṣṭrāṁ ca bhrātre dāsyāmi medinīm ॥45॥
8.74.47: kopasya ca kurūṇāṁ ca śarāṇāṁ gāṇḍivasya ca,
8.74.48: hatvā karṇaṁ raṇe kr̥ṣṇa śambaraṁ maghavāniva,
adya karṇe hate yuddhe somakānāṁ mahārathāḥ ॥48॥
8.74.49: kr̥taṁ kāryaṁ ca manyantāṁ mitrakāryepsavo yudhi,
na jāne ca kathaṁ prītiḥ śaineyasyādya mādhava ॥49॥
8.74.50: bhaviṣyati hate karṇe mayi cāpi jayādhike,
ahaṁ hatvā raṇe karṇaṁ putraṁ cāsya mahāratham ॥50॥
8.74.51: prītiṁ dāsyāmi bhīmasya yamayoḥ sātyakasya ca,
8.74.53: yudhyantaṁ kauravān saṅkhye ghātayantaṁ ca sūtajam,
8.74.57: pādau ca me sarathau sadhvajau ca
8.76.15: kiṁ śiṣṭaṁ syāt sāyakānāṁ rathe me,
kā vā jātiḥ kiṁ pramāṇaṁ ca teṣāṁ
8.76.15d1: kati vā sahasrāṇi kati vā śatāni
8.77.1: śrutvā tu rathanirghoṣaṁ siṁhanadaṁ ca saṁyuge,
arjunaḥ prāha govindaṁ śīghraṁ nodaya vājinaḥ ॥1॥
8.77.2: eṣa gacchāmi sukṣipraṁ yatra bhīmo vyavasthitaḥ ॥2॥
8.77.13: te tu taṁ puruṣavyāghraṁ vyāghrā iva mahārathāḥ,
8.77.17: tatra tatra sma līyante bhaye jāte mahārathāḥ ॥17॥
8.77.19: te vadhyamānāḥ samare nānāliṅgaiḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.77.21: tāṁ tu senāṁ bhr̥śaṁ viddhvā drāvayitvārjunaḥ śaraiḥ,
8.77.24: tyaktvā prāṇān mahārāja senāṁ tava mamarda ha ॥24॥
8.77.27: tāṁ tu senāṁ tadā bhīmo darśayan pāṇilāghavam,
8.77.30: samādiśan raṇe sarvān hata bhīmamiti sma ha ॥30॥
8.77.31: pratigr̥hya ca tāmājñāṁ tava putrasya pārthivāḥ ॥31॥
8.77.33: sa taiḥ parivr̥taḥ śūraiḥ śūro rājan samantataḥ ॥33॥
8.77.35: sa rarāja tathā saṅkhye darśanīyo narottamaḥ,
8.77.36: tasya te pārthivāḥ sarve śaravr̥ṣṭiṁ samāsr̥jan,
8.77.38: nr̥ṇāṁ śatasahasre dve dve śate caiva bhārata ॥38॥
8.77.47: evaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā kr̥taṁ karma bhīmasenena saṁyuge,
8.77.48: asmin jite jitaṁ manye pāṇḍaveyaṁ mahābalam ॥48॥
8.77.51: saṁnyavartata taṁ bhīmo vāryamāṇaḥ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.77.52: varma bhittvā tu te ghorāḥ pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ ॥52॥
8.77.54: preṣayāmāsa sa ruṣā saubalaṁ prati bhārata,
8.77.55: tasmin nipatite bhūmau bhīmaḥ kruddho viśāmpate ॥55॥
8.77.58: dvābhyāṁ sa sārathiṁ hyārcchad bhīmaṁ saptabhireva ca,
8.77.62: sā nirbhidya bhujaṁ savyaṁ pāṇḍavasya mahātmanaḥ ॥62॥
8.77.64: na tu taṁ mamr̥ṣe bhīmaḥ siṁhanādaṁ tarasvinām,
anyad gr̥hya dhanuḥ sajyaṁ tvaramāṇo mahābalaḥ ॥64॥
8.77.69: dhanuściccheda saṅkruddho vivyādha ca śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.77.74: parāṅmukhaṁ tu rājānaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā sainyāni bhārata,
8.77.75: tān dr̥ṣṭvā vidrutān sarvān dhārtarāṣṭrān parāṅmukhān,
8.77.77: sa hi teṣāṁ mahāvīryo dvīpo’bhūt sumahābalaḥ,
8.78.1: duryodhano’bravīt kiṁ nu saubalo vāpi sañjaya ॥1॥
8.78.2: karṇo vā jayatāṁ śreṣṭho yodhā vā māmakā yudhi,
kr̥po vā kr̥tavarmā vā drauṇirduḥśāsano’pi vā ॥2॥
8.78.5: śarma varma pratiṣṭhā ca jīvitāśā ca sañjaya,
8.78.6: putrā vā mama durdharṣā rājāno vā mahārathāḥ,
8.78.11: praviśya ca mahat sainyaṁ śalyaḥ parabalārdanaḥ,
8.78.16: taṁ śikhaṇḍī ca bhīmaśca dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaśca pārṣataḥ,
8.78.17: sātyakistu tadā karṇaṁ viṁśatyā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥17॥
8.78.22: tān pratyavidhyad rādheyaḥ pañcabhiḥ pañcabhiḥ śaraiḥ,
8.78.23: bhīmasenaṁ tataḥ kruddho vivyādha triṁśatā śaraiḥ ॥23॥
8.78.29: prādravanta raṇe bhītāḥ siṁhatrastā mr̥gā iva,
8.78.35: prādravanta raṇe bhītāḥ karṇaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā mahāratham,
8.78.37: karṇamekaṁ raṇe yodhaṁ menire tatra śātravāḥ,
8.78.39: tathā tat pāṇḍavaṁ sainyaṁ karṇamāsādya dīryate,
8.78.41: bāhūṁśca vīro vīrāṇāṁ ciccheda laghu ceṣubhiḥ,
8.78.42: rathāṁśca vividhān rājan patākā vyajanāni ca,
akṣaṁ ca yugayoktrāṇi cakrāṇi vividhāni ca ॥42॥
8.78.45: nāpi sve na pare yodhāḥ prājñāyanta parasparam ॥45॥
8.78.46: ghore śarāndhakāre tu karṇāstre ca vijr̥mbhite,
8.78.47: te pāṇḍaveyāḥ samare rādheyena punaḥ punaḥ ॥47॥
8.78.48: mr̥gasaṅghān yathā kruddhaḥ siṁho drāvayate vane ॥48॥
8.78.50: kālayāmāsa tat sainyaṁ yathā paśugaṇān vr̥kaḥ,
dr̥ṣṭvā tu pāṇḍavīṁ senāṁ dhārtarāṣṭrāḥ parāṅmukhīm ॥50॥
8.78.51: duryodhano hi rājendra mudā paramayā yutaḥ ॥51॥
8.78.53: nyavartanta yathā śūraṁ mr̥tyuṁ kr̥tvā nivartanam,
tān nivr̥ttān raṇe śūrān rādheyaḥ śatrutāpanaḥ ॥53॥
8.78.54: tatra bhārata karṇena pañcālā viṁśatī rathāḥ ॥54॥
8.78.59: tathā sa somakān hatvā tasthāveko mahārathaḥ,
8.78.63: tatra yuddhaṁ mahaccāsīt krūraṁ viśasanaṁ mahat,
8.79.1: sūtaputraṁ ca saṅkruddhaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā caiva mahāraṇe ॥1॥
8.79.5: jayaiṣiṇāṁ ca sutarāṁ bhīrūṇāṁ ca sudustarām ॥5॥
8.79.7: eṣa ketū raṇe kr̥ṣṇa sūtaputrasya dr̥śyate,
8.79.9: karṇena bhagnān pañcālān drāvayan bahu śobhate,
8.79.13: niḥśeṣān samare kuryāt paśyatāṁ no janārdana ॥13॥
8.79.19: ayaṁ sa ratha āyāti śvetāśvaḥ kr̥ṣṇasārathiḥ,
8.79.20: eṣa tiṣṭhati kaunteyaḥ saṁspr̥śan gāṇḍivaṁ dhanuḥ,
taṁ haniṣyasi cedadya tannaḥ śreyo bhaviṣyati ॥20॥
8.79.23: etaccakraṁ gadā śaṅkhaḥ śārṅgaṁ kr̥ṣṇasya ca prabho,
8.79.24: ete hastavatā muktā ghnantyamitrān śitāḥ śarāḥ ॥24॥
8.79.31: asahyamāno rādheya taṁ yāhi prati bhārata ॥31॥
8.79.31d1: ghr̥ṇāṁ tyaktvā pramādaṁ ca bhr̥gorastraṁ ca saṁsmara,
dr̥ṣṭiṁ muṣṭiṁ ca sandhānaṁ smr̥tvā rāmopadeśajam,
8.79.32: arjunasya bhayāt tūrṇaṁ nighnataḥ śātravān bahūn ॥32॥
8.79.34: na hyavasthāsyate pārtho yuyutsuḥ kenacit saha,
8.79.35: śikhaṇḍinaṁ sātyakiṁ ca dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ ca pārṣatam ॥35॥
8.79.36: nakulaṁ sahadevaṁ ca bhrātarau dvau samīkṣya ca ॥36॥
8.79.38: tvaṁ karṇa pratiyāhyenaṁ nāstyanyo hi dhanurdharaḥ ॥38॥
8.79.39: na taṁ paśyāmi loke’smiṁstvatto hyanyaṁ dhanurdharam,
arjunaṁ samare kruddhaṁ yo velāmiva dhārayet ॥39॥
8.79.40: na cāsya rakṣāṁ paśyāmi pārśvato na ca pr̥ṣṭhataḥ,
8.79.41: tvaṁ hi kr̥ṣṇau raṇe saktaḥ saṁsādhayitumāhave,
8.79.43: vanasthitaṁ yathā vyāghraṁ jahi karṇa dhanañjayam ॥43॥
8.79.45: dravatāmatha teṣāṁ tu nānyo’sti yudhi mānavaḥ,
8.79.46: ete tvāṁ kuravaḥ sarve dvīpamāsādya saṁyuge,
8.79.47: gāndhārāśca yayā dhr̥tyā jitāḥ saṅkhye sudurjayāḥ,
tāṁ dhr̥tiṁ kuru rādheya tataḥ pratyehi pāṇḍavam ॥47॥
8.79.48d1: yathaikena tvayā pūrvaṁ kr̥to digvijayaḥ purā,
8.79.50: paśya bāhvorbalaṁ me’dya śikṣitasya ca paśya me,
8.79.51: kr̥ṣṇau ca puruṣavyāghra tataḥ satyaṁ bravīmi te,
nāhatvā yudhi tau vīrau vyapayāsye kathañcana ॥51॥
8.79.52: svapsye vā nihatastābhyāmanityo hi raṇe jayaḥ,
8.79.66: bhayaṁ me vai jāyate sādhvasaṁ ca
8.80.5: gātrāṇi prācchinat pārthaḥ śirāṁsi ca cakarta ha ॥5॥
8.80.20: kr̥taṁ pravihataṁ bāṇaiḥ sarvataḥ pradrutaṁ diśaḥ,
8.80.21: utsr̥jya ca mahābāhuṁ bhīmasenaṁ tathā raṇe ॥21॥
8.80.23: samāgamya ca bhīmena mantrayitvā ca phālgunaḥ ॥23॥
8.80.25: nādayan rathaghoṣeṇa pr̥thivīṁ dyāṁ ca bhārata,
8.80.28: na yuktān hi sa tān mene yamāyāśu kirīṭinā,
8.81.6: savimānā yathā siddhāḥ svargāt puṇyakṣaye tathā ॥6॥
8.81.11: pārśvato vyahanan pārthaṁ tava putrasya śāsanāt ॥11॥
8.81.14: atha tān dviradān sarvān nānāliṅgaiḥ śarottamaiḥ,
8.81.20d1: asaṁyuktāśca te rājan parivr̥ttā raṇaṁ prati,
8.81.23: dr̥ṣṭvārjunaṁ tadā bhīmo jagāma bhrātaraṁ prati ॥23॥
8.81.31: gadāpāṇiṁ tato bhīmaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā bhārata tāvakāḥ,
8.81.32: sa matta iva mātaṅgaḥ saṅkruddhaḥ pāṇḍunandanaḥ,
8.81.33: vigāhya ca gajānīkaṁ pragr̥hya mahatīṁ gadām,
8.81.35: hatvā tu tad gajānīkaṁ bhīmaseno mahābalaḥ,
8.81.41: na hyatrāsīdanirbhinno rathaḥ sādī hayo gajaḥ ॥41॥
8.81.42d1: tat sainyaṁ bharataśreṣṭha vadhyamānaṁ śitaiḥ śaraiḥ,
na jahau samaraṁ prāpya phālgunaṁ śatrutāpanam.
8.81.45: te hitvā samare karṇaṁ vadhyamānāśca sāyakaiḥ,
8.81.46: abhyadravata tān pārthaḥ kiran śaraśatān bahūn,
8.81.47: putrāstu te mahārāja jagmuḥ karṇarathaṁ prati,
8.81.48: kuravo hi mahārāja nirviṣāḥ pannagā iva,
8.81.51: mā bhaiṣṭetyabravīt karṇo hyabhīto māmiteti ca ॥51॥
8.81.52: sambhagnaṁ hi balaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā balāt pārthena tāvakam,
8.81.53: tān pradrutān kurūn dr̥ṣṭvā karṇaḥ śastrabhr̥tāṁ varaḥ,
8.82.32d1: samaṁ ca śūrau ca sasārathī tadā,
8.83.4: dr̥ṣṭvā tu tat karma kr̥taṁ suduṣkaraṁ
8.83.24: anena yājñasenyā me bhīma keśā vikarṣitāḥ,
8.83.42: eṣa te rudhiraṁ kaṇṭhāt pibāmi puruṣādhama ॥42॥
8.83.49: ityuktvā vacanaṁ rājan jayaṁ prāpya vr̥kodaraḥ,
8.84.1: duḥśāsane tu nihate tava putrā mahārathāḥ,
8.84.2: daśa rājan mahāvīryā bhīmaṁ prācchādayan śaraiḥ,
8.84.6: hateṣu teṣu vīreṣu pradudrāva balaṁ tava ॥6॥
8.84.7: tataḥ karṇo mahārāja praviveśa mahad bhayam ॥7॥
8.84.9: mā vyathāṁ kuru rādheya naivaṁ tvayyupapadyate ॥9॥
8.84.15: bhāro hi dhārtarāṣṭreṇa tvayi sarvaḥ samāhitaḥ,
8.84.16: jaye syād vipulā kīrtirdhruvaḥ svargaḥ parājaye,
8.84.17: hr̥di cāvaśyakaṁ bhāvaṁ cakre yuddhāya susthiram ॥17॥
8.84.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate karṇaparvaṇi vr̥ṣasenayuddhe nakulaparājaye caturaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥84॥
8.85.4: tava nr̥pa rathivaryāṁstān daśaikaṁ ca vīrān
8.85.13: śitaiḥ śarīraṁ vyahanad dvipaṁ ca tam ॥13॥
8.86.3: yena te saha yoddhavyaṁ sthiro bhava dhanañjaya,
paśya cainaṁ samāyuktaṁ rathaṁ karṇasya pāṇḍava ॥3॥
8.86.5: dhvajaṁ ca paśya karṇasya nāgakakṣaṁ mahātmanaḥ ॥5॥
8.86.11: dr̥ṣṭvā kesariṇaṁ kruddhaṁ mr̥gā iva mahāvane,
8.86.13: tvaṁ hi jetuṁ raṇe śaktastathaiva viditaṁ mama,
8.86.14: na śaktā draṣṭumīśānaṁ kiṁ punaryodhituṁ prabhum,
8.86.16: jahi karṇaṁ mahābāho namuciṁ vr̥trahā yathā,
8.86.17: dhruva eva jayaḥ kr̥ṣṇa mama nāstyatra saṁśayaḥ,
8.86.19: adya karṇaṁ hataṁ paśya maccharaiḥ śakalīkr̥tam,
māṁ vā drakṣyasi govinda karṇena nihataṁ śaraiḥ ॥19॥
8.86.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate karṇaparvaṇi karṇārjunadvairathe vāsudevavākye ṣaḍaśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥86॥
8.87.5: tau dr̥ṣṭvā vismayaṁ jagmuḥ sarvasainyāni māriṣa,
8.87.7: dhvajau ca dr̥ṣṭvā saṁsaktau vismayaḥ samapadyata,
hastikakṣaṁ ca karṇasya vānaraṁ ca kirīṭinaḥ ॥7॥
8.87.8: tau rathau samprasaktau tu dr̥ṣṭvā bhārata pārthivāḥ,
8.87.9: dr̥ṣṭvā ca dvairathaṁ tābhyāṁ tatra yodhāḥ sahasraśaḥ,
8.87.13: tau dr̥ṣṭvā puruṣavyāghrau rathasthau rathināṁ varau,
8.87.31: tāvakānāṁ raṇe karṇo glaho hyāsīd viśāmpate,
8.87.32: ta eva sabhyāstatrāsan prekṣakāścābhavan sma te,
8.87.34: tau tu sthitau mahārāja samare yuddhaśālinau,
8.87.46: vasavo marutaḥ sādhyā rudrā viśve’śvinau tathā ॥46॥
8.87.48: viśaḥ śūdrāśca sūtāśca ye ca saṅkarajātayaḥ,
8.87.50: brahma kṣatraṁ ca yajñāśca dakṣiṇāścārjunaṁ śritāḥ,
8.87.52d4: te bhāvāḥ sahitāḥ karṇaṁ praviṣṭāḥ sūtanandanam,
8.87.52d7: tato devagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṁ siddhāśca saha cāraṇaiḥ,
8.87.57: bhavaścaiva sthito yāne divye taṁ deśamāgamat,
8.87.59: hatvārjunaṁ mama sutaḥ karṇo jayatu saṁyuge,
hatvā karṇaṁ jayatvadya mama putro dhanañjayaḥ ॥59॥
8.87.60: iti sūryasya caivāsīd vivādo vāsavasya ca,
8.87.68: tat tathāstu namaste’stu prasīda bhagavan mama,
8.87.70: svargaṁ ca samanuprāpya sāhāyyaṁ śakra te kr̥tam,
karṇaśca dānavaḥ pakṣa ataḥ kāryaḥ parājayaḥ ॥70॥
8.87.71: evaṁ kr̥te bhavet kāryaṁ devānāmeva niścitam,
8.87.73: kathaṁ vā tasya na jayo jāyate śatalocana ॥73॥
8.87.74: yasya cakre svayaṁ viṣṇuḥ sārathyaṁ jagataḥ prabhuḥ,
8.87.78: na vidyate vyavasthānaṁ kruddhayoḥ kr̥ṣṇayoḥ kvacit,
8.87.80: naitayostu samaḥ kaścid divi vā mānuṣeṣu vā,
8.87.89: rathau tayoḥ śvetahayau divyau yuktau mahātmanoḥ,
8.87.90: samāgatā lokavīrāḥ śaṅkhān dadhmuḥ pr̥thak pr̥thak,
8.87.98: prakurvāte dhvajau yuddhaṁ pūrvaṁ pūrvataraṁ tadā ॥98॥
8.87.102: yadi pārtho raṇe hanyādadya māmiha karhicit,
8.87.103: yadi karṇa raṇe hanyādadya tvāṁ śvetavāhanaḥ,
8.87.104: taṁ prahasyābravīt kr̥ṣṇaḥ satyaṁ pārthamidaṁ vacaḥ ॥104॥
8.87.106: hanyāṁ karṇaṁ tathā śalyaṁ bāhubhyāmeva saṁyuge ॥106॥
8.87.112: na hi me śāmyate manyuryadanena purā kr̥tam ॥112॥
8.87.115: adya tā madhurā vācaḥ śrotāsi madhusūdana,
diṣṭyā jayasi vārṣṇeya iti karṇe nipātite ॥115॥
8.87.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate karṇaparvaṇi karṇārjunasamāgame dvairathe saptāśītitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥87॥
8.88.23: tvayā tu pārthaiśca kr̥te ca saṁvide
8.88.24: na ced vacaḥ śroṣyasi me narādhipa
8.88.24d2: yathocitaṁ ca vai rājyamanujñāsyati te prabhuḥ,
8.88.24d6: rājyaṁ śrīścaiva bhadraṁ te jīvamāne tu kalpate.
8.88.24d7: mr̥tasya khalu kauravya naiva rājyaṁ kutaḥ sukham,
8.88.24d8: śāmya tvaṁ pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṁ śeṣaṁ kurukulasya ca,
mā bhūt sa kālaḥ kauravya yadāhamahitaṁ vacaḥ.
8.88.24d9: brūyāṁ kāmaṁ mahābāho māvamaṁsthā vaco mama,
8.88.24d10: prajāhitaṁ ca gāndhāre kulasya ca sukhāvaham.
8.88.24d11: na jeṣyati naravyāghramiti me niścitā matiḥ.
8.88.24d12: rocatāṁ te naraśreṣṭha mamaitad vacanaṁ śubham,
ato’nyathā hi rājendra vināśaḥ sumahān bhavet.
8.88.25: idaṁ ca dr̥ṣṭaṁ jagatā saha tvayā
na cāpi dhātā bhagavān na yakṣarāṭ ॥25॥
8.88.31: na tat parokṣaṁ bhavataḥ kutaḥ śamaḥ ॥31॥
8.89.61: tataḥ sa kr̥ṣṇaṁ ca kirīṭinaṁ ca
8.89.77: kr̥ṣṇaṁ ca pārthaṁ ca tathā dhvajaṁ ca
8.89.84: karṇaṁ ca śalyaṁ ca kurūṁśca sarvān
8.89.96d2: kṣātre ca dharme niratāḥ stha yūyam,
8.90.24: nihata iti suto me srastagātro babhūva,
8.90.26: na sandhatte dviḥ śaraṁ śalya karṇo
8.90.42: dr̥ṣṭvā gogatakaṁ jahāra mukuṭaṁ gośabdagopūri vai
8.90.48: na sandadhyāṁ dviḥ śaraṁ caiva nāga
8.90.69: tato rathasthaḥ sa mumoha ca skhalan
8.90.86: sa cāpi nighnāti na pāti bhaktān
8.90.92: gāṇḍīvaṁ jyāṁ ca bāṇāṁśca so’numantrya parantapaḥ,
8.90.95: visr̥jāstraṁ paraṁ pārtha rādheyo grasate śarān,
8.90.97: dvitīyāṁ ca tr̥tīyāṁ ca caturthīṁ pañcamīṁ tathā,
8.90.98: navamīṁ daśamīṁ cāsya tathā caikādaśīṁ vr̥ṣaḥ,
8.90.100: tasya jyāchedanaṁ karṇo jyāvadhānaṁ ca saṁyuge,
8.90.102: tataḥ kr̥ṣṇo’rjunaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā karṇāstreṇa ca pīḍitam,
8.90.108: bho bhoḥ pārtha maheṣvāsa muhūrtaṁ paripālaya,
8.90.109: savyaṁ cakraṁ mahīgrastaṁ dr̥ṣṭvā daivādidaṁ mama,
8.90.113: na vimuñcanti śastrāṇi śūrāḥ sādhuvrate sthitāḥ,
tvaṁ ca śūratamo loke sādhuvr̥ttaśca pāṇḍava ॥113॥
8.90.115: na māṁ rathastho bhūmiṣṭhaṁ vikalaṁ hantumarhasi ॥115॥
8.90.116: na vāsudevāt tvatto vā pāṇḍaveya bibhemyaham,
8.91.1: nindanti daivaṁ kukr̥taṁ na tu svam ॥1॥
8.91.4: vanavāse vyatīte ca karṇa varṣe trayodaśe,
na prayacchasi yad rājyaṁ kva te dharmastadā gataḥ ॥4॥
8.91.5: ācarat tvanmate rājā kva te dharmastadā gataḥ ॥5॥
8.91.6: ādīpayastvaṁ rādheya kva te dharmastadā gataḥ ॥6॥
8.91.7: sabhāyāṁ prāhasaḥ karṇa kva te dharmastadā gataḥ ॥7॥
8.91.8: upaprekṣasi rādheya kva te dharmastadā gataḥ ॥8॥
8.91.9: vinaṣṭāḥ pāṇḍavāḥ kr̥ṣṇe śāśvataṁ narakaṁ gatāḥ,
8.91.10: upaprekṣasi rādheya kva te dharmastadā gataḥ,
yadā śakunimāśritya kva te dharmastadā gataḥ ॥10॥
8.91.11: parivārya raṇe bālaṁ kva te dharmastadā gataḥ ॥11॥
8.91.20: tat samīkṣya tataḥ karṇo brahmāstreṇa dhanañjayam,
8.91.34: tathaiva sampūjya sa tad vacaḥ prabho-
8.91.59: dr̥ṣṭvā tu karṇaṁ bhuvi vā vipannaṁ
8.91.68d1: mandaṁ mandaṁ vrajati savitā mandiraṁ mandaraśmiḥ.
8.92.11: vanye ca sarve tava śatravo ye ॥11॥
8.93.3: tadā tava sutān rājannāviveśa mahad bhayam ॥3॥
8.93.4: āsīd buddhirhate karṇe tava yodhasya karhicit ॥4॥
8.93.15: duryodhano’tha svaṁ sūtaṁ hā hā kr̥tvedamabravīt ॥15॥
8.93.17: yudhyamānaṁ hi kaunteyaṁ haniṣyāmi na saṁśayaḥ,
8.93.24: na tān rathastho bhūmiṣṭhān dharmāpekṣī vr̥kodaraḥ,
8.93.33: viśrutaṁ triṣu lokeṣu gāṇḍīvaṁ vyākṣipad dhanuḥ,
8.93.34: arjunaṁ cāpi yoddhāraṁ tvadīyāḥ prādravan bhayāt,
8.93.38: dhr̥ṣṭadyumnaṁ raṇe dr̥ṣṭvā tvadīyāḥ prādavan bhayāt,
8.93.40: te sarve tāvakān prekṣya dravato’pi parāṅmukhān ॥40॥
8.93.41: senāvaśeṣaṁ taṁ dr̥ṣṭvā tava sainyasya pāṇḍavaḥ ॥41॥
8.93.43: viśrutaṁ triṣu lokeṣu vyākṣipad gāṇḍivaṁ dhanuḥ,
8.93.44: tamasā saṁvr̥tenātha na sma kiñcid vyadr̥śyata,
8.93.45: yodhāḥ sarve mahārāja tāvakāḥ prādravan bhayāt,
8.93.52: na taṁ deśaṁ prapaśyāmi yatra yātā bhayārditāḥ ॥52॥
8.93.53: gatānāṁ yatra vai mokṣaḥ pāṇḍavāt kiṁ gatena vaḥ,
alpaṁ ca balameteṣāṁ kr̥ṣṇau ca bhr̥śavikṣatau ॥53॥
8.93.54: adya sarvān haniṣyāmi dhruvo hi vijayo bhavet,
8.93.55: anusr̥tya vadhiṣyanti śreyān naḥ samare vadhaḥ,
8.93.56: mr̥to duḥkhaṁ na jānīte pretya cānantyamaśnute,
śr̥ṇudhvaṁ kṣatriyāḥ sarve yāvantaḥ stha samāgatāḥ ॥56॥
8.93.57: yadā śūraṁ ca bhīruṁ ca mārayatyantako yamaḥ,
ko nu mūḍho na yudhyeta mādr̥śaḥ kṣatriyavrataḥ ॥57॥
8.93.59: na yuddhadharmācchreyo hi panthāḥ svargasya kauravāḥ,
acireṇa hatā lokān sadyo yodhāḥ samaśnuta ॥59॥
8.93.60: evaṁ bruvati putre te sainikā bhr̥śavikṣatāḥ,
8.94.24: hā karṇa hā karṇa iti bruvāṇa-
8.94.28: hā karṇa hā karṇa iti bruvāṇāḥ,
8.94.40: yathā hi jvalano dīpto jalamāsādya śāmyati,
8.94.41: āhr̥tya ca yaśo dīptaṁ suyuddhenātmano bhuvi,
visr̥jya śaravarṣāṇi pratāpya ca diśo daśa ॥41॥
8.94.42: saputraḥ samare karṇaḥ sa śāntaḥ pārthatejasā,
8.94.45: sadbhiḥ sadā satpuruṣaḥ sa hato dvairathe vr̥ṣaḥ ॥45॥
8.94.47: sadā strīṇāṁ priyo nityaṁ dātā caiva mahārathaḥ,
sa vai pārthāstranirdagdho gataḥ paramikāṁ gatim ॥47॥
8.94.48: yamāśrityākarod vairaṁ putraste sa gato divam,
ādāya tava putrāṇāṁ jayāśāṁ śarma varma ca ॥48॥
8.94.iti: iti śrīmahābhārate karṇaparvaṇi raṇabhūmivarṇanaṁ nāma caturnavatitamo’dhyāyaḥ ॥94॥
8.95.2: karṇaṁ tu nihataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā śatrubhiḥ paramāhave,
8.95.8: aśvatthāmā tataḥ śūro viniḥśvasya punaḥ punaḥ,
8.95.13: kuravo dudruvuḥ sarve dr̥ṣṭvā karṇaṁ nipātitam ॥13॥
8.95.15: nāsīttatra pumān kaścid yo yuddhāya mano dadhe ॥15॥
8.95.16: jīviteṣvapi rājyeṣu dāreṣu ca dhaneṣu ca ॥16॥
8.95.17: tān samānīya putraste yatnena mahatā vibhuḥ,
8.96.1: tathā nipatite karṇe parasainye ca vidrute,
8.96.3: tvayā tu nihataḥ karṇo dhanuṣā niśitaiḥ śaraiḥ ॥3॥
8.96.4: tamimaṁ vikramaṁ loke prathitaṁ te yaśaskaram,
8.96.7: tataḥ sa śibiraṁ gatvā sthitavān puruṣarṣabhaḥ ॥7॥
8.96.13: agr̥hṇītāṁ ca muditau caraṇau pārthivasya tau ॥13॥
8.96.16: tat tasmai tad yathāvr̥ttaṁ vāsudevaḥ sahārjunaḥ,
8.96.18: tvaṁ cāpi kuśalī rājan mādrīputrau ca pāṇḍavau ॥18॥
8.96.20: diṣṭyā jayasi rājendra diṣṭyā vardhasi bhārata ॥20॥
8.96.22: taṁ paśya puruṣavyāghra vibhinnaṁ bahubhiḥ śaraiḥ ॥22॥
8.96.25: diṣṭyā diṣṭyeti rājendra vākyaṁ cedamuvāca ha,
8.96.27: pragr̥hya ca kuruśreṣṭha sāṅgadaṁ dakṣiṇaṁ bhujam,
uvāca dharmabhr̥t pārtha ubhau tau keśavārjunau ॥27॥
8.96.30: jigāyābhimukhaḥ śatrūn na cāsīd vimukhaḥ kvacit ॥30॥
8.96.32: bhīṣmo droṇaśca karṇaśca mahātmā gautamaḥ kr̥paḥ,
anye ca bahavaḥ śūrā ye ca teṣāṁ padānugāḥ ॥32॥
8.96.33: tvadbuddhyā nihate karṇe hatā govinda sarvathā,
8.96.36: sa dadarśa raṇe karṇaṁ śayānaṁ puruṣarṣabham ॥36॥
8.96.37: citaṁ śaraśataiḥ karṇaṁ dharmarājo dadarśa saḥ ॥37॥
8.96.38: dīpikābhiḥ kr̥todyotaṁ paśyate vai vr̥ṣaṁ tadā ॥38॥
8.96.39: saputraṁ nihataṁ dr̥ṣṭvā karṇaṁ rājā yudhiṣṭhiraḥ ॥39॥
8.96.41: adya rājāsmi govinda pr̥thivyāṁ bhrātr̥bhiḥ saha,
8.96.43: jīvite caiva rājye ca hate rādhātmaje raṇe,
8.96.46: evaṁ sa bahuśo rājā praśaśaṁsa janārdanam,
8.96.47: dr̥ṣṭvā ca nihataṁ karṇaṁ saputraṁ pārthasāyakaiḥ,
8.96.55: tathā sā patitā devī gāndhārī dīrghadarśinī,
8.96.57: sa daivaṁ paramaṁ matvā bhavitavyaṁ ca pārthivaḥ ॥57॥
8.96.65: yo dadyāt sukr̥taṁ taddhi śravaṇāt karṇaparvaṇaḥ ॥65॥
